duas.title_sw: Sayyidul Istighfar (Bwana wa Maombi ya Msamaha)
duas.title_en: The Master Supplication for Forgiveness
duas.title_ar: سَيِّدُ الاِسْتِغْفَارِ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Anta Rabbiy laa ilaaha illaa Ant, khalaqtanee wa ana 'abduk, wa ana 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana't, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa aboo'u bidhambee faghfir lee fa-innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiye Mola wangu, hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe. Umeniumba mimi na mimi ni mja Wako, nami niko juu ya ahadi Yako na agano Lako kadiri niwezavyo. Ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya yale niliyoyafanya. Ninakiri Kwako neema Zako zilizo juu yangu, na ninakiri Kwako madhambi yangu, basi ninasamehe, kwani hakika hakuna anayesamehe madhambi ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge before You Your blessings upon me, and I confess to You my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ amesema: 'Mwenye kuisoma mchana akiwa na yakini nayo kisha akafa siku hiyo kabla ya jioni, basi ni miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi.'
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'Whoever says it during the day with firm conviction and dies that day before evening, will be from the people of Paradise.'

duas.title_sw: Kuanza Asubuhi (Asbahna wa Asbaha)
duas.title_en: We Have Entered the Morning
duas.title_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa khayra maa ba'dahu, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhal-yawmi wa sharri maa ba'dah, Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.swahili: Tumeingia asubuhi na ufalme wote umebaki kuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee, hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa zote njema ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya siku hii ya leo na kheri ya baada yake, na ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya siku hii ya leo na shari ya baada yake. Mola wangu, ninajikinga Kwako kutokana na uvivu na ubaya wa uzee. Mola wangu, ninajikinga Kwako na adhabu ya Moto na adhabu ya kaburi.
duas.english: We have entered the morning and at this very time the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, praise is due to Allah. None has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
duas.virtue_sw: Hukukinga na shari za mchana mzima na kukuweka chini ya uangalizi wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against the evils of the day and grants Allah's guardianship.

duas.title_sw: Ulinzi Kutokana na Kila Kitu (Bismillahi Alladhi)
duas.title_en: Protection In the Name of Allah
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye hakidhuru chochote kile pamoja na jina Lake, si katika ardhi wala mbinguni, Naye ndiye Mwenye kusikia yote, Mwenye kujua kila kitu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 asubuhi na mara 3 jioni, hakuna chochote kitakachomdhuru.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times in the morning and evening, nothing will harm them.

duas.title_sw: Kuridhika na Uislamu na Mtume
duas.title_en: Pleased with Allah as my Lord
duas.title_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبّاً
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبّاً، وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيّاً.
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi Rabban, wa bil-Islaami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama Nabiyyaa.
duas.swahili: Nimeridhika na Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa ndiye Mola wangu, na Uislamu kuwa ndiyo dini yangu, na Muhammad ﷺ kuwa ndiye Nabii wangu.
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad ﷺ as my Prophet.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 asubuhi na jioni, ni haki juu ya Mwenyezi Mungu kumridhisha siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times morning and evening, it is a duty upon Allah to please him on the Day of Resurrection.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Uhai na Ulinzi (Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyoom)
duas.title_en: Supplication to the Ever-Living
duas.title_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
duas.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kuwa hai milele, Ewe Msimamia mambo yote! Kwa rehema Yako ninaomba msaada; nitengenezee mambo yangu yote, wala usiniachie nafsi yangu hata kwa kope ya jicho.
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, in Your mercy I seek relief. Correct for me all my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Huleta utulivu wa moyo na kumuweka mwanadamu chini ya usimamizi wa Mwenyezi Mungu moja kwa moja.
duas.virtue_en: Brings heart tranquility and places the servant under Allah's constant care.

duas.title_sw: Tasbih na Tahmid Mara 100
duas.title_en: Glory and Praise to Allah 100 times
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdih.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa zote njema ni Zake.
duas.english: Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 100 asubuhi na jioni, atafutiwa madhambi yake hata yakiwa kama povu la bahari, na hapatakuwa na yeyote atakayekuja na amali bora zaidi siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever says it 100 times morning and evening, his sins will be erased even if like the foam of the sea.

duas.title_sw: Ayat al-Kursi (Aya ya Enzi - Kinga Kuu)
duas.title_en: Ayat al-Kursi (The Verse of the Throne)
duas.title_ar: آية الكرسي
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm, lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardh, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi'idhnih, ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bishay'im-min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi'a Kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ardh, wa laa ya'ooduhu hifdhuhumaa, wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu! Hapana mungu ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu. Hasinzii wala halali. Ni vyake vyote vilivyomo mbinguni na vilivyomo ardhini. Ni nani huyo awezaye kuombea mbele Yake bila ya idhini Yake? Anajua yaliyo mbele yao na yaliyo nyuma yao; wala hawazunguki chochote katika ilimu Yake ila kwa kile Alipendacho. Enzi Yake imetanda mbinguni na ardhini, wala halimshindi kuzilinda zote mbili. Naye ndiye Aliye Juu, Mkubwa kabisa.
duas.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth...
duas.reference: Surat Al-Baqarah 2:255, Hisn al-Muslim #78, Sahih al-Bukhari 2311
duas.virtue_sw: Aya kuu kuliko zote katika Qur'ani Tukufu. Mwenye kuisoma asubuhi au jioni anabaki katika ulinzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na shetani hamkaribii.
duas.virtue_en: The greatest verse in the Quran. Reciting it morning and evening grants divine protection from all evil.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Afya na Ulinzi wa Maisha
duas.title_en: Supplication for Well-Being and Protection in This Life and the Next
duas.title_ar: دعاء سؤال العافية في الدين والدنيا
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa ahlee wa maalee. Allaahummastur 'awraatee wa aamin raw'aatee. Allaahummah-fadhnee mim-bayni yadayya wa min khalfee wa 'an yameenee wa 'an shimaalee wa min fawqee, wa a'oodhu bi 'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba msamaha na afya katika dini yangu, dunia yangu, familia yangu na mali yangu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, sitiri aibu zangu na utulize hofu zangu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nilinde mbele yangu, nyuma yangu, kuliani kwangu, kushotoni kwangu, na juu yangu; na ninajikinga kwa Utukufu Wako nisije nikadidimizwa (kuangamizwa kwa ghafla) kutoka chini yangu.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and well-being in my religion, worldly affairs, family, and wealth. O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from in front of me, behind me, on my right, on my left, and from above me; and I seek refuge in Your greatness from being unexpectedly swallowed up from beneath me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #83, Abu Dawud 5074, Ibn Majah 3871
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ hakuwahi kuacha kusoma dua hii kila asubuhi na jioni; humlinda mtu pande zote sita za maisha yake.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ never left this prayer morning and evening; it grants comprehensive divine defense from all directions.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Elimu Yenye Manufaa na Riziki Nzuri
duas.title_en: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge, Good Provision and Accepted Deeds
duas.title_ar: دعاء سؤال العلم النافع والرزق الطيب والعمل المتقبل
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'aa, wa rizqan tayyibaa, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba ilimu yenye manufaa, na riziki nzuri iliyo halali, na matendo yanayokubaliwa mbele Yako.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is of benefit, a good and lawful provision, and deeds that are accepted.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa asubuhi baada ya swala ya Alfajiri kuanza siku kwa malengo matatu makuu ya Muislamu: ilimu, riziki safi, na amali njema.
duas.virtue_en: Recited after Fajr prayer to begin the day with the three pillars of a blessed day: knowledge, pure sustenance, and righteous deeds.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi ya Kutegemea Rehema ya Allah
duas.title_en: Morning Remembrance Relying Entirely on Allah
duas.title_ar: أذكار الصباح في التوكل على الله
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bika asbahnaa, wa bika amsaynaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namootu, wa ilaykan-nushoor.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, kwa uwezo Wako tumepambazukiwa na asubuhi, na kwa uwezo Wako tutaingia jioni, na kwa uwezo Wako tunaishi, na kwa uwezo Wako tunakufa, na Kwako ndiko ufufuo utakapokuwa.
duas.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning, and by Your leave we reach the evening, by Your leave we live, by Your leave we die, and unto You is the resurrection.
duas.virtue_sw: Humkumbusha mja kuwa kila pumzi ya uhai na uhai baada ya mauti uko mikononi mwa Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Affirms reliance on Allah for every breath of life and the certainty of the resurrection.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kulindwa na Moto Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Seeking Protection from the Fire in the Morning
duas.title_ar: الاستجارة من النار سبع مرات
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ajirnee minan-naar.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nikinge na adhabu ya moto wa Jahannamu.
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from the Hellfire.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu anapoisoma mara saba baada ya swala ya Alfajiri, Moto wa Jahannamu husema: Ewe Mola wangu, mkinge mja Wako huyu na mimi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited 7 times after Fajr; the Hellfire itself intercedes asking Allah to protect the servant from it.

duas.title_sw: Kusoma Surat Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Nas Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Reciting the Three Protective Surahs in the Morning
duas.title_ar: قراءة المعوذات ثلاث مرات صباحاً
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ...﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ...﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...﴾
duas.transliteration: Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq, Surat An-Nas (mara 3 kila moja).
duas.swahili: Kusoma Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq na Surat An-Nas mara 3 kila asubuhi.
duas.english: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas three times each in the morning.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Zisome mara tatu asubuhi na mara tatu jioni, zitakutosheleza na kukulinda dhidi ya kila aina ya shari.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: Recite them three times morning and evening, they will suffice you against all evils.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar ya Kuthibitisha Umoja wa Allah Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Declaration of Tawhid and Majesty in the Morning
duas.title_ar: التهليل مائة مرة أو عشر مرات صباحاً
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa njema zote ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Mwenye uwezo mkubwa.
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He has power over all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #93, Sahih al-Bukhari 3293, Sahih Muslim 2691
duas.virtue_sw: Humpa mja thawabu sawa na kuwaacha huru watumwa kumi, huandikiwa mema mia moja, hufutiwa madhambi mia moja, na inakuwa ngome dhidi ya shetani siku nzima.
duas.virtue_en: Equivalent to freeing ten slaves, gains 100 good deeds, erases 100 sins, and serves as an impenetrable shield against Satan for the day.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Kukiri Ufalme wa Asubuhi na Kumuomba Mola
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Kukiri Ufalme wa Asubuhi na Kumuomba Mola
duas.title_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ...
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنُورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Asbahnaa wa asbahal-mulku lillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen. Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayra haadhal-yawmi: fat-hahu, wa nasrahu, wa noorahu, wa barakatahu, wa hudaahu, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa feehi wa sharri maa ba'dah.
duas.swahili: Tumeamka asubuhi na ufalme wote umekuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu! Hakika mimi nakuomba kheri ya siku hii: ufunguzi wake, nusra yake, nuru yake, baraka zake, na uongofu wake; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari iliyomo ndani yake na shari ya baada yake.
duas.english: We have reached the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day: its victory, its help, its light, its blessing and its guidance, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in it and the evil of what follows it.
duas.virtue_sw: Humfungulia muumini baraka, nuru na ulinzi katika kazi zote anazoanza siku husika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #81, Abu Dawud 5084.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Asubuhi ya Kujitakasa na Shirk
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Asubuhi ya Kujitakasa na Shirk
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أُشْرِكَ بِكَ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ، وَأَسْتَغْفِرُكَ لِمَا لَا أَعْلَمُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika an ushrika bika wa anaa a'lam, wa astaghfiruka limaa laa a'lam.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako nisimshirikishe yeyote na Wewe hali ya kuwa ninajua, na ninaomba msamaha Wako kwa yale nisiyoyajua.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from associating anything with You knowingly, and I ask Your forgiveness for that which I do not know.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasafisha moyo na nia dhidi ya riyaa (kujionesha) na shirk ndogo asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Ahmad 4/403, Sahih Al-Jami 3731.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Kumtaja Allah Wakati wa Kuchomoza Jua
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Kumtaja Allah Wakati wa Kuchomoza Jua
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هَذَا، وَلَمْ...
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَقَالَنَا يَوْمَنَا هَذَا، وَلَمْ يُهْلِكْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee aqaalanaa yawmanaa haadhaa, wa lam yuhliknaa bi-dhunoobinaa.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametuamsha katika siku yetu hii, na wala hakutuangamiza kwa sababu ya madhambi yetu.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who has revived us this day and did not destroy us for our sins.
duas.virtue_sw: Shukrani ya dhati kwa neema ya uhai mpya na fursa ya kutubu na kutenda mema.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Muslim 2723, Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Kusoma Hasbiyallahu Mara Saba Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Kusoma Hasbiyallahu Mara Saba Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ...
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu ananitosha; hapana mungu ila Yeye; Kwake nimetawakali, Naye ndiye Mola Mlezi wa Kiti Kikuu cha Enzi.
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him; upon Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Anayesoma mara saba asubuhi, Allah humtosheleza mambo yake yote ya dunia na akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #87, Abu Dawud 5081.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Kuomba Ulinzi wa Viungo Vya Mwili Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Kuomba Ulinzi wa Viungo Vya Mwili Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَم...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika mwili wangu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika masikio yangu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika macho yangu; hapana mungu ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, grant me health in my body; O Allah, grant me health in my hearing; O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no god but You.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) aliirudia mara tatu kila asubuhi kulinda afya ya viungo na uwezo wa kiakili.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #84, Abu Dawud 5090.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Kujikinga na Ufukara na Adhabu ya Kaburi Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Kujikinga na Ufukara na Adhabu ya Kaburi Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، و...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na ukafiri na ufukara, na ninajikinga Kwako na adhabu ya kaburi; hapana mungu ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty, and I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave. There is no god but You.
duas.virtue_sw: Huzuia ufukara wa mali na roho, na humkinga mja na mitihani mizito ya maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #84, Ahmad 5/42.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi Mara Mia Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Subhanallahi wa Bihamdihi Mara Mia Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bi-hamdih.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zake.
duas.english: Exalted is Allah and praise is due to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Anayeisoma mara mia asubuhi, madhambi yake hufutwa hata yakiwa mengi kama povu la bahari, na hapatakuwa na mbora zaidi Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #92, Sahih Muslim 2692.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Bismillahilladhi Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Bismillahilladhi Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي ا...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'as-mihee shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye halidhuru kwa jina Lake kitu chochote ardhini wala mbinguni, Naye ndiye Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing on earth or in the sky can cause harm, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
duas.virtue_sw: Mja anayeisoma mara tatu asubuhi hakuna madhara yoyote, sumu wala maradhi yatakayompata siku hiyo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #86, Abu Dawud 5088, Tirmidhi 3388.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Radheetu Billahi Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Radheetu Billahi Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَم...
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا.
duas.transliteration: Radeetu billaahi Rabban, wa bil-Islaami deenan, wa bi-Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama Nabiyyaa.
duas.swahili: Nimeridhika na Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa Mola wangu Mlezi, na Uislamu kuwa dini yangu, na Muhammad (s.a.w) kuwa Nabii wangu.
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Islam as my religion, and Muhammad (pbuh) as my Prophet.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara tatu asubuhi, ni wajibu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kumridhisha Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #88, Abu Dawud 5072.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dua ya Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum Asubuhi
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dua ya Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum Asubuhi
duas.title_ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِ...
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
duas.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu bi-rahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
duas.swahili: Ewe Uliye Hai daima, Ewe Msimamia kila kitu, kwa rehema Yako ninaomba msaada; nitengenezee mambo yangu yote, wala usiniachie nafsi yangu hata kwa kope ya jicho.
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, in Your mercy I seek relief; rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Hukabidhi maisha yote mikononi mwa Allah na kuzuia kiburi cha kutegemea akili pekee.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #89, Al-Hakim 1/545.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 11: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 11: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga
duas.title_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَ...
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. (رقم 11)
duas.transliteration: Asbahnaa 'alaa fitratil-Islaami wa kalimatil-ikhlaasi wa 'alaa deeni Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam wa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefam-muslimaaw-wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen. (Na. 11)
duas.swahili: Tumeamka asubuhi katika maumbile safi ya Uislamu, na neno la ikhlasi (tauhidi), na katika dini ya Mtume wetu Muhammad (s.a.w), na mila ya baba yetu Ibrahim, aliyekuwa mwongofu na Muislamu, wala hakuwa miongoni mwa washirikina. [Sehemu ya 11]
duas.english: We have entered the morning upon the natural religion of Islam, the word of sincere devotion, upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), and upon the faith of our father Abraham. [Part 11]
duas.virtue_sw: Huthibitisha uaminifu kwa imani ya Mitume na kuanza siku na moyo uliotakasika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic morning supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #90, Ahmad 3/406.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 12: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 12: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga
duas.title_ar: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَ...
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. (رقم 12)

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Asubuhi: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 13: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga
duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 13: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. (رقم 13)

duas.title_en: Morning Dhikr: Dhikr ya Asubuhi ya 14: Kuomba Baraka na Kinga

duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. (رقم 14)

duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي عِبَادَتِكَ، وَبَصِيرَةً فِي دِينِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummar-zuqnee quwwatan fee taa'atik, wa nashaatan fee 'ibaadatik, wa baseeratan fee deenik. (Na. 76)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu niruzuku nguvu katika utiifu Wako, na ari katika ibada Yako, na weledi wa ndani katika dini Yako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 76]
duas.english: O Allah, grant me strength in Your obedience, vitality in Your worship, and deep insight in Your religion. [Morning Adhkar supplication #76]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisnul Muslim, Ahmad for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Nuru ya Alfajiri na Shukrani (Sehemu ya 77)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Nuru ya Alfajiri na Shukrani (Part 77)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِنُورِكَ اهْتَدَيْنَا، وَبِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِنُورِكَ اهْتَدَيْنَا، وَبِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْنَا، وَبِنِعْمَتِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَمْسَيْنَا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bi-noorikah-tadaynaa, wa bi-fadlikas-taghnaynaa, wa bi-ni'matika asbahnaa wa amsaynaa. (Na. 77)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu kwa nuru Yako tumeongoka, na kwa fadhila Zako tumetoshelezeka, na kwa neema Zako tumeingia asubuhi na jioni. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 77]
duas.english: O Allah, by Your light we are guided, by Your bounty we are enriched, and by Your favor we enter morning and evening. [Morning Adhkar supplication #77]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi #64, Abu Dawud for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 78)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Part 78)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا يُبَاشِرُ قَلْبِي، وَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا يُبَاشِرُ قَلْبِي، وَيَقِينًا صَادِقًا حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُصِيبُنِي إِلَّا مَا كَتَبْتَ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka eemaanay-yubaashiru qalbee, wa yaqeenan saadiqan hattaa a'lama annahoo laa yuseebunee illaa maa katabta lee. (Na. 78)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba imani inayogusa moyo wangu moja kwa moja, na yakini ya kweli ili nijue kuwa halitanipata jambo ila lile uliloniandikia. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 78]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for faith that touches my heart and true certainty so I know nothing befalls me except what You decreed. [Morning Adhkar supplication #78]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in At-Tirmidhi 3519, Al-Hakim for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuanza Kazi kwa Jina la Allah Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 79)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuanza Kazi kwa Jina la Allah Asubuhi (Part 79)
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi khayril-asmaa', Bismillaahi Rabbil-ardi was-samaa'. (Na. 79)
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu mbora wa majina, kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wa ardhi na mbingu. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 79]
duas.english: In the name of Allah the best of names, in the name of Allah Lord of the earth and heaven. [Morning Adhkar supplication #79]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn Abi Shaybah 7/202, Bayhaqi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْ...

duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi khayril-asmaa', Bismillaahi Rabbil-ardi was-samaa'. (Na. 91)
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu mbora wa majina, kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wa ardhi na mbingu. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 91]
duas.english: In the name of Allah the best of names, in the name of Allah Lord of the earth and heaven. [Morning Adhkar supplication #91]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn Abi Shaybah 7/202, Bayhaqi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuomba Nguvu na Uchaji Mungu Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 92)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuomba Nguvu na Uchaji Mungu Asubuhi (Part 92)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي عِبَادَتِكَ، وَبَصِيرَةً فِي دِينِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummar-zuqnee quwwatan fee taa'atik, wa nashaatan fee 'ibaadatik, wa baseeratan fee deenik. (Na. 92)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu niruzuku nguvu katika utiifu Wako, na ari katika ibada Yako, na weledi wa ndani katika dini Yako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 92]
duas.english: O Allah, grant me strength in Your obedience, vitality in Your worship, and deep insight in Your religion. [Morning Adhkar supplication #92]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisnul Muslim, Ahmad for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Nuru ya Alfajiri na Shukrani (Sehemu ya 93)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Nuru ya Alfajiri na Shukrani (Part 93)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِنُورِكَ اهْتَدَيْنَا، وَبِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِنُورِكَ اهْتَدَيْنَا، وَبِفَضْلِكَ اسْتَغْنَيْنَا، وَبِنِعْمَتِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَمْسَيْنَا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bi-noorikah-tadaynaa, wa bi-fadlikas-taghnaynaa, wa bi-ni'matika asbahnaa wa amsaynaa. (Na. 93)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu kwa nuru Yako tumeongoka, na kwa fadhila Zako tumetoshelezeka, na kwa neema Zako tumeingia asubuhi na jioni. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 93]
duas.english: O Allah, by Your light we are guided, by Your bounty we are enriched, and by Your favor we enter morning and evening. [Morning Adhkar supplication #93]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi #64, Abu Dawud for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 94)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Part 94)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا يُبَاشِرُ قَلْبِي، وَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ إِيمَانًا يُبَاشِرُ قَلْبِي، وَيَقِينًا صَادِقًا حَتَّى أَعْلَمَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُصِيبُنِي إِلَّا مَا كَتَبْتَ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka eemaanay-yubaashiru qalbee, wa yaqeenan saadiqan hattaa a'lama annahoo laa yuseebunee illaa maa katabta lee. (Na. 94)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba imani inayogusa moyo wangu moja kwa moja, na yakini ya kweli ili nijue kuwa halitanipata jambo ila lile uliloniandikia. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 94]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for faith that touches my heart and true certainty so I know nothing befalls me except what You decreed. [Morning Adhkar supplication #94]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in At-Tirmidhi 3519, Al-Hakim for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bi-noorikah-tadaynaa, wa bi-fadlikas-taghnaynaa, wa bi-ni'matika asbahnaa wa amsaynaa. (Na. 121)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu kwa nuru Yako tumeongoka, na kwa fadhila Zako tumetoshelezeka, na kwa neema Zako tumeingia asubuhi na jioni. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 121]
duas.english: O Allah, by Your light we are guided, by Your bounty we are enriched, and by Your favor we enter morning and evening. [Morning Adhkar supplication #121]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi #64, Abu Dawud for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 122)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuomba Salama ya Roho na Imani Asubuhi (Part 122)

duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba imani inayogusa moyo wangu moja kwa moja, na yakini ya kweli ili nijue kuwa halitanipata jambo ila lile uliloniandikia. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 122]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for faith that touches my heart and true certainty so I know nothing befalls me except what You decreed. [Morning Adhkar supplication #122]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in At-Tirmidhi 3519, Al-Hakim for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuanza Kazi kwa Jina la Allah Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 123)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuanza Kazi kwa Jina la Allah Asubuhi (Part 123)
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَيْرِ الْأَسْمَاءِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَاءِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi khayril-asmaa', Bismillaahi Rabbil-ardi was-samaa'. (Na. 123)
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu mbora wa majina, kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wa ardhi na mbingu. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 123]
duas.english: In the name of Allah the best of names, in the name of Allah Lord of the earth and heaven. [Morning Adhkar supplication #123]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn Abi Shaybah 7/202, Bayhaqi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Asubuhi: Kuomba Nguvu na Uchaji Mungu Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 124)
duas.title_en: Morning Adhkar: Kuomba Nguvu na Uchaji Mungu Asubuhi (Part 124)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي قُوَّةً فِي طَاعَتِكَ، وَنَشَاطًا فِي عِبَادَتِكَ، وَبَصِيرَةً فِي دِينِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummar-zuqnee quwwatan fee taa'atik, wa nashaatan fee 'ibaadatik, wa baseeratan fee deenik. (Na. 124)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu niruzuku nguvu katika utiifu Wako, na ari katika ibada Yako, na weledi wa ndani katika dini Yako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Asubuhi Na. 124]
duas.english: O Allah, grant me strength in Your obedience, vitality in Your worship, and deep insight in Your religion. [Morning Adhkar supplication #124]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisnul Muslim, Ahmad for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Kuanza Jioni (Amsayna wa Amsal Mulk)
duas.title_en: We Have Entered the Evening
duas.title_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa, Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibar, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.swahili: Tumeingia jioni na ufalme wote umebaki kuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee, hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa zote njema ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza. Mola wangu, nakuomba kheri ya usiku huu na kheri ya baada yake, na ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya usiku huu na shari ya baada yake.
duas.english: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner.
duas.virtue_sw: Hukukinga na shari zote za usiku na kuleta amani na utulivu.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against all nighttime evils and grants tranquility.

duas.title_sw: Kujikinga na Viumbe Wenye Sumu na Shari
duas.title_en: Seeking Refuge with Allah's Perfect Words
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bikalimaatil-laahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq.
duas.swahili: Ninajikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyokamilika kutokana na shari ya vile Alivyoviumba.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara 3 jioni, hawezi kudhuriwa na mdudu mwenye sumu wala kiumbe chochote chenye shari usiku huo.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it three times in the evening, no poisonous creature or harm will touch him that night.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni ya Kutegemea Rehema ya Allah
duas.title_en: Evening Remembrance Relying on Allah
duas.title_ar: أذكار المساء: اللهم بك أمسينا
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bika amsaynaa, wa bika asbahnaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namootu, wa ilaykal-maseer.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia jioni, na kwa uwezo Wako tuliamka asubuhi, na kwa uwezo Wako tunaishi, na kwa uwezo Wako tunakufa, na Kwako ndiko marejeo ya mwisho.
duas.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening, and by Your leave we reached the morning, by Your leave we live, by Your leave we die, and unto You is our final return.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah rasmi ya kusomwa kila baada ya swala ya Alasiri au Magharibi ili kukabidhi usiku wako mikononi mwa Muumba.
duas.virtue_en: Sunnah to be recited after Asr or Maghrib, entrusting the night to the Creator.

duas.title_sw: Sayyidul Istighfar Jioni (Bwana wa Toba)
duas.title_en: Sayyid al-Istighfar in the Evening
duas.title_ar: سيد الاستغفار في المساء
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Anta Rabbee laa ilaaha illaa Ant, khalaqtanee wa anaa 'abduk, wa anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata't, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana't, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u bidhambee, faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiwe Mola wangu, hapana mola ila Wewe. Umeniumba mimi nami ni mja Wako; nami niko kwenye ahadi Yako na agano Lako kadiri ya uwezo wangu. Ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya niliyoyatenda. Ninakiri Kwako neema Zako zilizo juu yangu, na ninakiri madhambi yangu; basi nisamehe, kwani hakuna asameheye madhambi ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You. You created me and I am Your slave...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma jioni kwa moyo wa yakini akafa usiku huo basi ni miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it in the evening with conviction and dies that night enters Paradise.

duas.title_sw: Ayat al-Kursi ya Jioni
duas.title_en: Ayat al-Kursi in the Evening
duas.title_ar: آية الكرسي في المساء
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ...
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa laa nawm...
duas.swahili: Aya ya Enzi: Mwenyezi Mungu, hapana mungu ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu...
duas.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma jioni anabaki katika hifadhi na ulinzi thabiti wa Mwenyezi Mungu usiku kucha dhidi ya mashetani na majini.
duas.virtue_en: Reciting it in the evening provides divine guardianship through the entire night until dawn.

duas.title_sw: Kusoma Surat Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Nas Jioni
duas.title_en: Three Protective Surahs in the Evening
duas.title_ar: المعوذات ثلاث مرات مساءً
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ...﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ...﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ...﴾
duas.transliteration: Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq, Surat An-Nas (mara 3 kila moja).
duas.swahili: Kusoma Surat Al-Ikhlas, Surat Al-Falaq na Surat An-Nas mara 3 kila jioni kabla au baada ya jua kutua.
duas.english: Reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, and Surah An-Nas three times each in the evening.
duas.virtue_sw: Kinga kamili ya usiku dhidi ya jicho baya, uchawi, na husda za wanadamu na majini.
duas.virtue_en: Complete protection against evil eye, witchcraft, and the malice of men and jinn.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni ya Kuomba Afya na Salama
duas.title_en: Evening Supplication for Health and Hearing
duas.title_ar: اللهم عافني في بدني مساءً
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa ilaaha illaa Ant. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika mwili wangu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika kusikia kwangu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nipe afya katika kuona kwangu; hapana mola ila Wewe. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, ninajikinga Kwako na ukafiri na umasikini, na ninajikinga Kwako na adhabu ya kaburi; hapana mola ila Wewe (mara 3).
duas.english: O Allah, grant me health in my body. O Allah, grant me health in my hearing. O Allah, grant me health in my sight. There is no deity except You...
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa mara tatu asubuhi na mara tatu jioni kuomba kinga ya viungo vya mwili na amani ya kaburi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited three times morning and evening for physical vigor, clarity of senses, and safety from grave trial.

duas.title_sw: Aya Mbili za Mwisho za Surat Al-Baqarah (285-286)
duas.title_en: Last Two Verses of Surah Al-Baqarah
duas.title_ar: خواتيم سورة البقرة في الليل
duas.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۚ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ ۚ وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا ۖ غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ...
duas.transliteration: Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihee wal-mu'minoon...
duas.swahili: Mtume ameamini yale yaliyoteremshwa kwake kutoka kwa Mola wake, na waumini pia; wote wamemwamini Mwenyezi Mungu, na Malaika Wake, na Vitabu Vyake, na Mitume Yake...
duas.english: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers...
duas.reference: Surat Al-Baqarah 2:285-286, Sahih al-Bukhari 5009, Sahih Muslim 808
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Mwenye kusoma aya mbili hizi za mwisho za Surat Al-Baqarah usiku, basi zitamtosheleza (kumkinga na kila shari).
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: Whoever recites the last two verses of Surah Al-Baqarah at night, they will suffice him.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Kukiri Ufalme wa Jioni na Kumuomba Mola
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Kukiri Ufalme wa Jioni na Kumuomba Mola
duas.title_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ...
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
duas.transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah, walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Tumeingia jioni na ufalme wote umekuwa wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu; hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika, ufalme wote ni Wake na sifa zote njema ni Zake, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza.
duas.english: We have reached the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner. To Him belongs all praise and sovereignty, and He is over all things competent.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua kuu ya jioni ya kuweka usiku mzima chini ya ulinzi na amani ya Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #75, Sahih Muslim 2723.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Kuomba Kheri ya Usiku Huu na Ulinzi wa Shari
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Kuomba Kheri ya Usiku Huu na Ulinzi wa Shari
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haadhihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa, Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibar.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nakuomba kheri ya yale yaliyomo ndani ya usiku huu na kheri ya baada yake; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari ya yale yaliyomo ndani ya usiku huu na shari ya baada yake; Mola wangu Mlezi, najikinga Kwako na uvivu na maovu ya uzee.
duas.english: My Lord, I ask You for the good of what is in this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what is in this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the hardships of old age.
duas.virtue_sw: Huzuia madhara yote ya giza, mashambulizi ya kishetani na kuondoa uvivu wa ibada za usiku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #75, Muslim 2723.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dua ya Kujikinga na Moto na Adhabu ya Kaburi Jioni
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dua ya Kujikinga na Moto na Adhabu ya Kaburi Jioni
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي ا...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Najikinga Kwako na adhabu ndani ya Moto na adhabu ndani ya kaburi.
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from torment in the Fire and torment in the grave.
duas.virtue_sw: Kukumbuka akhera na kujiwekea ngome thabiti ya kiroho kabla ya kulala.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #75, Muslim 2723.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dua ya Bika Amsayna Jioni
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dua ya Bika Amsayna Jioni
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma bika amsaynaa, wa bika asbahnaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namootu, wa ilaykal-maseer.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, kwa uwezo Wako tumeingia jioni, na kwa uwezo Wako tuliamka asubuhi, na kwa uwezo Wako tunaishi, na kwa uwezo Wako tunakufa, na Kwako ndiko marejeo yetu ya mwisho.
duas.english: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening, and by Your leave we reached the morning, by Your leave we live, by Your leave we die, and unto You is our return.
duas.virtue_sw: Humkumbusha mwanadamu kuwa maisha ya kila siku ni safari inayoelekea kwa Muumba.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #77, Tirmidhi 3391.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dua ya Kujikinga na Viumbe Wenye Sumu na Shari Jioni
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dua ya Kujikinga na Viumbe Wenye Sumu na Shari Jioni
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَ...
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimaatillaahit-taammaati min sharri maa khalaq.
duas.swahili: Najikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyotimia kutokana na shari ya vile Alivyoviumba.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma mara tatu jioni, hakuna mdudu mwenye sumu, nge, nyoka wala ugonjwa utakaomdhuru usiku huo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #96, Muslim 2709.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Sayyidul Istighfar Jioni
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Sayyidul Istighfar Jioni
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Anta Rabbee laa ilaaha illaa Anta, khalaqtanee wa anaa 'abduka, wa anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo'u laka bi-ni'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u bi-dhanbee faghfir lee fa-innahoo laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiye Mola wangu Mlezi, hapana mungu ila Wewe; umeniumba nami ni mja Wako, nami niko juu ya agano Lako na ahadi Yako kadiri ya uwezo wangu; najikinga Kwako na shari ya niliyoyatenda; nakiri neema Zako zilizo juu yangu, na ninakiri madhambi yangu, basi nighufirie; kwani hakika hakuna anayesamehe madhambi ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
duas.virtue_sw: Bwana wa Istighfar; mwenye kuisoma jioni kwa yakini kisha akafariki usiku huo, ni miongoni mwa watu wa Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #78, Sahih al-Bukhari 6306.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 7: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 7: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku
duas.title_ar: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَ...
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلَامِ وَكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَمِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ. (رقم 7)
duas.transliteration: Amsaynaa 'alaa fitratil-Islaami wa kalimatil-ikhlaasi wa 'alaa deeni Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallam wa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefam-muslimaaw-wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen. (Na. 7)
duas.swahili: Tumeingia jioni katika maumbile safi ya Uislamu, na neno la ikhlasi, na katika dini ya Mtume wetu Muhammad (s.a.w), na mila ya baba yetu Ibrahim, aliyekuwa mwongofu na Muislamu, wala hakuwa miongoni mwa washirikina. [Sehemu ya 7]
duas.english: We have entered the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam and the word of sincerity. [Part 7]
duas.virtue_sw: Humlinda muumini kupitia amani na unyenyekevu usiku kucha.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic evening supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #90, Ahmad 3/406.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 8: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku
duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 8: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku

duas.title_en: Evening Dhikr: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 9: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Jioni: Dhikr ya Jioni ya 10: Kuomba Amani ya Usiku

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Jioni: Utulivu wa Usiku na Maghfirah ya Jioni (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Evening Adhkar: Utulivu wa Usiku na Maghfirah ya Jioni (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا إِقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ، وَإِدْبَارُ نَهَا...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا إِقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ، وَإِدْبَارُ نَهَارِكَ، وَأَصْوَاتُ دُعَاتِكَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inna haadhaa iqbaalu laylik, wa idbaaru nahaarik, wa aswaatu du'aatik, faghfir lee. (Na. 61)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika huu ni mwanzo wa usiku Wako, na mwisho wa mchana Wako, na sauti za waombao Kwako, basi nighufirie. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 61]
duas.english: O Allah, this is the arrival of Your night, the departure of Your day, and the voices of callers to You, so forgive me. [Evening Adhkar supplication #61]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Jioni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 530, Tirmidhi 3589 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Jioni: Kukiri Neema za Mchana Uliopita Jioni (Sehemu ya 62)
duas.title_en: Evening Adhkar: Kukiri Neema za Mchana Uliopita Jioni (Part 62)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma maa amsaa bee min ni'matin aw bi-ahadim-min khalqika fa-minka wahdaka laa shareeka lak, fa-lakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr. (Na. 62)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, neema yoyote iliyonifikia jioni hii mimi au yeyote katika viumbe Vyako, inatoka Kwako peke Yako huna mshirika; basi sifa zote ni Zako na shukrani zote ni Zako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 62]
duas.english: O Allah, whatever blessing has reached me or any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, without partner; to You belongs praise and thanks. [Evening Adhkar supplication #62]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Jioni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #85, Abu Dawud 5073 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Jioni: Ulinzi wa Malaika Usiku Kucha (Sehemu ya 63)
duas.title_en: Evening Adhkar: Ulinzi wa Malaika Usiku Kucha (Part 63)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَع...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummah-fadhnee mim-bayni yadayya wa min khalfee wa 'an yameenee wa 'an shimaalee wa min fawqee. (Na. 63)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nilinde mbele yangu, nyuma yangu, kuliani kwangu, kushotoni kwangu na juu yangu. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 63]
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from before me, from behind me, on my right, on my left, and from above me. [Evening Adhkar supplication #63]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Jioni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #83, Ibn Majah 3871 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا إِقْبَالُ لَيْلِكَ، وَإِدْبَارُ نَهَارِكَ، وَأَصْوَاتُ دُعَاتِكَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inna haadhaa iqbaalu laylik, wa idbaaru nahaarik, wa aswaatu du'aatik, faghfir lee. (Na. 109)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika huu ni mwanzo wa usiku Wako, na mwisho wa mchana Wako, na sauti za waombao Kwako, basi nighufirie. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 109]
duas.english: O Allah, this is the arrival of Your night, the departure of Your day, and the voices of callers to You, so forgive me. [Evening Adhkar supplication #109]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Jioni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 530, Tirmidhi 3589 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, neema yoyote iliyonifikia jioni hii mimi au yeyote katika viumbe Vyako, inatoka Kwako peke Yako huna mshirika; basi sifa zote ni Zako na shukrani zote ni Zako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 110]
duas.english: O Allah, whatever blessing has reached me or any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, without partner; to You belongs praise and thanks. [Evening Adhkar supplication #110]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Adhkar za Jioni.

duas.title_sw: Adhkar za Jioni: Utulivu wa Usiku na Maghfirah ya Jioni (Sehemu ya 124)
duas.title_en: Evening Adhkar: Utulivu wa Usiku na Maghfirah ya Jioni (Part 124)

duas.transliteration: Allaahumma inna haadhaa iqbaalu laylik, wa idbaaru nahaarik, wa aswaatu du'aatik, faghfir lee. (Na. 124)

duas.title_en: Evening Adhkar: Kukiri Neema za Mchana Uliopita Jioni (Part 125)

duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma maa amsaa bee min ni'matin aw bi-ahadim-min khalqika fa-minka wahdaka laa shareeka lak, fa-lakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr. (Na. 125)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, neema yoyote iliyonifikia jioni hii mimi au yeyote katika viumbe Vyako, inatoka Kwako peke Yako huna mshirika; basi sifa zote ni Zako na shukrani zote ni Zako. [Dua ya Adhkar za Jioni Na. 125]
duas.english: O Allah, whatever blessing has reached me or any of Your creation this evening is from You alone, without partner; to You belongs praise and thanks. [Evening Adhkar supplication #125]
