duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kulala (Kwa Jina Lako Mola Wangu)
duas.title_en: In Your Name My Lord I Lie Down
duas.title_ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu jambee, wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfadh-haa bimaa tahfadhu bihi 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina Lako Mola wangu ninaweka ubavu wangu, na kwa ajili Yako ninaunyanyua. Ukiizuia roho yangu (nikafa usingizini) basi irehemu, na ukiirudisha basi ihifadhi kama unavyowahifadhi waja Wako wema.
duas.english: In Your name my Lord, I lie down and in Your name I arise, so if You should take my soul then have mercy upon it, and if You should return my soul then protect it in the manner You do with Your righteous servants.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #101, Sahih al-Bukhari 6320, Sahih Muslim 2714
duas.virtue_sw: Hukupa usingizi mzuri wenye amani na ulinzi wa Malaika hadi unapoamka.
duas.virtue_en: Grants peaceful sleep under angels' protection until morning.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuamka Usingizini
duas.title_en: Supplication Upon Waking Up
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametuhuisha baada ya kutufisha (kwa usingizi), na Kwake ndiyo marejeo na kufufuliwa.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us, and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #1, Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, Sahih Muslim 2711
duas.virtue_sw: Hufungua vifungo vya Shetani vilivyofungwa wakati wa kulala na kumpa mtu bashasha na wepesi wa asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Unties Satan's knots and grants an energetic, blessed start to the morning.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuamka Kutoka Usingizini
duas.title_en: Upon Waking Up from Sleep
duas.title_ar: دعاء الاستيقاظ من النوم
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee ahyaanaa ba'da maa amaatanaa wa ilayhin-nushoor.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu Aliyetufufua baada ya kutufisha (usingizini), na Kwake Yeye ndio marejeo ya ufufuo wote.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who gave us life after having taken it from us and unto Him is the resurrection.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #1, Sahih al-Bukhari 6312, Sahih Muslim 2711
duas.virtue_sw: Muislamu anayeanza siku yake kwa kumshukuru Allah huwekewa ulinzi na baraka tele katika shughuli zote za siku.
duas.virtue_en: Beginning the morning by praising Allah infuses the entire day with barakah and divine grace.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuweka Mbavu Kitandani
duas.title_en: Before Placing One's Side on the Bed
duas.title_ar: دعاء وضع الجنب على الفراش
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي، وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu jambee, wa bika arfa'uh, fa'in amsakta nafsee farhamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfadh-haa bimaa tahfadhu bihee 'ibaadakas-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Kwa Jina Lako Mola wangu ninaweka ubavu wangu, na kwa Uwezo Wako nitauinua; basi ikiwa Utaiweka roho yangu (nisiamshe) basi irehemu, na ikiwa Utairudisha basi ilinde kwa yale Unayowalinda kwayo waja Wako wema.
duas.english: In Your name my Lord, I put down my side and with Your power I raise it up. If You take my soul, have mercy on it; and if You return it, protect it as You protect Your righteous slaves.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #98, Sahih al-Bukhari 6320, Sahih Muslim 2714
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa baada ya kupukuta kitanda chako mara tatu kwa ncha ya vazi lako kabla ya kulala.
duas.virtue_en: Recited after dusting off the bed three times with the hem of one's garment before sleeping.

duas.title_sw: Tasbih ya Kabla ya Kulala (Fatima)
duas.title_en: Tasbih of Fatima Before Sleep
duas.title_ar: التسبيح والتحميد والتكبير عند النوم
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (34).
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaah (mara 33), Alhamdulillaah (mara 33), Allaahu Akbar (mara 34).
duas.swahili: Kusema: Subhaanallaah mara 33, Alhamdulillaah mara 33, na Allaahu Akbar mara 34 unapojitayarisha kulala kitandani.
duas.english: SubhanAllah 33 times, Alhamdulillah 33 times, and Allahu Akbar 34 times upon retiring to bed.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #101, Sahih al-Bukhari 3705, Sahih Muslim 2727
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alimfundisha binti yake Fatima na Ali kuwa dhikr hii huwapa nguvu na utulivu kuliko hata kuwa na mtumishi wa nyumbani.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ taught this to Fatima and Ali, stating it gives greater strength and relief than having a domestic servant.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kugeuka Usingizini Usiku
duas.title_en: When Turning Over During the Night
duas.title_ar: دعاء التقلب في الليل
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ، رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahul-Waahidul-Qahhaar, Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardhi wa maa baynahumal-'Azeezul-Ghaffaar.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu, Mmoja Pekee, Mshindi Mkuu, Mola wa mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo baina yake, Mwenye Nguvu, Mwingi wa Maghfira.
duas.english: There is no deity except Allah, the One, the Subduer, Lord of the heavens and earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa pale mtu anapogeuka ubavu mmoja kwenda mwingine usiku katikati ya usingizi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited whenever turning from one side to the other in bed during sleep.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Aliyeshtuka au Kuota Ndoto Mbaya
duas.title_en: When Startled or Having a Distressing Dream
duas.title_ar: دعاء الفزع في النوم ومن بلي بالوحشة
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bi kalimaatillaahit-taammaati min ghadhabihee wa 'iqaabih, wa sharri 'ibaadih, wa min hamazaatish-shayaateeni wa an yahdhuroon.
duas.swahili: Ninajikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyokamilika kutokana na ghadhabu Zake na adhabu Zake, na kutokana na shari ya waja Wake, na kutokana na minong'ono ya mashetani na wasije wakanikaribia.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, from the evil of His slaves, and from the whisperings of devils and from their presence.
duas.virtue_sw: Huondoa hofu ya usiku, jinamizi, na kuleta utulivu moyoni mara moja.
duas.virtue_en: Repels nightmares, fear, panic, and unwanted presence of evil spirits at night.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuamka Usiku Kuswali Tahajjud
duas.title_en: Supplication Upon Waking for Night Prayer (Tahajjud)
duas.title_ar: دعاء الاستفتاح في صلاة الليل (التهجد)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ الْحَقُّ، وَوَعْدُكَ الْحَقُّ، وَلِقَاؤُكَ حَقٌّ، وَالْجَنَّةُ حَقٌّ، وَالنَّارُ حَقٌّ...
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu Anta noorus-samaawaati wal-ardhi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamdu Anta qayyimus-samaawaati wal-ardhi wa man feehinn...
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, sifa njema zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Nuru ya mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake; na sifa njema zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Msimamizi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake; na sifa zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Haki, na ahadi Yako ni haki, na mkutano Wako ni haki, na Pepo ni haki, na Moto ni haki...
duas.english: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and the earth and whoever is within them...
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #108, Sahih al-Bukhari 1120, Sahih Muslim 769
duas.virtue_sw: Dua tukufu aliyokuwa akiisoma Mtume ﷺ anapoamka usiku kufungua swala ya Tahajjud.
duas.virtue_en: The profound opening supplication the Prophet ﷺ recited when rising for Tahajjud prayer.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwisho Kabla ya Kulala (Fitrah)
duas.title_en: Final Supplication Before Sleep (Dying upon the Fitrah)
duas.title_ar: دعاء ما يقول إذا أوى إلى فراشه وتمني الموت على الفطرة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wa fawwadtu amree ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa alja'tu dhahree ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, laa malja'a wa laa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bikitaabikal-ladhee anzalta, wa bi Nabiyyikal-ladhee arsalt.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nimeisalimisha nafsi yangu Kwako, na nimemkabidhi mambo yangu Kwako, na nimeuelekeza uso wangu Kwako, na nimeutegemeza mgongo wangu Kwako, kwa kutarajia na kwa kukuogopa Wewe; hakuna pa kukimbilia wala pa kuokokea dhidi Yako ila Kwako tu. Nimekiamini Kitabu Chako Ulichokiteremsha, na Mtume Wako Uliyemtuma.
duas.english: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affairs to You, turned my face to You, and backed myself towards You...
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #103, Sahih al-Bukhari 6311, Sahih Muslim 2710
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Yafanye haya kuwa maneno yako ya mwisho kabla ya kulala; ukifa usiku huo basi unakufa katika dini safi ya kimaumbile (Fitrah).
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: Make these your last words at night; if you die that night, you die upon the natural pure faith (Fitrah).

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Dua ya Kutawadha Kabla ya Kulala na Kulala kwa Upande wa Kulia
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Dua ya Kutawadha Kabla ya Kulala na Kulala kwa Upande wa Kulia
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wa fawwadtu amree ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa alja'tu dhahree ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, laa malja'a wa laa manjaa minka illaa ilayk, aamantu bi-kitaabikal-ladhee anzalta wa bi-Nabiyyikal-ladhee arsalt.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nimeisalimisha nafsi yangu Kwako, na nimeukabidhi mambo yangu Kwako, na nimeuelekeza uso wangu Kwako, na nimeutegemeza mgongo wangu Kwako, kwa kutumaini na kuogopa Kwako; hakuna kimbilio wala pa kuokokea kutoka Kwako ila Kwako; nimekiamini Kitabu Chako ulichokiteremsha, na Nabii Wako uliyemtuma.
duas.english: O Allah, I have submitted myself to You, entrusted my affairs to You, turned my face to You, and leaned my back against You, out of hope and fear of You. There is no refuge or salvation from You except with You. I believe in Your Book which You have revealed and in Your Prophet whom You have sent.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Ukifa usiku huo baada ya kuisoma dua hii, unakufa katika maumbile safi ya Uislamu (Fitrah).
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #104, Sahih al-Bukhari 6311.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Kusoma Ayat Al-Kursi Kabla ya Kulala
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Kusoma Ayat Al-Kursi Kabla ya Kulala
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhuu sinatuw-wa laa nawm, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ard, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahoo illaa bi-idhnih, ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum, wa laa yuheetoona bi-shay'im-min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi'a Kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ard, wa laa ya'ooduhoo hifdhuhumaa wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu, hapana mungu ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu; kusinzia hakumshiki wala kulala; ni Vyake vilivyomo mbinguni na vilivyomo ardhini...
duas.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma kabla ya kulala atakuwa na mlinzi kutoka kwa Allah, na shetani hatamkaribia hadi asubuhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #99, Sahih al-Bukhari 2311.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Kupuliza Mkononi na Kusoma Surah Tatu za Kinga Kabla ya Kulala
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Kupuliza Mkononi na Kusoma Surah Tatu za Kinga Kabla ya Kulala
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَح...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ ﴿قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ﴾، ﴿قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ﴾، ثُمَّ يَمْسَحُ بِهِمَا مَا اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Kusoma Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas na kupapasa mwili kuanzia kichwani, usoni hadi miguuni.
duas.swahili: Kukusanya viganja viwili, kupulizia kisha kusoma Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq na An-Nas, na kupapasa mwili mzima mara tatu kabla ya kulala.
duas.english: Reciting the three Qul Surahs into cupped hands and wiping the head, face and front of body three times before sleep.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya Mtume (s.a.w) kila usiku ya kuzuia ndoto mbaya, majini na maradhi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #98, Sahih al-Bukhari 5017.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Dua ya Kushtuka Kutoka Usingizini Usiku
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Dua ya Kushtuka Kutoka Usingizini Usiku
duas.title_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ ال...
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer, alhamdulillaah, wa subhaanallaah, wa laa ilaaha illallaah, wallaahu akbar, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah, Allaahummagh-fir lee.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola ila Allah Mmoja hana mshirika; ufalme ni Wake na sifa ni Zake Naye ni Muweza wa kila kitu; sifa njema ni za Allah, na ametakasika Allah, na hapana mola ila Allah, na Allah ni Mkubwa, na hakuna uwezo wala nguvu ila kwa Allah; Ewe Allah nighufirie.
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner... O Allah forgive me.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuamka usiku akasoma maneno haya kisha akaomba dua yoyote, dua yake inajibiwa; akiswali swala yake inakubaliwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #106, Sahih al-Bukhari 1154.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Dua ya Kuogopa au Kutingisika Ndani ya Usingizi
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Dua ya Kuogopa au Kutingisika Ndani ya Usingizi
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِق...
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَنْ يَحْضُرُونِ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimaatillaahit-taammaati min ghadabihee wa 'iqaabih, wa sharri 'ibaadih, wa min hamazaatish-shayaateeni wa ay-yahduroon.
duas.swahili: Najikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyotimia kutokana na ghadhabu Zake na adhabu Yake, na shari ya waja Wake, na wasiwasi wa mashetani wasije wakanikaribia.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, the evil of His servants, and from the whispers of devils and their presence.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutuliza hofu ya jinamizi, ndoto za kutisha na kushtuka usiku kwa watoto na wakubwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #108, Abu Dawud 3893, Tirmidhi 3528.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Dhikr ya Utulivu wa Usingizi 6
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Dhikr ya Utulivu wa Usingizi 6
duas.title_ar: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ ...
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu jambee wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee far-hamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfadh-haa bimaa tahfadhu bihee 'ibaadakas-saaliheen. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Kwa jina Lako Mola wangu Mlezi nimeuweka ubavu wangu na kwa uwezo Wako ninauinua; basi ukiizuia roho yangu (nisiamshe) irehemu, na ukiirudisha ilinde kama unavyowalinda waja Wako wema. [Dhikr 6]
duas.english: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side and in Your name I raise it up... [Dhikr 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga utulivu wa usingizi na kumkabidhi Mungu roho yako.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #100, Bukhari 6320.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Usingizi: Dhikr ya Utulivu wa Usingizi 7
duas.title_en: Sleep Supplication: Dhikr ya Utulivu wa Usingizi 7

duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ، فَإِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا، وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ. (رقم 37)
duas.transliteration: Bismika Rabbee wada'tu jambee wa bika arfa'uh, fa-in amsakta nafsee far-hamhaa, wa in arsaltahaa fahfadh-haa bimaa tahfadhu bihee 'ibaadakas-saaliheen. (Na. 37)
duas.swahili: Kwa jina Lako Mola wangu Mlezi nimeuweka ubavu wangu na kwa uwezo Wako ninauinua; basi ukiizuia roho yangu (nisiamshe) irehemu, na ukiirudisha ilinde kama unavyowalinda waja Wako wema. [Dhikr 37]
duas.english: In Your name, my Lord, I lay down my side and in Your name I raise it up... [Dhikr 37]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga utulivu wa usingizi na kumkabidhi Mungu roho yako.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for sleeping and waking from Hisn al-Muslim #100, Bukhari 6320.

duas.title_sw: Usingizi na Kuamka: Kusoma Duha na Utulivu wa Kitandani (Sehemu ya 51)
duas.title_en: Sleep & Waking Up: Kusoma Duha na Utulivu wa Kitandani (Part 51)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ لَا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَهْدِئْ لَيْلِي وَأَنِمْ عَيْنِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ghaaratin-nujoom, wa hada'atil-'uyoon, wa Anta Hayyun Qayyoomul-laa ta'khudhuka sinatuw-wa laa nawm, yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu ahdi' laylee wa anim 'aynee. (Na. 51)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nyota zimezama, na macho yametulia, na Wewe ndiwe Uliye Hai Msimamia kila kitu kusinzia hakukushiki wala kulala; Ewe Uliye Hai Ewe Msimamia kila kitu utulize usiku wangu na ulaze macho yangu. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 51]
duas.english: O Allah, the stars have set, eyes have rested, and You are Ever-Living and Sustaining; calm my night and give rest to my eyes. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #51]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn As-Sunni #749, Tabarani for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Usingizi na Kuamka: Dua ya Kuamka na Kupata Nuru (Sehemu ya 52)
duas.title_en: Sleep & Waking Up: Dua ya Kuamka na Kupata Nuru (Part 52)
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَعَافَانِي ...
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي رَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي، وَعَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي، وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee radda 'alayya roohee, wa 'aafaanee fee jasadee, wa adhina lee bi-dhikrih. (Na. 52)
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliyenirudishia roho yangu, na akanipa afya katika mwili wangu, na akaniruhusu kumtaja. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 52]
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who returned my soul to me, healed my body, and granted me leave to remember Him. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #52]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #2, Tirmidhi 3401 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ لَا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَهْدِئْ لَيْلِي وَأَنِمْ عَيْنِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ghaaratin-nujoom, wa hada'atil-'uyoon, wa Anta Hayyun Qayyoomul-laa ta'khudhuka sinatuw-wa laa nawm, yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu ahdi' laylee wa anim 'aynee. (Na. 99)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nyota zimezama, na macho yametulia, na Wewe ndiwe Uliye Hai Msimamia kila kitu kusinzia hakukushiki wala kulala; Ewe Uliye Hai Ewe Msimamia kila kitu utulize usiku wangu na ulaze macho yangu. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 99]
duas.english: O Allah, the stars have set, eyes have rested, and You are Ever-Living and Sustaining; calm my night and give rest to my eyes. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #99]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn As-Sunni #749, Tabarani for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee radda 'alayya roohee, wa 'aafaanee fee jasadee, wa adhina lee bi-dhikrih. (Na. 100)
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliyenirudishia roho yangu, na akanipa afya katika mwili wangu, na akaniruhusu kumtaja. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 100]
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who returned my soul to me, healed my body, and granted me leave to remember Him. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #100]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #2, Tirmidhi 3401 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee radda 'alayya roohee, wa 'aafaanee fee jasadee, wa adhina lee bi-dhikrih. (Na. 112)
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu aliyenirudishia roho yangu, na akanipa afya katika mwili wangu, na akaniruhusu kumtaja. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 112]
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who returned my soul to me, healed my body, and granted me leave to remember Him. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #112]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #2, Tirmidhi 3401 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Usingizi na Kuamka: Kusoma Duha na Utulivu wa Kitandani (Sehemu ya 113)
duas.title_en: Sleep & Waking Up: Kusoma Duha na Utulivu wa Kitandani (Part 113)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ غَارَتِ النُّجُومُ، وَهَدَأَتِ الْعُيُونُ، وَأَنْتَ حَيٌّ قَيُّومٌ لَا تَأْخُذُكَ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ أَهْدِئْ لَيْلِي وَأَنِمْ عَيْنِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ghaaratin-nujoom, wa hada'atil-'uyoon, wa Anta Hayyun Qayyoomul-laa ta'khudhuka sinatuw-wa laa nawm, yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu ahdi' laylee wa anim 'aynee. (Na. 113)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nyota zimezama, na macho yametulia, na Wewe ndiwe Uliye Hai Msimamia kila kitu kusinzia hakukushiki wala kulala; Ewe Uliye Hai Ewe Msimamia kila kitu utulize usiku wangu na ulaze macho yangu. [Dua ya Usingizi na Kuamka Na. 113]
duas.english: O Allah, the stars have set, eyes have rested, and You are Ever-Living and Sustaining; calm my night and give rest to my eyes. [Sleep & Waking Up supplication #113]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Usingizi na Kuamka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn As-Sunni #749, Tabarani for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Msikitini
duas.title_en: Supplication When Entering the Mosque
duas.title_ar: دُعَاءُ دُخُولِ الْمَسْجِدِ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaf-tah lee abwaaba rahmatik.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, nifungulie milango ya rehema Yako.
duas.english: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.virtue_sw: Huingia katika nyumba ya Mwenyezi Mungu akizungukwa na rehema na utulivu.
duas.virtue_en: Invites Allah's mercy and tranquility upon entering His house.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kutoka Msikitini
duas.title_en: Supplication When Leaving the Mosque
duas.title_ar: دُعَاءُ الْخُرُوجِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba katika fadhila Zako.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutoka akielekea kwenye riziki na baraka Zake za halali.
duas.virtue_en: Seeks lawful provisions and divine bounty upon departure.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Kutoa Salamu Katika Swala
duas.title_en: Supplication After the Prayer Salam
duas.title_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ (ثَلاَثاً)، اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإِكْرَامِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaah (mara 3). Allaahumma Antas-Salaamu wa minkas-salaamu, tabaarakta yaa Dhal-Jalaali wal-Ikraam.
duas.swahili: Ninamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha (mara 3). Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, Wewe ndiye Amani, na kutoka Kwako ndiko kunakotoka amani. Umebarikika Ewe Mwenye Utukufu na Ukarimu.
duas.english: I ask Allah for forgiveness (three times). O Allah, You are As-Salam and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, O Owner of Majesty and Honor.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah inayopendekezwa kusomwa mara moja baada ya kumaliza swala ya faradhi.
duas.virtue_en: Beloved Sunnah to be recited immediately upon finishing obligatory prayers.

duas.title_sw: Dua Kabla ya Kutawadha (Wudhu)
duas.title_en: Before Performing Ablution (Wudu)
duas.title_ar: الذكر قبل الوضوء
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #12, Abu Dawud 101, Ibn Majah 399
duas.virtue_sw: Hakuna wudhu kamili kwa yule asiyetaja jina la Mwenyezi Mungu kabla ya kuanza.
duas.virtue_en: Commencing wudu with the name of Allah completes and blesses the purification.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Kutawadha (Wudhu)
duas.title_en: Upon Completing Ablution (Wudu)
duas.title_ar: الذكر بعد الفراغ من الوضوء
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ. اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَّوَّابِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنَ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh. Allaahummaj'alnee minat-tawwaabeena waj'alnee minal-mutatahhireen.
duas.swahili: Nashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika, na nashuhudia kwamba Muhammad ni mja Wake na Mtume Wake. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nijaalie niwe miongoni mwa wanaotubu na unijaalie niwe miongoni mwa wanaojitakasa.
duas.english: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. O Allah, make me of the repentant and make me of the purified.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma hufunguliwa milango minane ya Pepo aingie kwa ule anaotaka.
duas.virtue_en: All eight gates of Paradise are opened for the one who recites it, to enter through whichever they wish.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufungua Swala (Du'a al-Istiftah)
duas.title_en: Opening Supplication of Prayer (Du'a al-Istiftah)
duas.title_ar: دعاء الاستفتاح في الصلاة
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa ta'aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni Kwako Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, limetukuka Jina Lako, na umetukuka utukufu Wako, na hapana mola mwingine apasaye kuabudiwa asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise; blessed is Your Name and exalted is Your Majesty, and there is no deity worthy of worship besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa kwa siri mara baada ya Takbiratul Ihram kabla ya kuanza kusoma Surat Al-Fatiha.
duas.virtue_en: Recited quietly after the initial Takbir before reciting Surah Al-Fatihah.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kusujudu Katika Swala
duas.title_en: Supplication in Prostration (Sujud)
duas.title_ar: دعاء السجود
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الأَعْلَى.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wangu Mlezi Aliye Juu kabisa.
duas.english: Glory is to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.virtue_sw: Mja huwa karibu zaidi na Mola wake wakati akiwa amesujudu; inashauriwa kurudia mara tatu au zaidi.
duas.virtue_en: The servant is nearest to his Lord when in prostration; recommended 3 or more times.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufungua Funga (Iftar)
duas.title_en: Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
duas.title_ar: دعاء الصائم عند إفطاره
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u, wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Kiu kimeondoka, na mishipa imelowa maji, na ujira umethibiti akipenda Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa papo hapo unapofungua funga; dua ya mfungaji wakati wa kufuturu hairejeshwi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited when breaking fast; the supplication of the fasting person is readily accepted.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Sala ya Istikharah (Kutafuta Mwongozo)
duas.title_en: Supplication of Istikharah (Seeking Guidance)
duas.title_ar: دعاء صلاة الاستخارة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ، وَأَسْتَقْدِرُكَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ الْعَظِيمِ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْدِرُ وَلاَ أَقْدِرُ، وَتَعْلَمُ وَلاَ أَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلاَّمُ الْغُيُوبِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee astakheeruka bi'ilmika, wa astaqdiruka biqudratika, wa as'aluka min fadhlikal-'Adheem, fa'innaka taqdiru wa laa aqdir, wa ta'lamu wa laa a'lam, wa Anta 'Allaamul-ghuyoob.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nakuomba unichagulie kwa ilimu Yako, na nakuomba uniwezeshe kwa uwezo Wako, na nakuomba katika fadhila Zako kuu, kwani Wewe Unaweza nami siwezi, na Wewe Unajua nami sijui, na Wewe ni Mjuzi wa yaliyofichika.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek Your counsel through Your knowledge, and I seek ability through Your power, and I ask of Your great favor. For You are capable and I am not, and You know and I do not, and You are the Knower of the unseen.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ aliwafundisha masahaba kusali rakaa mbili na kusoma dua hii wakati wowote mtu anapokusudia kufanya uamuzi au jambo muhimu maishani.
duas.virtue_en: Sunnah for making decisions, seeking divine guidance in all worldly and religious matters.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kusikia Adhana
duas.title_en: During and Upon Hearing the Call to Prayer (Adhan)
duas.title_ar: الذكر عند سماع الأذان
duas.arabic: وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ، رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً، وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا.
duas.transliteration: Wa anaa ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh, radheetu billaahi Rabbaa, wa bi Muhammadin Rasoolaa, wa bil-Islaami deenaa.
duas.swahili: Nami pia ninashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika, na kwamba Muhammad ni mja Wake na Mtume Wake. Nimeridhika na Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa Mola wangu, na Muhammad kuwa Mtume wangu, na Uislamu kuwa dini yangu.
duas.english: And I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, Muhammad as Messenger, and Islam as my religion.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma baada ya muadhini kutoa shahada anasamehewa madhambi yake yaliyotangulia.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it after hearing the Muadhin's shahada has their previous sins forgiven.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Adhana
duas.title_en: Supplication After the Call to Prayer (Adhan)
duas.title_ar: الدعاء بعد الأذان وسؤال الوسيلة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabba haadhihid-da'watit-taammah, was-salaatil-qaa'imah, aati Muhammadanil-waseelata wal-fadheelah, wab'ath-hu maqaamam-mahmoodanil-ladhee wa'adtah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wa wito huu uliokamilika, na swala hii iliyosimama, mpe Mtume Muhammad daraja ya juu ya Al-Wasilah na fadhila, na umfufue katika cheo chenye kusifiwa Ulichomuahidi.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and favor, and raise him to the praised station which You have promised him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kusoma dua hii baada ya adhana atastahiki kupata uombezi (shafaa) wa Mtume Muhammad ﷺ Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it after the call to prayer earns the intercession of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ on the Day of Judgment.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kwenda Msikitini
duas.title_en: Supplication on the Way to the Mosque
duas.title_ar: دعاء الذهاب إلى المسجد
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ أَمَامِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْ فِي نَفْسِي نُورًا، وَأَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj'al fee qalbee nooraa, wa fee lisaanee nooraa, wa fee sam'ee nooraa, wa fee basaree nooraa, wa min fawqee nooraa, wa min tahtee nooraa, wa 'an yameenee nooraa, wa 'an shimaalee nooraa, wa min amaamee nooraa, wa min khalfee nooraa, waj'al fee nafsee nooraa, wa a'dhim lee nooraa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, weka nuru moyoni mwangu, na katika ulimi wangu nuru, na katika masikio yangu nuru, na katika macho yangu nuru, na juu yangu nuru, na chini yangu nuru, na kuliani kwangu nuru, na kushotoni kwangu nuru, na mbele yangu nuru, na nyuma yangu nuru; na unijalie nuru ndani ya nafsi yangu, na uniongezee nuru kuu.
duas.english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light above me, light below me, light on my right, light on my left, light in front of me, light behind me, and make light within myself, and magnify for me light.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #19, Sahih al-Bukhari 6316, Sahih Muslim 763
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya nuru inayofanya safari ya kwenda msikitini kuwa yenye baraka za kiroho na usafi wa ndani.
duas.virtue_en: Invokes divine illumination surrounding the believer completely on the way to worship.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Rukuu Katika Swala
duas.title_en: Supplication in Bowing (Ruku')
duas.title_ar: دعاء الركوع
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni kwa Mola wangu Aliye Mkuu kabisa.
duas.english: Glory is to my Lord, the Most Great.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah muakkadah kusoma mara 3 au zaidi ukiwa umerukuu kwa unyenyekevu.
duas.virtue_en: Recited 3 times or more during bowing, exalting the magnificence of Allah.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuinuka Kutoka Rukuu
duas.title_en: Upon Rising from Bowing (Ruku')
duas.title_ar: دعاء الرفع من الركوع
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamd, hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubaarakan feeh.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi, sifa njema zote ni Zako, sifa nyingi, zilizo nzuri na zenye baraka tele ndani yake.
duas.english: Our Lord, to You is praise, an abundant, beautiful, and blessed praise.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu mmoja alipoisoma nyuma ya Mtume ﷺ, Mtume alisema: Niliona malaika zaidi ya thelathini wakikimbilia kuwahi kuiandika mara moja.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ saw over thirty angels racing each other to record this prayer first.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kukaa Kati ya Sijda Mbili
duas.title_en: Between the Two Prostrations
duas.title_ar: الدعاء بين السجدتين
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَاجْبُرْنِي، وَعَافِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَارْفَعْنِي.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee, Rabbighfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, wa 'aafinee, warzuqnee, warfa'nee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu nisamehe, Mola wangu nisamehe, na unirehemu, na uniongoze, na unifariji/unizibie mapungufu yangu, na unipe afya, na uniruzuku, na uniinue daraja.
duas.english: My Lord forgive me, my Lord forgive me, have mercy on me, guide me, patch my broken state, grant me health, provide for me, and elevate me.
duas.virtue_sw: Kukaa kwa utulivu kati ya sijda mbili na kuomba maghfira na afya ni nguzo muhimu ya khushuu.
duas.virtue_en: A beautiful comprehensive prayer uniting forgiveness, mercy, health, sustenance, and elevation.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Sujud at-Tilawah (Kusujudu Kusoma Quran)
duas.title_en: Supplication for Prostration of Recitation (Sujud al-Tilawah)
duas.title_ar: دعاء سجود التلاوة
duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lilladhee khalaqahu, wa shaqqa sam'ahu wa basarahu, bihawlihee wa quwwatih, fatabaarakallaahu ahsanul-khaaliqeen.
duas.swahili: Uso wangu umemsujudia Yule Aliyeuumba, na akaupasulia masikio yake na macho yake, kwa uwezo Wake na nguvu Zake; basi Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu, Mbora wa waumbaji wote.
duas.english: My face has prostrated to the One Who created it and brought forth its hearing and sight by His might and power; blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa unaposoma au kusikia aya yenye alama ya sijda katika Qur'ani Tukufu.
duas.virtue_en: Recited whenever encountering a verse of prostration while reciting or listening to the Quran.

duas.title_sw: Tashahhud Kamili ya Swala (Attahiyyaat)
duas.title_en: The Complete Tashahhud (Attahiyyat)
duas.title_ar: التشهد في الصلاة
duas.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ، وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ.
duas.transliteration: At-tahiyyaatu lillaahi was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaat, as-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh, as-salaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhu wa Rasooluh.
duas.swahili: Heshima zote, na swala zote, na vizuri vyote ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu. Amani ishuke juu yako ewe Mtume, na rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu na baraka Zake. Amani ishuke juu yetu na juu ya waja wema wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Nashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu, na nashuhudia kwamba Muhammad ni mja Wake na Mtume Wake.
duas.english: All greetings, prayers, and good words are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings...
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #51, Sahih al-Bukhari 831, Sahih Muslim 402
duas.virtue_sw: Nguzo ya msingi ya swala inayosomwa wakati wa kukaa baada ya rakaa ya pili na ya mwisho.
duas.virtue_en: Obligatory pillar of prayer recited during sitting in the middle and final rak'ahs.

duas.title_sw: Salawat Ibrahimiya (Kumsalia Mtume Katika Swala)
duas.title_en: Salawat Ibrahimiyyah (Blessings Upon the Prophet)
duas.title_ar: الصلاة على النبي بعد التشهد
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheem, innaka Hameedum-Majeed.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, mteremshie rehema Mtume Muhammad na jamaa zake Mtume Muhammad, kama Ulivyomteremshia rehema Mtume Ibrahim na jamaa zake Mtume Ibrahim; hakika Wewe ni Mwenye kusifiwa, Mtukufu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, mbariki Mtume Muhammad na jamaa zake Mtume Muhammad, kama Ulivyombariki Mtume Ibrahim na jamaa zake Mtume Ibrahim; hakika Wewe ni Mwenye kusifiwa, Mtukufu.
duas.english: O Allah, bestow Your favor on Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You bestowed favor on Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim...
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #53, Sahih al-Bukhari 3370, Sahih Muslim 406
duas.virtue_sw: Njia bora na tukufu zaidi ya kumsalia Mtume Muhammad ﷺ iliyofundishwa na yeye mwenyewe.
duas.virtue_en: The most revered and authentic form of invoking blessings on the Prophet ﷺ.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Tashahhud ya Mwisho Kabla ya Salamu
duas.title_en: After Final Tashahhud Before the Taslim (Seeking Refuge from 4 Evils)
duas.title_ar: الدعاء بعد التشهد الأخير وقبل السلام (التعوذ من أربع)
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabr, wa min 'adhaabi jahannam, wa min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Maseehid-Dajjaal.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako na adhabu ya kaburi, na adhabu ya Jahannamu, na fitina za uhai na kifo, na shari ya fitina ya Masihi Dajjal (Mpinga Kristo).
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave, from the punishment of Hellfire, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #55, Sahih al-Bukhari 1377, Sahih Muslim 588
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisisitiza sana kuisoma dua hii kabla ya kutoa salamu kwenye swala; inakinga na majanga makuu manne.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ commanded seeking refuge from these four major calamities before the final Salam.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qunut Katika Swala ya Witr
duas.title_en: Supplication of Qunut in the Witr Prayer
duas.title_ar: دعاء القنوت في صلاة الوتر
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي فِيمَنْ هَدَيْتَ، وَعَافِنِي فِيمَنْ عَافَيْتَ، وَتَوَلَّنِي فِيمَنْ تَوَلَّيْتَ، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَقِنِي شَرَّ مَا قَضَيْتَ، فَإِنَّكَ تَقْضِي وَلاَ يُقْضَى عَلَيْكَ، إِنَّهُ لاَ يَذِلُّ مَنْ وَالَيْتَ، وَلاَ يَعِزُّ مَنْ عَادَيْتَ، تَبَارَكْتَ رَبَّنَا وَتَعَالَيْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummahdinee feeman hadayt, wa 'aafinee feeman 'aafayt, wa tawallanee feeman tawallayt, wa baarik lee feemaa a'tayt, wa qinee sharra maa qadhayt, fa'innaka taqdhee wa laa yuqdhaa 'alayk, innahu laa yadhillu maw-waalayt, wa laa ya'izzu man 'aadayt, tabaarakta Rabbanaa wa ta'aalayt.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, niongoze miongoni mwa Uliowaongoza, na unipe afya miongoni mwa Uliowapa afya, na unisimamie miongoni mwa Uliowasimamia, na unibariki katika vile Ulivyonipa, na unikinge na shari ya Uliyoyahukumu; kwani Wewe ndiye Unayehukumu wala Huhukumiwi, hakika hadhaliliki yule Uliyemfanya rafiki, wala hawi na utukufu yule Uliyemfanya adui; umetukuka Mola wetu na umetukuka Juu kabisa.
duas.english: O Allah, guide me among those You have guided, pardon me among those You have pardoned, turn to me in friendship among those on whom You have turned in friendship...
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Qunut iliyofundishwa na Mtume ﷺ kwa mjukuu wake Al-Hasan kwa ajili ya kumalizia swala ya usiku ya Witr.
duas.virtue_en: Taught by the Prophet ﷺ to his grandson Al-Hasan for the conclusion of the Witr night prayer.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Kuingia Msikitini
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Kuingia Msikitini
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, was-salaatu was-salaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah, Allaahummaf-tah lee abwaaba rahmatik.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, na rehema na amani ziwe juu ya Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nifungulie milango ya rehema Zako.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and prayers and peace be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kuingia msikitini kwa mguu wa kulia ili kupata rehema za Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #20, Muslim 713.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Kutoka Msikitini
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Kutoka Msikitini
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اعْصِمْنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, was-salaatu was-salaamu 'alaa Rasoolillaah, Allaahumma innee as'aluka min fadlik, Allaahumma'simnee minash-shaytaanir-rajeem.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, na rehema na amani ziwe juu ya Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba katika fadhila Zako; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nikinge na shetani aliyetokomezwa mbali.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah. O Allah, I ask You from Your bounty; O Allah, protect me from Satan the outcast.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kutoka msikitini kwa mguu wa kushoto ili kulindwa dhidi ya mitego ya kidunia.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #21, Ibn Majah 773.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Kuitikia Adhana
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Kuitikia Adhana
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاة...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabba haadhihid-da'watit-taammah, was-salaatil-qaa'imah, aati Muhammadanil-waseelata wal-fadeelah, wab'ath-hu maqaamam-mahmoodanil-ladhee wa'adtah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa mwito huu uliotimia, na Swala hii iliyosimama; mpe Muhammad daraja ya juu (Wasilah) na fadhila, na mmfikishe cheo kinachosifiwa ulichomwahidi.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and established prayer, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and virtue, and raise him to the praised station which You promised him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma baada ya adhana anastahiki maombezi (Shafa'ah) ya Mtume Muhammad (s.a.w) Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #26, Sahih al-Bukhari 614.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Istiftah (Kufungulia Swala)
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Istiftah (Kufungulia Swala)
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، وَتَبَارَكَ اسْمُكَ، وَتَعَالَى جَدُّكَ، وَلَا إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bi-hamdika, wa tabaarakas-muka, wa ta'aalaa jadduka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruk.
duas.swahili: Umetakasika Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, na limetukuka Jina Lako, na umetukuka Utukufu Wako, na hapana mungu mwingine asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your name, exalted is Your majesty, and there is no god other than You.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa mwanzoni mwa swala baada ya Takbiratul-Ihram kabla ya kusoma Al-Fatihah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #28, Abu Dawud 776.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Rukuu: Subhana Rabbiyal-Adheem
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Rukuu: Subhana Rabbiyal-Adheem
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wangu Mlezi Aliye Mtukufu.
duas.english: Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa mara tatu au zaidi wakati wa kurukuu kumtukuza Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #33, Muslim 772.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Kuinuka Kutoka Kwenye Rukuu
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Kuinuka Kutoka Kwenye Rukuu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ، حَمْدًا كَثِيرًا طَيِّبًا مُبَارَكًا فِيهِ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa lakal-hamdu, hamdan katheeran tayyibam-mubaarakan feeh.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi, sifa njema zote ni Zako, sifa nyingi nzuri zilizobarikiwa ndani yake.
duas.english: Our Lord, to You belongs all praise, an abundant, good and blessed praise.
duas.virtue_sw: Swahaba alipoisoma katika swala, Mtume alisema zaidi ya malaika thelathini walikimbizana nani wa kwanza kuandika thawabu zake.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #36, Sahih al-Bukhari 799.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى.
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ الْأَعْلَى.
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbiyal-A'laa.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wangu Mlezi Aliye Juu kabisa.
duas.english: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High.
duas.virtue_sw: Wakati wa kusujudu mja anakuwa karibu zaidi na Mola wake Mlezi; inafaa kuomba dua nyingi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #40, Muslim 772.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua Kati ya Sajda Mbili
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua Kati ya Sajda Mbili
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِن...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي، وَارْحَمْنِي، وَاهْدِنِي، وَارْزُقْنِي، وَعَافِنِي.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee, Rabbighfir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee, wa 'aafinee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi nighufirie, Mola wangu Mlezi nighufirie; na unirehemu, na uniongoze, na uniruzuku, na unipe afya.
duas.english: My Lord forgive me, my Lord forgive me, and have mercy on me, guide me, provide for me, and grant me health.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa unapokaa kati ya sajda ya kwanza na ya pili; inakusanya maghfirah, mwongozo na afya.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #46, Abu Dawud 850.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya At-Tahiyyat (Tashahhud)
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya At-Tahiyyat (Tashahhud)
duas.title_ar: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّل...
duas.arabic: التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ وَالصَّلَوَاتُ وَالطَّيِّبَاتُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ، السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ.
duas.transliteration: At-tahiyyaatu lillaahi was-salawaatu wat-tayyibaat, as-salaamu 'alayka ayyuhan-Nabiyyu wa rahmatullaahi wa barakaatuh, as-salaamu 'alaynaa wa 'alaa 'ibaadillaahis-saaliheen, ash-hadu allaa ilaaha illallaahu wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan 'abduhoo wa Rasooluh.
duas.swahili: Maamkizi yote, na swala zote, na mambo yote mazuri ni ya Mwenyezi Mungu. Amani iwe juu yako ewe Nabii, na rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu na baraka Zake. Amani iwe juu yetu na juu ya waja wema wa Mwenyezi Mungu. Ninashuhudia kwamba hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu na ninashuhudia kwamba Muhammad ni mja Wake na Mtume Wake.
duas.english: All greetings, prayers and pure words are for Allah. Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings...
duas.virtue_sw: Tashahhud ya wajibu katika kila kikao cha swala.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #51, Sahih al-Bukhari 831.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dua ya Baada ya Tashahhud Kabla ya Kutoa Salamu
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dua ya Baada ya Tashahhud Kabla ya Kutoa Salamu
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ، وَمِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ، وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabi jahannama, wa min 'adhaabil-qabr, wa min fitnatil-mahyaa wal-mamaat, wa min sharri fitnatil-Maseehid-Dajjaal.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na adhabu ya Jahannamu, na adhabu ya kaburi, na fitna za uhai na mauti, na shari ya fitna ya Masih Dajjal.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the torment of Hell, from the torment of the grave, from the trials of life and death, and from the evil trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) aliwaamuru Maswahaba kusoma dua hii kabla ya kutoa salamu mwisho wa kila swala.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #55, Sahih Muslim 588.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Swala: Dhikr ya Swala na Msikiti 11
duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dhikr ya Swala na Msikiti 11
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِب...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَى ذِكْرِكَ، وَشُكْرِكَ، وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ. أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ. (رقم 11)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma a'innee 'alaa dhikrika, wa shukrika, wa husni 'ibaadatik. Astaghfirullaah, Astaghfirullaah, Astaghfirullaah. (Na. 11)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nisaidie juu ya kukutaja Wewe, na kukushukuru Wewe, na kufanya vizuri ibada Yako. Namwomba Mungu msamaha, namwomba Mungu msamaha, namwomba Mungu msamaha. [Swala Dhikr 11]
duas.english: O Allah, help me remember You, thank You, and worship You in the best manner. [Prayer Remembrance 11]
duas.virtue_sw: Husaidia kuomba unyenyekevu na uthabiti katika kuswali mara tano kila siku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for prayer and mosque from Hisn al-Muslim #66, Abu Dawud 1522.

duas.title_en: Prayer Dhikr: Dhikr ya Swala na Msikiti 12

duas.title_sw: Swala na Msikiti: Dua ya Tahajjud na Qiyam al-Layl (Sehemu ya 91)
duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Tahajjud na Qiyam al-Layl (Part 91)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu Anta noorus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamdu Anta Qayyimus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn. (Na. 91)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu sifa njema zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Nuru ya mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake; na sifa zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Msimamizi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 91]
duas.english: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and earth and all within them... [Prayer & Mosque supplication #91]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #27, Sahih al-Bukhari 1120 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Swala na Msikiti: Dua ya Khushu ndani ya Swala (Sehemu ya 92)
duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Khushu ndani ya Swala (Part 92)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَم...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min qalbil-laa yakhsha', wa min du'aa'il-laa yusma', wa min nafsil-laa tashba', wa min 'ilmil-laa yanfa'. (Na. 92)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu najikinga Kwako na moyo usionyenyekea, na dua isiyosikilizwa, na nafsi isiyoshiba, na ilimu isiyo na manufaa. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 92]
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not humble itself, a prayer that is not heard, a soul that is never satisfied, and knowledge that does not benefit. [Prayer & Mosque supplication #92]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Sahih Muslim 2722, Tirmidhi 3482 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Swala na Msikiti: Dua ya Sajda ya Tilawah (Sehemu ya 93)
duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Sajda ya Tilawah (Part 93)
duas.title_ar: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَه...

duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhee lil-ladhee khalaqahoo, wa shaqqa sam'ahoo wa basarahoo, bi-hawlihee wa quwwatih, fatabaarakallaahu ahsanul-khaaliqeen. (Na. 120)
duas.swahili: Uso wangu umemsujudia Yule aliyeumba, na akafungua masikio yake na macho yake, kwa uwezo Wake na nguvu Zake; basi Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu Mbora wa waumbaji wote. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 120]
duas.english: My face has prostrated to Him Who created it... [Prayer & Mosque supplication #120]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #47, Tirmidhi 580 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu Anta noorus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamdu Anta Qayyimus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn. (Na. 121)

duas.english: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and earth and all within them... [Prayer & Mosque supplication #121]

duas.arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِي لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ، بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، فَتَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Sajada wajhee lil-ladhee khalaqahoo, wa shaqqa sam'ahoo wa basarahoo, bi-hawlihee wa quwwatih, fatabaarakallaahu ahsanul-khaaliqeen. (Na. 174)
duas.swahili: Uso wangu umemsujudia Yule aliyeumba, na akafungua masikio yake na macho yake, kwa uwezo Wake na nguvu Zake; basi Ametukuka Mwenyezi Mungu Mbora wa waumbaji wote. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 174]
duas.english: My face has prostrated to Him Who created it... [Prayer & Mosque supplication #174]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #47, Tirmidhi 580 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Swala na Msikiti: Dua ya Tahajjud na Qiyam al-Layl (Sehemu ya 175)
duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Tahajjud na Qiyam al-Layl (Part 175)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ نُورُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ، وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ قَيِّمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَنْ فِيهِنَّ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu Anta noorus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn, wa lakal-hamdu Anta Qayyimus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa man feehinn. (Na. 175)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu sifa njema zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Nuru ya mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake; na sifa zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiwe Msimamizi wa mbingu na ardhi na vilivyomo ndani yake. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 175]
duas.english: O Allah, to You belongs all praise, You are the Light of the heavens and earth and all within them... [Prayer & Mosque supplication #175]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #27, Sahih al-Bukhari 1120 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Swala na Msikiti: Dua ya Khushu ndani ya Swala (Sehemu ya 176)
duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Khushu ndani ya Swala (Part 176)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَم...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ قَلْبٍ لَا يَخْشَعُ، وَمِنْ دُعَاءٍ لَا يُسْمَعُ، وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لَا تَشْبَعُ، وَمِنْ عِلْمٍ لَا يَنْفَعُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min qalbil-laa yakhsha', wa min du'aa'il-laa yusma', wa min nafsil-laa tashba', wa min 'ilmil-laa yanfa'. (Na. 176)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu najikinga Kwako na moyo usionyenyekea, na dua isiyosikilizwa, na nafsi isiyoshiba, na ilimu isiyo na manufaa. [Dua ya Swala na Msikiti Na. 176]
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a heart that does not humble itself, a prayer that is not heard, a soul that is never satisfied, and knowledge that does not benefit. [Prayer & Mosque supplication #176]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Swala na Msikiti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Sahih Muslim 2722, Tirmidhi 3482 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_en: Prayer & Mosque: Dua ya Khushu ndani ya Swala (Part 179)
