duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Yunus Wakati wa Shida (Dhun-Noon)
duas.title_en: Supplication of Prophet Yunus (In Distress)
duas.title_ar: دُعَاءُ ذِي النُّونِ فِي بَطْنِ الْحُوتِ
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minadh-dhaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe, kutakasika ni Kwako; hakika mimi nilikuwa miongoni mwa waliodhulumu nafsi zao.
duas.english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ amesema: 'Muislamu yeyote atakayemuomba Mola wake kwa dua hii katika jambo lolote lile, basi Mwenyezi Mungu atamjibu na kumuondolea shida hiyo.'
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'No Muslim suppliant ever prays with these words for anything, but Allah will answer him.'

duas.title_sw: Kuondosha Huzuni, Hamu na Madeni
duas.title_en: Supplication Against Worry, Grief and Debt
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako kutokana na hamu na huzuni, na kutoweza na uvivu, na ubakhili na uoga, na kuelemewa na madeni na kudhulumiwa au kushindwa na watu.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men.
duas.virtue_sw: Humuondolea muislamu msongo wa mawazo, uzito wa madeni na kumpa nguvu ya kupambana na maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Relieves anxiety, heavy debts, and restores emotional and spiritual strength.

duas.title_sw: Mtegemeo Kamili (Hasbunallahu wa Ni'mal Wakeel)
duas.title_en: Allah is Sufficient for Us
duas.title_ar: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
duas.arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ.
duas.transliteration: Hasbunallaahu wa ni'mal-wakeel.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu anatutosha, Naye ndiye Msimamizi bora zaidi.
duas.english: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #126, Sahih al-Bukhari 4563, Surat Aal-Imran 3:173
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyoisoma Nabii Ibrahim alipotupwa motoni, na aliyoisoma Nabii Muhammad ﷺ pale maadui walipokusanyika dhidi yake.
duas.virtue_en: The supplication of Prophet Ibrahim when cast into fire, and Prophet Muhammad ﷺ against enemies.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumtembelea Mgonjwa
duas.title_en: Visiting the Sick
duas.title_ar: دعاء عيادة المريض
duas.arabic: لاَ بَأْسَ، طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ba'sa, tahoorun in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Hapana neno, ni kutakasika (kwa madhambi) Mwenyezi Mungu akipenda.
duas.english: Do not worry, it is a purification, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaleta matumaini, faraja na uponyaji wa kisaikolojia kwa mgonjwa, ikimkumbusha kuwa maradhi ni kafara ya madhambi.
duas.virtue_en: Comforts the ill person, reassuring that illness purifies one from sins.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Maumivu Mwilini
duas.title_en: For Pain in the Body
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أحس بوجع في جسده
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (mara 3)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (mara 7).
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah (mara 3). A'oodhu billaahi wa qudratihi min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir (mara 7).
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 3). Ninajikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na kwa uwezo Wake kutokana na shari ya ninachokihisi na ninachokiogopa (mara 7).
duas.english: In the name of Allah (3 times). I seek refuge with Allah and His power from the evil that I feel and fear (7 times).
duas.virtue_sw: Weka mkono wako kwenye sehemu inayouma ya mwili wako na useme Bismillah mara 3, kisha usome dua hii mara 7 kwa imani kamili ya kuponywa.
duas.virtue_en: Place your hand on the spot that hurts and recite with firm faith for physical healing.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuondokewa na Hasira
duas.title_en: When Feeling Angry
duas.title_ar: دعاء الغضب
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem.
duas.swahili: Ninajikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kutokana na shetani aliyetupwa mbali na rehema Yake.
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #137, Sahih al-Bukhari 6115, Sahih Muslim 2610
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Najua neno ambalo mtu akilisema hasira zake zitaondoka, nalo ni: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem.
duas.virtue_en: Extinguishes rage and suppresses the whisperings of Satan during anger.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Deni na Shida ya Kifedha
duas.title_en: Relief from Debt and Financial Hardship
duas.title_ar: دعاء قضاء الدين
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummakfinee bihalaalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bifadhlika 'amman siwaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nitosheleze kwa vilivyo halali Vyako nisihitaji vilivyo haramu Vyako, na unitajirishe kwa fadhila Zako nisiwe na haja na yeyote asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful against what is unlawful, and enrich me by Your grace from all besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Ali alisema: Hata kama ungedaiwa deni zito kama mlima Uhud, Mwenyezi Mungu atakukidhia ukisoma dua hii.
duas.virtue_en: Even if your debts were as heavy as Mount Uhud, Allah will facilitate settling them.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuondolewa Ugumu Katika Jambo Lolote
duas.title_en: When Facing Any Difficult Affair
duas.title_ar: دعاء من استصعب عليه أمر
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahla illaa maa ja'altahoo sahlaa, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna idhaa shi'ta sahlaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakuna jambo rahisi ila lile Ulilolifanya Wewe kuwa rahisi, na Wewe unalifanya jambo gumu kuwa jepesi Ukitaka.
duas.english: O Allah, nothing is easy except what You make easy, and You make hardship easy if You will.
duas.virtue_sw: Inarahisisha mitihani, masomo, kazi ngumu na changamoto zote za maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Eases examinations, stressful tasks, and complicated life hurdles.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Msiba na Huzuni Kubwa
duas.title_en: When Afflicted by Calamity or Loss
duas.title_ar: دعاء المصيبة
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا.
duas.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon, Allaahumma'jurnee fee museebatee, wakhluf lee khayram-minhaa.
duas.swahili: Hakika sisi ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu, na hakika sisi Kwake tutarejea. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nilipe ujira katika msiba wangu huu, na unibadilishie kitu kilicho bora zaidi kuliko hiki nilichokipoteza.
duas.english: Indeed to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
duas.virtue_sw: Muislamu anayeisoma dua hii wakati wa msiba hulipwa thawabu na kupewa mbadala ulio bora zaidi duniani na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Brings immediate divine solace and replaces the loss with something far better.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Hofu na Mashaka ya Adui au Mtawala
duas.title_en: When Fearing an Enemy, Ruler or Oppressor
duas.title_ar: دعاء لقاء العدو وذي السلطان
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَجْعَلُكَ فِي نُحُورِهِمْ، وَنَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرُورِهِمْ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innaa naj'aluka fee nuhoorihim, wa na'oodhu bika min shuroorihim.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika sisi tunakuweka Wewe mbele ya shingo zao (ili Ututosheleze nao), na tunajikinga Kwako kutokana na shari zao.
duas.english: O Allah, we place You before them and we seek refuge in You from their wickedness.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ aliisoma dua hii wakati wowote alipohofia shambulizi au njama kutoka kwa maadui.
duas.virtue_en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ whenever fearing hostility or aggression from adversaries.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumwondolea Mtu Mkanganyiko na Shida Kubwa
duas.title_en: In Distress: Calling Upon the Ever-Living, Self-Subsisting
duas.title_ar: دعاء الكرب: يا حي يا قيوم برحمتك أستغيث
duas.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
duas.transliteration: Yaa Hayyu Yaa Qayyoomu bi rahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha'nee kullah, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
duas.swahili: Ewe Uliye Hai daima, Ewe Msimamia kila kitu, kwa rehema Yako ninaomba msaada; nitengenezee mambo yangu yote, wala usiniachie nafsi yangu mwenyewe hata kwa kiasi cha kufumba na kufumbua jicho.
duas.english: O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting, by Your mercy I seek assistance; rectify for me all of my affairs, and do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua kuu ya kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu kuingilia kati na kutatua changamoto zote za maisha bila kutegemea nguvu za kibinadamu.
duas.virtue_en: Directly appeals to Allah's greatest attributes to rectify all aspects of life without self-reliance.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ruqyah ya Kujikinga na Kijicho (Husda) na Sumu
duas.title_en: Ruqyah for Protection Against Evil Eye, Envy and Harm
duas.title_ar: التعويذ للأولاد والرقية الشرعية من العين
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكَ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لاَمَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: U'eedhuka bi kalimaatillaahit-taammah, min kulli shaytaanin wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynin laammah.
duas.swahili: Ninakukinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyokamilika, kutokana na kila shetani na kila mdudu mwenye sumu, na kutokana na kila jicho baya lenye kudhuru.
duas.english: I seek protection for you in the perfect words of Allah, from every devil and poisonous reptile, and from every harmful envious eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyokuwa akiwasomea Mtume ﷺ wajukuu zake Al-Hasan na Al-Husayn; kinga bora kwa watoto na watu wazima.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ recited this over Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn; the gold standard protection for children against envy.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mgonjwa Aliyekata Tamaa ya Kupona
duas.title_en: For the Terminally Ill or When Losing Hope of Life
duas.title_ar: دعاء المريض الذي يئس من حياته
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي، وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee warhamnee, wa alhiqnee bir-Rafeeqil-A'laa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nisamehe na unirehemu, na unikutanishe na Marafiki Watukufu wa Juu kabisa (Mitume na waja wema Peponi).
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me and have mercy upon me, and join me with the Highest Companions.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #152, Sahih al-Bukhari 5674, Sahih Muslim 2444
duas.virtue_sw: Haya yalikuwa maneno ya mwisho kabisa ya Mtume Muhammad ﷺ kabla ya roho yake tukufu kutwaliwa.
duas.virtue_en: These were the very last words spoken by the Prophet ﷺ before his soul was taken.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufariji Mfiwa Katika Msiba
duas.title_en: Condolences Upon Bereavement and Loss
duas.title_ar: دعاء التعزية عند المصيبة
duas.arabic: إِنَّ لِلَّهِ مَا أَخَذَ، وَلَهُ مَا أَعْطَى، وَكُلٌّ عِنْدَهُ بِأَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى، فَلْتَصْبِرْ وَلْتَحْتَسِبْ.
duas.transliteration: Inna lillaahi maa akhadha, wa lahu maa a'taa, wa kullun 'indahu bi-ajalim-musammaa, faltasbir wal-tahtasib.
duas.swahili: Hakika ni vya Mwenyezi Mungu kile Alichokitwaa, na ni Vyake kile Alichokitoa, na kila kitu Kwake kina muda maalum uliopangwa; basi subiri na utarajie malipo kutoka kwa Allah.
duas.english: Truly to Allah belongs that which He has taken, and to Him belongs that which He has given, and with Him everything has an appointed time; so be patient and anticipate Allah's reward.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #159, Sahih al-Bukhari 1284, Sahih Muslim 923
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno bora na ya faraja ya kisheria ya kumliwaza ndugu, rafiki au jirani aliyefiwa na mpendwa wake.
duas.virtue_en: The definitive Islamic condolence offering serenity, acceptance of Qadar, and patient hope for eternal reunion.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mvua Wakati wa Ukame (Istisqa)
duas.title_en: Seeking Rain During Drought (Istisqa)
duas.title_ar: دعاء الاستسقاء وطلب الغيث
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا غَيْثًا مُغِيثًا مَرِيئًا مَرِيعًا، نَافِعًا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ، عَاجِلاً غَيْرَ آجِلٍ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummasqinaa ghaythan mugheetham-maree'am-maree'aa, naafi'an ghayra dhaarri, 'aajilan ghayra aajil.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tunyeshee mvua yenye kuokoa, yenye manufaa na rutuba, yenye kheri isiyo na madhara, ya haraka bila ya kuchelewa.
duas.english: O Allah, shower upon us a saving rain, abundant, productive, beneficial without harm, promptly and without delay.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa wakati nchi au jamii inapokumbwa na ukame na upungufu wa maji.
duas.virtue_en: Invokes beneficial rainfall during periods of drought, crop failure, and scarcity.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Upepo Mkali na Tufani
duas.title_en: When Fierce Wind or Storm Blows
duas.title_ar: دعاء هبوب الريح والعواصف
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا أُرْسِلَتْ بِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayrahaa, wa khayra maa feehaa, wa khayra maa ursilat bih, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa, wa sharri maa ursilat bih.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba kheri ya upepo huu, na kheri ya vilivyomo ndani yake, na kheri ya kile ulichotumwa nacho; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake, na shari ya vilivyomo ndani yake, na shari ya kile ulichotumwa nacho.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for its goodness, the good that is in it, and the good with which it was sent; and I seek refuge in You from its evil...
duas.virtue_sw: Upepo mkali unaweza kubeba rehma au adhabu; dua hii huomba kheri yake na kuzuia madhara yake.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against destruction from fierce storms, asking for its mercy rather than wrath.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Wasiwasi Katika Imani
duas.title_en: For One Experiencing Whispers or Doubts in Faith
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أصابه وسواس في الإيمان
duas.arabic: آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِ، هُوَ الأَوَّلُ وَالآخِرُ وَالظَّاهِرُ وَالْبَاطِنُ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ.
duas.transliteration: Aamantu billaahi wa Rusulih. Huwal-Awwalu wal-Aakhiru wadh-Dhaahiru wal-Baatinu wa Huwa bikulli shay'in 'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Nimemwamini Mwenyezi Mungu na Mitume Wake. Yeye ndiye wa Mwanzo na ndiye wa Mwisho, na ndiye Aliye Dhahiri na ndiye Aliye wa Siri; Naye ni Mjuzi wa kila kitu.
duas.english: I believe in Allah and His Messengers. He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is Knower of all things.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #136, Sahih Muslim 134, Abu Dawud 5110
duas.virtue_sw: Hufukuza papo hapo wasiwasi na maswali ya shaka yanayopandikizwa moyoni na shetani.
duas.virtue_en: Dispels Satanic whisperings, existential doubts, and spiritual anxieties.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Kinga dhidi ya Madeni na Utumwa
duas.title_en: For Relief from Heavy Debts and Economic Dependency
duas.title_ar: دعاء قضاء الدين والاستغناء بالحلال
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummakfinee bi halaalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bi fadhlika 'amman siwaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nitosheleze kwa riziki Yako ya halali nisiihitaji haramu Yako, na unitajirishe kwa fadhila Zako nisiwe na haja na yeyote asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful so that I do not need what is forbidden, and enrich me with Your bounty so that I need no one besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Hata kama mtu angekuwa na deni kubwa kama mlima wa Uhud, Mwenyezi Mungu atamfungulia njia ya kulilipa kwa baraka ya dua hii.
duas.virtue_en: Even if one had debt equivalent to a mountain, Allah facilitates its repayment through this prayer.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Shida Kuu (Dua al-Karb)
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Shida Kuu (Dua al-Karb)
duas.title_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ ...
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahul-'Adheemul-Haleem, laa ilaaha illallaahu Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem, laa ilaaha illallaahu Rabbus-samaawaati wa Rabbul-ardi wa Rabbul-'Arshil-Kareem.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mkubwa, Mpole; hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa Kiti Kikuu cha Enzi; hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa mbingu na Mola Mlezi wa ardhi na Mola Mlezi wa Kiti Kitukufu cha Enzi.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Tolerant; there is no god but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne; there is no god but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and Lord of the Noble Throne.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyokuwa akiisoma Mtume (s.a.w) pale jambo zito la dhiki na fadhaa lilipomfika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Hisn al-Muslim #122, Sahih al-Bukhari 6346, Muslim 2730.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Abu Bakr: Rehema Yako Pekee
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Abu Bakr: Rehema Yako Pekee
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَرْجُو فَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ، وَأَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma rahmataka arjoo falaa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn, wa aslih lee sha'nee kullah, laa ilaaha illaa Ant.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, rehema Yako ndiyo ninayoitarajia, basi usiniachie nafsi yangu hata kwa kope ya jicho, na unitengenezee mambo yangu yote; hapana mungu ila Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, it is Your mercy that I hope for, so do not leave me to myself even for the blink of an eye, and set right for me all of my affairs. There is no god but You.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya mwenye msukosuko mkubwa na hofu ya kupoteza uelekeo wa maisha.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Hisn al-Muslim #123, Abu Dawud 5090.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Kuondolewa Huzuni na Madeni (Dua ya Abu Umamah)
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Kuondolewa Huzuni na Madeni (Dua ya Abu Umamah)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ، وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan, wal-'ajzi wal-kasal, wal-bukhli wal-jubn, wa dala'id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijaal.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na fadhaa na huzuni, na unyonge na uvivu, na ubakhili na woga, na kulemewa na deni, na kushindwa na watu (uonevu).
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from grief and sadness, from weakness and laziness, from miserliness and cowardice, from being overcome by debt and being overpowered by men.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alimfundisha Abu Umamah alipokuwa amekaa msikitini akiwa amelemewa na madeni na huzuni; Allah akamuondolea dhiki yake yote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Hisn al-Muslim #121, Sahih al-Bukhari 2893.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Jambo Zito Linapokuwa Gumu
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Jambo Zito Linapokuwa Gumu
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْت...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَا سَهْلَ إِلَّا مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلًا، وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الْحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma laa sahla illaa maa ja'altahoo sahlaa, wa Anta taj'alul-hazna idhaa shi'ta sahlaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakuna jambo jepesi ila lile ulilolifanya Wewe kuwa jepesi, na Wewe unalifanya gumu kuwa jepesi Ukitaka.
duas.english: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You have made easy, and You make the difficulty easy when You wish.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa wakati wa mitihani, mazungumzo magumu, au mikataba mizito ya kazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Hisn al-Muslim #139, Ibn Hibban 327.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Amani Baada ya Hofu
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Amani Baada ya Hofu
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummastur 'awraatee wa aamin raw'aatee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, sitiri aibu zangu na utulize hofu zangu.
duas.english: O Allah, conceal my faults and calm my fears.
duas.virtue_sw: Huleta amani ya moyo na kuondoa wasiwasi wa aibu na madhila.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Hisn al-Muslim #83, Abu Dawud 5074.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 6
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 6
duas.title_ar: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي ...
duas.arabic: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي وَيَسِّرْ أَمْرِي وَارْحَمْ ضَعْفِي وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Yaa Faarijal-hammi wa yaa Kaashifal-ghamm, farrij hammee wa yassir amree warham da'fee wa qillata heelatee. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kuondosha fadhaa na Mwenye kufungua huzuni, niondoshee fadhaa yangu na unifanyie wepesi jambo langu, na urehemu udhaifu wangu na upungufu wa mbinu zangu. [Dua 6]
duas.english: O Reliever of grief and Remover of distress, relieve my grief and grant me ease... [Supplication 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga tumaini la haraka kwa mwenye moyo uliovunjika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Al-Adhkar Nawawi, Hisn al-Muslim.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 7
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 7
duas.title_ar: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي ...
duas.arabic: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي وَيَسِّرْ أَمْرِي وَارْحَمْ ضَعْفِي وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي. (رقم 7)
duas.transliteration: Yaa Faarijal-hammi wa yaa Kaashifal-ghamm, farrij hammee wa yassir amree warham da'fee wa qillata heelatee. (Na. 7)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kuondosha fadhaa na Mwenye kufungua huzuni, niondoshee fadhaa yangu na unifanyie wepesi jambo langu, na urehemu udhaifu wangu na upungufu wa mbinu zangu. [Dua 7]
duas.english: O Reliever of grief and Remover of distress, relieve my grief and grant me ease... [Supplication 7]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga tumaini la haraka kwa mwenye moyo uliovunjika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Al-Adhkar Nawawi, Hisn al-Muslim.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 8
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 8
duas.title_ar: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي ...
duas.arabic: يَا فَارِجَ الْهَمِّ وَيَا كَاشِفَ الْغَمِّ، فَرِّجْ هَمِّي وَيَسِّرْ أَمْرِي وَارْحَمْ ضَعْفِي وَقِلَّةَ حِيلَتِي. (رقم 8)
duas.transliteration: Yaa Faarijal-hammi wa yaa Kaashifal-ghamm, farrij hammee wa yassir amree warham da'fee wa qillata heelatee. (Na. 8)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kuondosha fadhaa na Mwenye kufungua huzuni, niondoshee fadhaa yangu na unifanyie wepesi jambo langu, na urehemu udhaifu wangu na upungufu wa mbinu zangu. [Dua 8]
duas.english: O Reliever of grief and Remover of distress, relieve my grief and grant me ease... [Supplication 8]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga tumaini la haraka kwa mwenye moyo uliovunjika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for distress and anxiety from Al-Adhkar Nawawi, Hisn al-Muslim.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Shida: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 9
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress: Dua ya Faraja ya Shida na Huzuni 9

duas.title_sw: Shida na Huzuni: Dua ya Faraja ya Moyo Kupitia Quran (Sehemu ya 71)
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress & Anxiety: Dua ya Faraja ya Moyo Kupitia Quran (Part 71)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْر...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ الْقُرْآنَ رَبِيعَ قَلْبِي، وَنُورَ صَدْرِي، وَجَلَاءَ حُزْنِي، وَذَهَابَ هَمِّي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj-'alil-Qur'aana rabee'a qalbee, wa noora sadree, wa jalaa'a huznee, wa dhahaaba hammee. (Na. 71)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu ujaalie Qur'ani kuwa chemchemi na furaha ya moyo wangu, na nuru ya kifua changu, na mfumbuzi wa huzuni yangu, na kiondosha fadhaa yangu. [Dua ya Shida na Huzuni Na. 71]
duas.english: O Allah, make the Quran the spring of my heart, the light of my chest, the remover of my sorrow, and the pacifier of my anxiety. [Relief from Distress & Anxiety supplication #71]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Shida na Huzuni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #120, Ahmad 1/391 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Shida na Huzuni: Dua ya Subira Wakati wa Misiba (Sehemu ya 72)
duas.title_en: Relief from Distress & Anxiety: Dua ya Subira Wakati wa Misiba (Part 72)
duas.title_ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُ...
duas.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَأَخْلِفْ لِي خَيْرًا مِنْهَا.
duas.transliteration: Innaa lillaahi wa innaa ilayhi raaji'oon, Allaahumma'jurnee fee museebatee, wa akhlif lee khayram-minhaa. (Na. 72)
duas.swahili: Hakika sisi ni wa Mwenyezi Mungu na hakika sisi Kwake tutarejea; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nilipe ujira katika msiba wangu huu, na unibadilishie kitu kilicho bora zaidi kuliko hiki. [Dua ya Shida na Huzuni Na. 72]
duas.english: Indeed to Allah we belong and to Him we shall return. O Allah, reward me in my affliction and replace it with something better. [Relief from Distress & Anxiety supplication #72]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Shida na Huzuni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #153, Sahih Muslim 918 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Istighfar ya Kila Siku (Astaghfirullah wa Atoobu Ilayh)
duas.title_en: Seeking Forgiveness and Repenting
duas.title_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Ninamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness from Allah and I repent unto Him.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #261, Sahih al-Bukhari 6307, Sahih Muslim 2702
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akiomba msamaha na kutubu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu zaidi ya mara 70 hadi 100 kwa siku.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ used to seek forgiveness and repent more than 70 to 100 times daily.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuwaombea Wazazi Wawili
duas.title_en: Supplication for Parents
duas.title_ar: دعاء للوالدين
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا.
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Warehemu wazazi wangu wawili kama walivyonilea nikiwa mtoto mdogo.
duas.english: My Lord! Be merciful to them as they raised me when I was small.
duas.virtue_sw: Ni wajibu na utiifu mkuu kwa wazazi wakiwa hai na hata baada ya kifo chao; daraja ya wazazi huinuliwa Peponi kwa istighfar ya mtoto wao.
duas.virtue_en: The highest form of filial piety; raises the ranks of parents in Paradise.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumshukuru Aliyekufanyia Wema
duas.title_en: To Someone Who Does You a Favor
duas.title_ar: دعاء من صُنِعَ إليه معروف
duas.arabic: جَزَاكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا.
duas.transliteration: Jazaakallaahu khayraa.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akulipe kila la kheri.
duas.english: May Allah reward you with goodness.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Mwenye kufanyiwa wema akasema 'Jazakallahu khayran' basi amemfikishia mwenziwe kiwango cha juu kabisa cha sifa na shukrani.
duas.virtue_en: The most sublime and complete expression of gratitude in Islam.

duas.title_sw: Kaffaratul Majlis (Kufuta Makosa ya Kikao)
duas.title_en: Expiation of an Assembly or Gathering
duas.title_ar: دعاء كفارة المجلس
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
duas.swahili: Umetakasika Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa zote njema ni Zako. Ninashuhudia ya kwamba hapana mungu apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe. Ninakuomba msamaha na ninatubu Kwako.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufuta makosa, maneno yasiyo na maana, na kuteleza kote kulikotokea ndani ya kikao, mazungumzo au mkutano kabla ya kutawanyika.
duas.virtue_en: Expiates any careless talk or sins that took place during a meeting or gathering.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Adam na Hawa ya Kutubu
duas.title_en: Supplication of Adam and Eve for Forgiveness
duas.title_ar: دعاء آدم وحواء عليهما السلام في التوبة
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa dhalamnaa anfusanaa wa in lam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumejidhulumu nafsi zetu; na kama Hutusamehe na kuturehemu, bila shaka tutakuwa miongoni mwa waliopata hasara.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno ya toba aliyofundishwa Nabii Adam na Mwenyezi Mungu mwenyewe na akamsamehe; kielelezo kikuu cha unyenyekevu.
duas.virtue_en: The words of repentance revealed to Adam by Allah, securing complete divine forgiveness.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa ya Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_en: Supplication of Prophet Musa Seeking Forgiveness
duas.title_ar: دعاء موسى عليه السلام في الاستغفار
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimejidhulumu nafsi yangu, basi nisamehe.
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua fupi lakini nzito inayomfanya Mwenyezi Mungu amsamehe mja papo hapo.
duas.virtue_en: A concise yet immense plea that earned immediate forgiveness from Allah for Prophet Musa.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Nabii Nuh ya Kutaka Kinga na Rehema
duas.title_en: Supplication of Prophet Nuh for Protection and Mercy
duas.title_ar: دعاء نوح عليه السلام في الاستعاذة والاستغفار
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihee 'ilm, wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamnee akum-minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Mimi ninajikinga Kwako nisije nikakuomba yale nisiyo na ilimu nayo; na kama Hutanisamehe na kunitendea rehema, nitakuwa miongoni mwa wenye kukhasirika.
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge; and unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Inamfundisha mja adabu ya kuomba dua sahihi na kutegemea rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu daima.
duas.virtue_en: Cultivates profound etiquette in supplication and utter reliance on Allah's pardon.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mtume ya Istighfar Katika Kila Kikao
duas.title_en: The Prophet's Repeated Seeking of Forgiveness in Gatherings
duas.title_ar: استغفار النبي في المجلس الواحد مائة مرة
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa tub 'alayya, innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu nisamehe na upokee toba yangu; hakika Wewe ndiwe Mwingi wa kupokea toba, Mwenye kurehemu daima.
duas.english: My Lord forgive me and accept my repentance; surely You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Masahaba walikuwa wakimuhesabia Mtume ﷺ akirudia maneno haya mara 100 katika kikao kimoja tu.
duas.virtue_en: The Companions counted the Prophet ﷺ repeating this supplication 100 times in a single sitting.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Msamaha wa Madhambi Makubwa na Madogo
duas.title_en: Comprehensive Plea for Expiation of All Sins
duas.title_ar: الاستغفار العظيم لمحو الذنوب
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'Adheemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Ninamwomba msamaha Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mkuu, ambaye hapana mola ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu, na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness of Allah the Magnificent, besides Whom there is no deity, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent unto Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alisema: Mwenye kusema hivi atasamehewa madhambi yake hata kama alikimbia vitani.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites this will be forgiven their sins even if they had fled from the battlefield.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Uongofu, Ucha Mungu na Kujitosheleza
duas.title_en: Seeking Guidance, Piety, Chastity and Contentment
duas.title_ar: سؤال الهدى والتقى والعفاف والغنى
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى، وَالتُّقَى، وَالْعَفَافَ، وَالْغِنَى.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-hudaa, wat-tuqaa, wal-'afaafa, wal-ghinaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba uongofu, na ucha-Mungu, na usafi wa nafsi (kujiepusha na machafu), na utajiri wa moyo (kutosheka).
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for guidance, piety, chastity, and self-sufficiency (contentment of the heart).
duas.virtue_sw: Dua fupi inayojumuisha kheri zote za dini na dunia kwa maneno manne mepesi.
duas.virtue_en: One of the most comprehensive prayers gathering all goodness of both worlds in four words.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mwisho Mwema (Husnul Khatimah)
duas.title_en: Supplication for a Beautiful Blessed Ending (Husn al-Khatimah)
duas.title_ar: دعاء سؤال حسن الخاتمة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُسْنَ الْخَاتِمَةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سُوءِ الْخَاتِمَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ خَيْرَ أَعْمَارِنَا أَوَاخِرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَعْمَالِنَا خَوَاتِيمَهَا، وَخَيْرَ أَيَّامِنَا يَوْمَ نَلْقَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka husnal-khaatimah, wa a'oodhu bika min soo'il-khaatimah. Allaahummaj'al khayra a'maarinaa awaakhirahaa, wa khayra a'maalinaa khawaateemahaa, wa khayra ayyaaminaa yawma nalqaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba mwisho mwema wa maisha yangu, na ninajikinga Kwako na mwisho mbaya. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, fanya sehemu bora ya umri wetu iwe ni mwishoni mwake, na matendo yetu bora yawe ya kukhitimisha, na siku yetu bora iwe siku tutakapokutana na Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for a good and righteous conclusion to my life, and seek refuge from an evil end. Make the best of our lives its end, the best of our deeds the concluding ones...
duas.virtue_sw: Mambo hutegemea miisho yake; dua hii inalinda imani ya mja mpaka pumzi yake ya mwisho.
duas.virtue_en: Actions are judged by their conclusions; preserves the believer's faith until the final breath.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kutubu Madhambi ya Siri na Dhahiri
duas.title_en: Pleading Pardon for All Sins, Minute and Immense
duas.title_ar: دعاء استغفار شامل للذنوب كلها
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ، دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلاَنِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaghfir lee dhanbee kullah, diqqahu wa jillah, wa awwalahu wa aakhirah, wa 'alaaniyatahu wa sirrah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nisamehe madhambi yangu yote: madogo na makubwa, ya kwanza na ya mwisho, yaliyo dhahiri na yaliyo ya siri.
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all my sins: the minor and the major, the first and the last, the open and the hidden.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyokuwa akiisoma Mtume ﷺ akiwa amesujudu; haisazi kosa lolote bila kufutwa.
duas.virtue_en: Recited by the Prophet ﷺ in prostration; leaves no fault unpardonned.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Istighfar ya Mtume Mara Mia Kila Siku
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Istighfar ya Mtume Mara Mia Kila Siku
duas.title_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaaha wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Namwomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness of Allah and repent to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Hakika mimi ninaomba msamaha kwa Allah na ninatubu Kwake zaidi ya mara sabini (na kwenye riwaya nyingine mara mia) kila siku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #261, Sahih al-Bukhari 6307, Muslim 2702.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Dua ya Abu Bakr Aliyofundishwa na Mtume Ndani ya Swala
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Dua ya Abu Bakr Aliyofundishwa na Mtume Ndani ya Swala
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا ي...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا، وَلَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ، وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee dhalamtu nafsee dhulman katheeran, wa laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Anta, faghfir lee maghfiratam-min 'indika warhamnee innaka Antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nimeidhulumu nafsi yangu dhuluma kubwa mno, na hakuna anayesamehe madhambi ila Wewe; basi nighufirie msamaha unaotoka Kwako na unirehemu; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwingi wa maghfirah, Mwenye kurehemu.
duas.english: O Allah, I have wronged myself greatly, and none forgives sins except You. So grant me forgiveness from Yourself and have mercy upon me. Indeed, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Abu Bakr As-Siddiq alimuomba Mtume amfundishe dua bora ya kuomba ndani ya swala yake.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #54, Sahih al-Bukhari 834, Muslim 2705.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Dua ya Kufuta Madhambi Hata Kama Mtu Alikimbia Vitani
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Dua ya Kufuta Madhambi Hata Kama Mtu Alikimbia Vitani
duas.title_ar: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ...
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الَّذِي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyal-Qayyooma wa atoobu ilayh.
duas.swahili: Namwomba msamaha Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye hapana mola ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu, na ninatubu Kwake.
duas.english: I seek forgiveness of Allah, other than whom there is no god, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Mwenye kuisoma atasamehewa madhambi yake hata kama alikimbia uwanja wa mapambano.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #262, Abu Dawud 1517, Tirmidhi 3577.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Dua ya Kufuta Madhambi ya Baraza (Kaffaratul Majlis)
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Dua ya Kufuta Madhambi ya Baraza (Kaffaratul Majlis)
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَه...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bi-hamdika, ash-hadu allaa ilaaha illaa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
duas.swahili: Umetakasika Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, ninashuhudia kwamba hapana mola ila Wewe, ninakuomba msamaha na ninatubu Kwako.
duas.english: Glory be to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that there is no god except You, I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
duas.virtue_sw: Inafuta makosa, maneno yasiyofaa na upuuzi wote uliozungumzwa katika kikao chochote kabla ya kuinuka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #196, Tirmidhi 3433.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Dua ya Toba ya Mwenye Kujuta
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Dua ya Toba ya Mwenye Kujuta
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbigh-fir lee wa tub 'alayya innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi nighufirie na unitakabalie toba yangu; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye kupokea toba, Mwenye kurehemu.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and accept my repentance; indeed, You are the Accepter of Repentance, the Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Maswahaba walimhesabia Mtume (s.a.w) akisoma dua hii zaidi ya mara mia moja katika baraza moja tu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #263, Abu Dawud 1516.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Istighfar: Dua ya Istighfar na Kutafuta Msamaha 6
duas.title_en: Repentance Supplication: Dua ya Istighfar na Kutafuta Msamaha 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، و...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي كُلَّهُ: دِقَّهُ وَجِلَّهُ، وَأَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ، وَعَلَانِيَتَهُ وَسِرَّهُ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagh-fir lee dhanbee kullah: diqqahoo wa jillah, wa awwalahoo wa aakhirah, wa 'alaaniyatahoo wa sirrah. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nighufirie madhambi yangu yote: madogo na makubwa, ya mwanzo na ya mwisho, ya wazi na ya siri. [Istighfar 6]
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me all of my sins: the small and great, the first and last, the open and secret. [Forgiveness 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Inafuta madhambi yote ya mwanadamu bila kubakiza hata unywele.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for repentance from Hisn al-Muslim #43, Sahih Muslim 483.

duas.title_sw: Istighfar na Tawbah: Dua ya Kuomba Msamaha wa Madhambi Yote (Sehemu ya 71)
duas.title_en: Forgiveness & Repentance: Dua ya Kuomba Msamaha wa Madhambi Yote (Part 71)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ، وَمَا أَسْرَفْتُ، وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagh-fir lee maa qaddamtu wa maa akh-khartu, wa maa asrartu wa maa a'lantu, wa maa asraftu, wa maa Anta a'lamu bihee minnee. (Na. 71)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nighufirie niliyoyatanguliza na niliyoyachelewesha, niliyoyaficha na niliyoyatangaza, niliyopindukia mipaka, na yale unayoyajua zaidi kuliko mimi. [Dua ya Istighfar na Tawbah Na. 71]
duas.english: O Allah, forgive me what I have sent forward and what I have held back, what I have hidden and what I have made public... [Forgiveness & Repentance supplication #71]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Istighfar na Tawbah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #56, Sahih Muslim 771 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Istighfar na Tawbah: Dua ya Kutubu kwa Mola Mwenye Kupokea Toba (Sehemu ya 72)
duas.title_en: Forgiveness & Repentance: Dua ya Kutubu kwa Mola Mwenye Kupokea Toba (Part 72)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيم...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تُبْ عَلَيَّ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma tub 'alayya innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem, waghfir lee khatee'atee wa jahlee wa israafee fee amree. (Na. 72)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu pokea toba yangu hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye kupokea toba Mwenye kurehemu, na nighufirie makosa yangu na ujinga wangu na kupita kiasi katika mambo yangu. [Dua ya Istighfar na Tawbah Na. 72]
duas.english: O Allah, accept my repentance... [Forgiveness & Repentance supplication #72]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Istighfar na Tawbah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 6398, Muslim 2719 for spiritual peace and virtue.
