duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kutoka Nyumbani
duas.title_en: Supplication When Leaving Home
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi tawakkaltu 'alallaahi, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, nimemtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu, wala hapana uwezo wala nguvu ila kwa msaada wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah; there is no power and no might except by Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Malaika humwambia msomaji: 'Umeongozwa, umetoshelezwa na umekingwa,' na Shetani hujitenga naye mbali.
duas.virtue_en: It is said to him: 'You are guided, defended and protected,' and Satan withdraws from him.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupanda Chombo / Safari
duas.title_en: Supplication for Travel and Mounting a Vehicle
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee sakh-khara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahu muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Yule aliyetutiishia sisi chombo hiki, nasi tusingaliweza kukidhibiti wenyewe, na hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu.
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it by our efforts. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #206, Sahih Muslim 1342, Surat Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14
duas.virtue_sw: Humkinga msafiri kutokana na ajali, machungu ya safari na majanga njiani.
duas.virtue_en: Protects travelers from mishaps, road hardships, and difficulties.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Kula Chakula
duas.title_en: Supplication After Finishing a Meal
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا، وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee at'amanee haadhaa, wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye amenilisha chakula hiki na kuniruzuku bila uwezo wala nguvu kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah who fed me this and provided it for me without any might or power on my part.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma baada ya kula husamehewa madhambi yake yaliyopita.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever says it after eating, his past sins will be forgiven.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Chooni
duas.title_en: Entering the Toilet / Restroom
duas.title_ar: دعاء دخول الخلاء
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khabaa'ith.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako na mashetani wa kiume na wa kike.
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all offensive and wicked evil things (male and female devils).
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #10, Sahih al-Bukhari 142, Sahih Muslim 375
duas.virtue_sw: Humkinga mtu dhidi ya madhara ya majini na mashetani wanapokuwa chooni.
duas.virtue_en: Protects against evil spirits and harms when entering the restroom.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kutoka Chooni
duas.title_en: Leaving the Toilet / Restroom
duas.title_ar: دعاء الخروج من الخلاء
duas.arabic: غُفْرَانَكَ.
duas.transliteration: Ghufraanaka.
duas.swahili: Nakuomba msamaha Wako (Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu).
duas.english: I seek Your forgiveness.
duas.virtue_sw: Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu msamaha kwa kutomdhukuru wakati uliokuwa chooni.
duas.virtue_en: Seeking Allah's forgiveness for having been in a state where remembrance was paused.

duas.title_sw: Dua Kabla ya Kula Chakula
duas.title_en: Before Eating a Meal
duas.title_ar: التسمية قبل الطعام
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaleta baraka kwenye chakula na kumzuia shetani asishiriki chakula chako.
duas.virtue_en: Brings barakah to the food and prevents devil from partaking in it.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kuvaa Nguo
duas.title_en: When Wearing Clothes
duas.title_ar: دعاء لبس الثوب
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَسَانِي هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee kasaanee haadhath-thawba wa razaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wa laa quwwah.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye amenivika vazi hili na kuniruzuku bila uwezo wala nguvu kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah Who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or might from myself.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma anasamehewa madhambi yake yaliyotangulia.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it has their previous minor sins forgiven.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Nyumbani
duas.title_en: Entering the House
duas.title_ar: دعاء دخول المنزل
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa bismillaahi kharajnaa, wa 'alaa Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tunaingia, na kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tulitoka, na kwa Mola wetu Mlezi tunamtegemea.
duas.english: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we rely.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufukuza shetani asilale wala kula kwenye nyumba yako.
duas.virtue_en: Bars the devil from shelter and food in the household.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuangalia Kwenye Kioo
duas.title_en: Looking into the Mirror
duas.title_ar: دعاء النظر في المرآة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma kamaa hassanta khalqee fahassin khuluqee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, kama Ulivyoufanya mzuri umbo langu, basi ufanye mzuri na tabia yangu.
duas.english: O Allah, just as You have made my physical appearance good, make my character and manners good.
duas.virtue_sw: Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu akhlaaq njema na uzuri wa ndani sambamba na uzuri wa nje.
duas.virtue_en: Supplication for beautiful character and high moral conduct.

duas.title_sw: Kaffaratul Majlis (Dua ya Kumaliza Kikao)
duas.title_en: Expiation of an Assembly (Kaffarat al-Majlis)
duas.title_ar: كفارة المجلس
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanakallaahumma wa bihamdika, ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illaa Anta, astaghfiruka wa atoobu ilayk.
duas.swahili: Kutakasika ni Kwako Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zako, nashuhudia kwamba hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Wewe, nakuomba msamaha na ninatubu Kwako.
duas.english: Glory is to You, O Allah, and praise. I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufuta maneno yasiyofaa na makosa yaliyotokea ndani ya kikao hicho.
duas.virtue_en: Expiates any idle talk, shortcomings or sins that occurred in the gathering.

duas.title_sw: Dua Mvua Inaponyesha
duas.title_en: When It Rains
duas.title_ar: دعاء نزول المطر
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَيِّبًا نَافِعًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma sayyiban naafi'aa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, iweke iwe mvua yenye manufaa na kheri.
duas.english: O Allah, may it be a beneficial rain.
duas.virtue_sw: Mvua inaponyesha ni miongoni mwa nyakati ambazo dua hujibiwa haraka na Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Rain is a special time of acceptance of prayers, asking for beneficial rain without destruction.

duas.title_sw: Dua Baada ya Mvua Kunyesha
duas.title_en: After It Has Rained
duas.title_ar: الذكر بعد نزول المطر
duas.arabic: مُطِرْنَا بِفَضْلِ اللَّهِ وَرَحْمَتِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Mutirnaa bifadhlillaahi wa rahmatih.
duas.swahili: Tumenyeshewa mvua kwa fadhila za Mwenyezi Mungu na rehema Zake.
duas.english: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #168, Sahih al-Bukhari 846, Sahih Muslim 71
duas.virtue_sw: Kukiri na kushukuru kwamba mvua inatoka kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na si kutokana na nyota au miujiza mingine.
duas.virtue_en: Affirming Tawhid and recognizing Allah alone as the sender of rain.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupanda Chombo cha Usafiri
duas.title_en: When Mounting or Boarding a Vehicle
duas.title_ar: دعاء ركوب الدابة أو وسيلة السفر
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Alhamdu lillaah, Subhaanal-ladhee sakh-khara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, sifa njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu. Ametakasika Yule Aliyetutiishia hiki, na sisi hatukuwa na uwezo nacho, na hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
duas.english: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, whereas we could not have done it by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.reference: Surat Az-Zukhruf 43:13-14, Hisn al-Muslim #205, Abu Dawud 2602, Tirmidhi 3446
duas.virtue_sw: Hutoa shukrani na kumuweka msafiri katika hifadhi ya Mwenyezi Mungu katika safari nzima.
duas.virtue_en: Invokes gratitude and Allah's guardianship during journeys by car, plane or vessel.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuona Mwezi Mwandamo
duas.title_en: Upon Sighting the Crescent Moon
duas.title_ar: دعاء رؤية الهلال
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالأَمْنِ وَالإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ وَالإِسْلاَمِ، رَبِّي وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahumma ahillahoo 'alaynaa bil-amni wal-eemaan, was-salaamati wal-Islaam, Rabbee wa Rabbukallaah.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa. Ewe Mola wetu, utuchomozee mwezi huu ukiwa na amani, imani, salama na Uislamu. Mola wangu na Mola wako ni Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: Allah is the greatest. O Allah, let this moon appear on us with security and faith, with peace and Islam. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Huweka mwezi mzima (k.m. mwezi wa Ramadhani au miezi mingine) katika baraka, utulivu na unyenyekevu kwa Muumba.
duas.virtue_en: Welcomes the new lunar month with prayers for peace, faith and righteousness.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufuturu Saumu
duas.title_en: Upon Breaking the Fast (Iftar)
duas.title_ar: دعاء إفطار الصائم
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u, wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa' Allaah.
duas.swahili: Kiu kimeondoka, mishipa imelowa, na ujira umethibiti Mwenyezi Mungu Akitaka.
duas.english: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasemwa pale tu unapofuturu; ni wakati ambao dua ya mfungaji haikataliwi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited right upon breaking the fast, a moment when supplication is accepted.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Mngurumo wa Radi
duas.title_en: Upon Hearing Thunder
duas.title_ar: دعاء سماع الرعد
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي يُسَبِّحُ الرَّعْدُ بِحَمْدِهِ وَالْمَلاَئِكَةُ مِنْ خِيفَتِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee yusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihee wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Yule ambaye radi inamtakasa kwa sifa Zake njema, na malaika wanamtakasa kwa kumkhofu Yeye.
duas.english: Glory be to Him whom thunder praises with praise, and the angels from the fear of Him.
duas.reference: Surat Ar-Ra'd 13:13, Hisn al-Muslim #168, Muwatta Malik 1801
duas.virtue_sw: Humkumbusha mja uwezo mkuu wa Allah mtukufu na humkinga na hofu wakati wa dhoruba.
duas.virtue_en: Reminds the believer of the supreme awe of Allah during violent thunderstorms.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupiga Chafya na Majibu Yake
duas.title_en: Upon Sneezing and Responding to Sneezing
duas.title_ar: أدعية العطاس وتشميت العاطس
duas.arabic: الْعَاطِس: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ. الْمُسْتَمِع: يَرْحَمُكَ اللَّهُ. رَدُّ الْعَاطِس: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللَّهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
duas.transliteration: Al-hamdu lillaah -> Yarhamukallaah -> Yahdeekumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum.
duas.swahili: Mwenye kupiga chafya husema: 'Alhamdulillaah' (Sifa njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu). Aliyesikia anamjibu: 'Yarhamukallaah' (Mwenyezi Mungu akurehemu). Kisha aliyepiga chafya anajibu: 'Yahdeekumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum' (Mwenyezi Mungu awaongoze na atengeneze mambo yenu).
duas.english: Sneezer says: Alhamdu lillah. Listener replies: Yarhamukallah. Sneezer responds: Yahdikumullahu wa yuslihu balakum.
duas.virtue_sw: Haki mojawapo kati ya haki sita za Muislamu kwa Muislamu mwenzake; inaleta upendo na afya.
duas.virtue_en: One of the six mutual rights of Muslims; fosters goodwill, community, and divine mercy.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumuombea Aliyefunga Ndoa (Maharusi)
duas.title_en: Congratulating the Newly Married Couple
duas.title_ar: الدعاء للمتزوج وتهنئة العروسين
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka, wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki, na ashushe baraka juu yako, na awaunganishe ninyi wawili katika kila lililo la kheri.
duas.english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite both of you in goodness.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah tukufu ya kumuombea kila mtu anayeingia kwenye ndoa badala ya maneno ya kimila.
duas.virtue_en: The prophetic standard of congratulating new marriages, invoking enduring blessing and harmony.

duas.title_sw: Dua Kabla ya Tendo la Ndoa
duas.title_en: Before Marital Intimacy
duas.title_ar: دعاء الجماع بين الزوجين
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah, Allaahumma jannibnash-shaytaana, wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tuepushe na shetani, na umwepushe shetani na kile Utakachoturuzuku (mtoto).
duas.english: In the name of Allah. O Allah, keep Satan away from us and keep Satan away from that with which You provide us.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #191, Sahih al-Bukhari 6388, Sahih Muslim 1434
duas.virtue_sw: Ikiwa watakadiriwa kupata mtoto kupitia tendo hilo, shetani hatamdhuru kamwe mtoto huyo katika maisha yake yote.
duas.virtue_en: If a child is conceived, Satan will never be able to harm that child throughout their entire life.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Sokoni au Eneo la Biashara
duas.title_en: When Entering the Market or Shopping Mall
duas.title_ar: دعاء دخول السوق
duas.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ حَيٌّ لاَ يَمُوتُ، بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamd, yuhyee wa yumeet, wa Huwa hayyun laa yamoot, biyadihil-khayr, wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Hapana mola apasaye kuabudiwa kwa haki ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja pekee hana mshirika; ufalme ni Wake na sifa njema zote ni Zake; Yeye ndiye Ahuishaye na Afishaye, Naye Yu Hai hafi kamwe; mkononi Mwake mna kheri yote, Naye juu ya kila kitu ni Mwenye uwezo mkubwa.
duas.english: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and praise...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma anapoingia sokoni anaandikiwa mema milioni moja (1,000,000), anafutiwa madhambi milioni moja, na anainuliwa daraja milioni moja Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Whoever recites it entering a market is rewarded with one million good deeds, one million sins erased, and raised one million ranks.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kulipa Deni kwa Aliyekukopesha
duas.title_en: When Repaying a Debt to a Lender
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أدى دينه إلى صاحبه
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ، إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fee ahlika wa maalik, innamaa jazaa'us-salafil-hamdu wal-adaa'.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki katika familia yako na mali yako; kwani hakika malipo ya mkopo ni kushukuru na kulipa vizuri.
duas.english: May Allah bless you in your family and wealth; the only reward for borrowing is sincere praise and prompt repayment.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #195, An-Nasa'i in 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah #300
duas.virtue_sw: Huimarisha uaminifu, udugu na baraka ya mali baina ya wakopeshaji na wakopaji.
duas.virtue_en: Fosters trust, brotherhood, and financial barakah between creditors and debtors.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuona Mtu Aliyepatwa na Mtihani au Ulemavu
duas.title_en: Upon Seeing Someone Afflicted with Trial or Disability
duas.title_ar: دعاء من رأى مبتلى في دينه أو دنياه
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا ابْتَلاَكَ بِهِ، وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلاً.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee 'aafaanee mimmab-talaaka bih, wa fadh-dhalanee 'alaa katheerim-mimman khalaqa tafdheelaa.
duas.swahili: Sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ameniepusha na yale aliyokutahini nayo, na akanifadhilisha juu ya wengi katika aliowaumba kwa ubora mkubwa.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who has spared me from that with which He tested you, and favored me over much of what He created.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu anayeisoma kwa siri anapomwona mtu mwenye tatizo basi yeye binafsi ataepushwa na mtihani huo maisha yake yote.
duas.virtue_en: Recited privately; whoever recites it upon witnessing affliction will be protected from that tribulation throughout life.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupanda Mlima na Kushuka Bondeni
duas.title_en: When Ascending an Incline or Descending a Valley
duas.title_ar: التكبير عند الصعود والتسبيح عند الهبوط
duas.arabic: عِنْدَ الصُّعُودِ: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ. عِنْدَ النُّزُولِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Wakati wa kupanda: Allaahu Akbar. Wakati wa kushuka: Subhaanallaah.
duas.swahili: Unapopanda eneo la juu (mlima, ghorofa, ndege inapopaa) unasema: 'Allaahu Akbar'. Na unaposhuka (bonde, ngazi) unasema: 'Subhaanallaah'.
duas.english: When ascending: Allahu Akbar. When descending: SubhanAllah.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah aliyokuwa akiifuata Mtume ﷺ na masahaba safarini ili kukumbuka ukuu wa Allah pale mtu anapokuwa juu.
duas.virtue_en: Prophetic sunnah during travels; humbling oneself when elevated and glorifying Allah when descending.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kufika Mji au Kijiji Kipya Katika Safari
duas.title_en: Upon Entering a New Town or City
duas.title_ar: دعاء دخول القرية أو البلدة
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَظْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَمَا أَقْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَمَا أَضْلَلْنَ، وَرَبَّ الرِّيَاحِ وَمَا ذَرَيْنَ، أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ، وَخَيْرَ أَهْلِهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا فِيهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ أَهْلِهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i wa maa adhlaln, wa Rabbal-aradeenas-sab'i wa maa aqlaln, wa Rabbash-shayaateeni wa maa adhlaln, wa Rabbar-riyaahi wa maa dharayn, as'aluka khayra haadhihil-qaryah, wa khayra ahlihaa, wa khayra maa feehaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa, wa sharri ahlihaa, wa sharri maa feehaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wa mbingu saba na yale yaliyoyafunika, na Mola wa ardhi saba na yale yaliyoyabeba, na Mola wa mashetani na yale waliyoyapoteza, na Mola wa pepo na yale yaliyoyapeperusha; nakuomba kheri ya kijiji/mji huu, na kheri ya watu wake, na kheri ya yaliyomo ndani yake; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake, na shari ya watu wake, na shari ya yaliyomo ndani yake.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and all they overshadow, Lord of the seven earths and all they carry...
duas.virtue_sw: Hukuhakikishia usalama, ulinzi na mapokezi mazuri wakati wowote unaposafiri na kuingia eneo au nchi mpya.
duas.virtue_en: Guarantees safety, divine hospitality, and protection from harm when entering any foreign city or territory.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kurudi Kutoka Safarini
duas.title_en: Upon Returning from a Journey
duas.title_ar: دعاء الرجوع من السفر
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ، تَائِبُونَ، عَابِدُونَ، لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Aayiboona, taa'iboona, 'aabidoona, li-Rabbinaa haamidoon.
duas.swahili: Tumerudi tukiwa ni wenye kutubu, wenye kufanya ibada, na kwa Mola wetu Mlezi tukiwa ni wenye kumsifu na kumshukuru.
duas.english: We return repentant, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutamkwa na msafiri anapoanza kuikaribia nyumba yake au mji wake baada ya safari ndefu au fupi.
duas.virtue_en: Recited as the traveler approaches home, concluding the voyage with devotion, humility and gratitude.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Mwenye Kupokea Habari ya Furaha na Neema
duas.title_en: Upon Receiving Pleasing News or Good Tidings
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أتاه أمر يسره ونعمة
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahil-ladhee bi ni'matihee tatimmus-saalihaat.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye kwa neema Zake mambo mema yote yanakamilika.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah through Whose favor all good things are accomplished.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akisema maneno haya kila alipofikishiwa habari au jambo lenye kumfurahisha.
duas.virtue_en: The Prophet ﷺ uttered this whenever something pleased him, attributing all success to Allah.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kupokea Jambo Lisilopendeza au Huzuni
duas.title_en: Upon Encountering Displeasing News or Setback
duas.title_ar: دعاء من أتاه أمر يكرهه
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ.
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillaahi 'alaa kulli haal.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu katika kila hali.
duas.english: Praise be to Allah in all circumstances.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume ﷺ alikuwa akisema hivi anapokutana na changamoto au jambo lenye kuumiza, akionyesha kuridhika kamili na mipango ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Exemplifies complete submission and contentment with Allah's decree during setbacks.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuingia Makaburini (Kusalimia Wafu)
duas.title_en: When Visiting the Graveyard
duas.title_ar: دعاء زيارة القبور والسلام على أهلها
duas.arabic: السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ دَارَ قَوْمٍ مُؤْمِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لاَحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ.
duas.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum daara qawmim-mu'mineen, wa innaa in shaa'Allaahu bikum laahiqoon, nas'alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah.
duas.swahili: Amani iwe juu yenu enyi watu wa makazi ya waumini; na hakika sisi, Mwenyezi Mungu akipenda, tutajiunga nanyi; tunamuomba Mwenyezi Mungu atupe sisi nanyi salama na afya.
duas.english: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of this dwelling of believers; and we, if Allah wills, will soon join you. We ask Allah for well-being for us and for you.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kuwasalimia maiti na kuwaombea maghfira, na inamkumbusha mtembeleaji kuhusu ukweli wa mauti na maandalizi ya Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Honors the departed believers with prayers while serving as a profound reminder of mortality and the hereafter.

duas.title_sw: Dua Wakati wa Kuchinja Mnyama
duas.title_en: When Slaughtering an Animal
duas.title_ar: الدعاء عند ذبح الأضحية أو الذبيحة
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ، اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi wallaahu Akbar, Allaahumma minka wa lak, Allaahumma taqabbal minnee.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa zaidi. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, (mnyama huyu) anatoka Kwako na ni kwa ajili Yako; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, takabali kutoka kwangu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and Allah is the Greatest. O Allah, from You and for You; O Allah, accept this from me.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #221, Sahih Muslim 1967, Abu Dawud 2795
duas.virtue_sw: Inafanya uchinjaji kuwa ibada halali, yenye baraka, na inayokubaliwa mbele ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Sanctifies the slaughter as an act of pure worship and devotion to Allah alone.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Kinga dhidi ya Tabia Mbaya na Matamanio
duas.title_en: Seeking Refuge from Immorality and Evil Desires
duas.title_ar: الاستعاذة من منكرات الأخلاق والأهواء
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ مُنْكَرَاتِ الأَخْلاَقِ، وَالأَعْمَالِ، وَالأَهْوَاءِ، وَالأَدْوَاءِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min munkaraatil-akhlaaq, wal-a'maal, wal-ahwaa', wal-adwaa'.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi ninajikinga Kwako na tabia mbaya zilizokataliwa, na matendo maovu, na matamanio mabaya ya nafsi, na maradhi mabaya.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from evil character, wicked deeds, corrupt desires, and severe illnesses.
duas.virtue_sw: Kinga imara dhidi ya kupotoka kimaadili na kufuata matamanio yanayomuangamiza mtu.
duas.virtue_en: Potent defense against moral corruption, harmful impulses, and damaging inclinations.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Mapenzi ya Allah na Wanaompenda
duas.title_en: Asking for Allah's Love and the Love of Those Who Love Him
duas.title_ar: سؤال محبة الله ومحبة من يحبه
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ حُبَّكَ، وَحُبَّ مَنْ يُحِبُّكَ، وَالْعَمَلَ الَّذِي يُبَلِّغُنِي حُبَّكَ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ حُبَّكَ أَحَبَّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ نَفْسِي وَأَهْلِي وَمِنَ الْمَاءِ الْبَارِدِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka hubbak, wa hubba may-yuhibbuk, wal-'amalal-ladhee yuballighunee hubbak. Allaahummaj'al hubbaka ahabba ilayya min nafsee wa ahlee wa minal-maaa'il-baarid.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba mapenzi Yako, na mapenzi ya yule anayekupenda Wewe, na amali itakayonifikisha kwenye kupata mapenzi Yako. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, yafanye mapenzi Yako yawe yenye kupendeza zaidi kwangu kuliko nafsi yangu, familia yangu, na kuliko maji baridi (wakati wa kiu kikali).
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for Your love, the love of those who love You, and the deed that will bring me to Your love. O Allah, make Your love dearer to me than myself, my family, and cold water.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Dawud aliyokuwa akiifanya mara kwa mara; huleta upendo wa dhati wa kimungu moyoni.
duas.virtue_en: The supplication of Prophet Dawud cultivating genuine divine love above all earthly desires.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kumaliza Kusoma Qur'ani Tukufu (Khatm al-Quran)
duas.title_en: Upon Completing the Quran (Khatm al-Quran)
duas.title_ar: دعاء ختم القرآن الكريم
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنَا بِالْقُرْآنِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا إِمَامًا وَنُورًا وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةً، اللَّهُمَّ ذَكِّرْنَا مِنْهُ مَا نَسِينَا، وَعَلِّمْنَا مِنْهُ مَا جَهِلْنَا، وَارْزُقْنَا تِلاَوَتَهُ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ وَأَطْرَافَ النَّهَارِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا حُجَّةً يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummarhamnaa bil-Qur'aan, waj'alhu lanaa imaaman wa nooran wa hudan wa rahmah. Allaahumma dhakkirnaa minhu maa naseenaa, wa 'allimnaa minhu maa jahilnaa, warzuqnaa tilaawatahu aanaa'al-layli wa atraafan-nahaar, waj'alhu lanaa hujjatan yaa Rabbal-'aalameen.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, turehemu kwa baraka ya Qur'ani, na Uifanye iwe kiongozi wetu, na nuru, na mwongozo, na rehema kwetu. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tukumbushe kutoka kwayo yale tuliyoyasahau, na utufundishe yale tusiyoyajua, na uturuzuku kuisoma nyakati za usiku na ncha za mchana, na Uifanye iwe hoja ya kututetea Siku ya Kiyama, Ewe Mola wa walimwengu wote.
duas.english: O Allah, have mercy upon us through the Quran, and make it for us a guide, a light, a direction, and a mercy...
duas.reference: Al-Baghawi in Sharh as-Sunnah, Ad-Da'awat li-Ibn al-Mubarak
duas.virtue_sw: Dua mashuhuri ya kumalizia usomaji wa Qur'ani; wakati wa kumaliza Qur'ani ni miongoni mwa nyakati ambazo dua hujibiwa kwa wingi.
duas.virtue_en: A revered prayer upon completing the Quran, asking for its guidance, intercession and divine mercy.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru Katika Kila Kitu
duas.title_en: Comprehensive Supplication for Divine Light in All Aspects
duas.title_ar: دعاء سؤال النور الشامل
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي قَبْرِي نُورًا، وَبَيْنَ يَدَيَّ نُورًا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي نُورًا، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي نُورًا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِي نُورًا، وَفِي سَمْعِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَصَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي شَعْرِي نُورًا، وَفِي بَشَرِي نُورًا، وَفِي لَحْمِي نُورًا، وَفِي دَمِي نُورًا، وَفِي عِظَامِي نُورًا، اللَّهُمَّ أَعْظِمْ لِي نُورًا، وَأَعْطِنِي نُورًا، وَاجْعَلْنِي نُورًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj'al lee fee qalbee nooraa, wa fee qabree nooraa, wa bayna yadayya nooraa, wa min khalfee nooraa, wa 'an yameenee nooraa, wa 'an shimaalee nooraa, wa min fawqee nooraa, wa min tahtee nooraa, wa fee sam'ee nooraa, wa fee basaree nooraa, wa fee sha'ree nooraa, wa fee basharee nooraa, wa fee lahmee nooraa, wa fee damee nooraa, wa fee 'idhaamee nooraa. Allaahumma a'dhim lee nooraa, wa a'tinee nooraa, waj'alnee nooraa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nijaalie nuru moyoni mwangu, na ndani ya kaburi langu nuru, na mbele yangu nuru, na nyuma yangu nuru, na kuliani kwangu nuru, na kushotoni kwangu nuru, na juu yangu nuru, na chini yangu nuru, na katika masikio yangu nuru, na katika macho yangu nuru, na katika nywele zangu nuru, na katika ngozi yangu nuru, na katika nyama yangu nuru, na katika damu yangu nuru, na katika mifupa yangu nuru. Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, niongezee nuru kuu, na unipe nuru, na unifanye mimi niwe nuru.
duas.english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light in my grave, light before me, light behind me, light on my right, light on my left, light above me, light below me, light in my hearing, light in my sight, light in my hair, light in my skin, light in my flesh, light in my blood, light in my bones. O Allah, magnify light for me, bestow light upon me, and make me light.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujaza maisha ya muumini nuru ya mwongozo hapa duniani, ndani ya kaburi, na juu ya Sirat Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Illuminates the believer's life in this world, in the grave, and across the bridge of Sirat in the Hereafter.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kuondoa Chuki na Kinyongo Moyoni
duas.title_en: Purifying the Heart from Grudge, Envy and Ill-Will
duas.title_ar: دعاء سلامة الصدر وطهارة القلب من الغل
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالإِيمَانِ وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلاًّ لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ.
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal-lilladheena aamanoo Rabbanaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tusamehe sisi na ndugu zetu waliotutangulia katika imani, wala Usiweke katika nyoyo zetu chuki au kinyongo chochote dhidi ya wale walioamini; Mola wetu Mlezi, hakika Wewe ni Mpole sana, Mwenye kurehemu daima.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and put not in our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Full of Pity, Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutakasa roho, huleta amani na upendo safi baina ya Waislamu, na huondoa sumu ya chuki na uhasama.
duas.virtue_en: Purifies the heart from grudges, uniting believers in genuine mutual love and serenity.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua ya Kutoka Nyumbani
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua ya Kutoka Nyumbani
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, tawakkaltu 'alallaahi, wa laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, nimetawakali kwa Mwenyezi Mungu, na hakuna uwezo wala nguvu ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, and there is no power or strength except with Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu anapoisoma anapotoka nyumbani huambiwa na malaika: Umeongozwa, umetoshelezwa na umelindwa; na shetani hujitenga naye mbali.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #16, Abu Dawud 5095, Tirmidhi 3426.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua ya Kuingia Nyumbani
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua ya Kuingia Nyumbani
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَلَجْنَا، وَبِسْمِ اللَّهِ خَرَجْنَا، وَعَلَى اللَّهِ رَبِّنَا تَوَكَّلْنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi walajnaa, wa bismillaahi kharajnaa, wa 'alallaahi Rabbinaa tawakkalnaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tumeingia, na kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu tulitoka, na kwa Mwenyezi Mungu Mola wetu Mlezi tumetawakali.
duas.english: In the name of Allah we enter, and in the name of Allah we leave, and upon Allah our Lord we rely.
duas.virtue_sw: Kutaja jina la Allah unapoingia kunamzuia shetani kulala ndani ya nyumba au kula chakula cha familia hiyo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #18, Abu Dawud 5096.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua ya Kupanda Kipando au Chombo cha Usafiri
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua ya Kupanda Kipando au Chombo cha Usafiri
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanal-ladhee sakh-khara lanaa haadhaa wa maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen, wa innaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Yule aliyetutiishia hiki, na sisi tusingeliweza kukidhibiti; na hakika sisi ni wenye kurejea kwa Mola wetu Mlezi.
duas.english: Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it. And indeed, to our Lord we will return.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya safari inayokinga chombo dhidi ya ajali na uharibifu njiani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #206, Abu Dawud 2602.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua Kamili ya Kusafiri
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua Kamili ya Kusafiri
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى، اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innaa nas'aluka fee safarinaa haadhal-birra wat-taqwaa, wa minal-'amali maa tardaa, Allaahumma hawwin 'alaynaa safaranaa haadhaa wat-wi 'annaa bu'dah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika sisi tunakuomba katika safari yetu hii wema na ucha-Mungu, na katika amali yale unayoyaridhia; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tusahilishie safari yetu hii, na utufupishie umbali wake.
duas.english: O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds pleasing to You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and shorten its distance.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya kulindwa na machungu ya safari na kurejea salama kwa familia.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #206, Sahih Muslim 1342.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua ya Kurudi Kutoka Safarini
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua ya Kurudi Kutoka Safarini
duas.title_ar: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
duas.arabic: آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ.
duas.transliteration: Aayiboona taa'iboona 'aabidoona li-Rabbinaa haamidoon.
duas.swahili: Tunarudi tukiwa wenye kutubu, wenye kufanya ibada, na wenye kumhimidi Mola wetu Mlezi.
duas.english: We return repenting, worshipping, and praising our Lord.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufunga safari kwa shukrani na kuanza tena maisha ya nyumbani kwa baraka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #213, Sahih Muslim 1342.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Kila Siku: Dua ya Maisha ya Kila Siku 6
duas.title_en: Daily Living: Dua ya Maisha ya Kila Siku 6
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي كَفَانَا وَآوَانَا، فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ...

duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee kafaanaa wa aawaanaa, fa-kam mimman laa kaafiya lahoo wa laa mu'wiya. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametutosheleza na ametuhifadhi; kwani ni wangapi wasio na wa kuwatosheleza wala wa kuwahifadhi! [Dua ya Kila Siku 6]
duas.english: Praise be to Allah Who has sufficed us and sheltered us... [Daily Prayer 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Humfanya mja kuridhika na chakula, mavazi na makazi aliyopewa na Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for daily life from Hisn al-Muslim #103, Sahih Muslim 2715.

duas.title_sw: Dua za Kila Siku: Dua ya Kuvaa Nguo Mpya (Sehemu ya 71)
duas.title_en: Daily Living & Travel: Dua ya Kuvaa Nguo Mpya (Part 71)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ م...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ، أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma lakal-hamdu Anta kasawtaneehi, as'aluka min khayrihee wa khayri maa suni'a lah, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihee wa sharri maa suni'a lah. (Na. 71)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu sifa njema zote ni Zako, Wewe ndiye uliyenivika vazi hili; ninakuomba kheri yake na kheri ya kile kilichotengenezewa, na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake na shari ya kile kilichotengenezewa. [Dua ya Dua za Kila Siku Na. 71]
duas.english: O Allah, all praise is for You, You have clothed me with it... [Daily Living & Travel supplication #71]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Dua za Kila Siku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #31, Abu Dawud 4020 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kukubaliwa Amali Njema
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kukubaliwa Amali Njema
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيم...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa innaka Antas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tutakabalie (amali yetu); hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye kusikia, Mwenye kujua.
duas.english: Our Lord, accept [this] from us. Indeed You are the Hearing, the Knowing.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim na Ismail wakati wakijenga Kaaba; inafaa kusomwa baada ya amali njema yoyote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:127.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Utiifu na Kizazi Kinachotii
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Utiifu na Kizazi Kinachotii
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَاجْعَلْنَا مُسْلِمَيْنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَا أُمَّةً مُّسْلِمَةً لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبْ عَلَيْنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatinaa ummatam-muslimatal-laka wa arinaa manaasikanaa wa tub 'alaynaa innaka Antat-Tawwaabur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tujaalie tuwe wanyenyekevu Kwako, na katika vizazi vyetu ujaalie umma unaonyenyekea Kwako, na utuonyeshe ibada zetu na utukubalie toba yetu; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye kupokea toba, Mwenye kurehemu.
duas.english: Our Lord, and make us submissive to You and from our descendants a Muslim nation to You. And show us our ways of worship and accept our repentance. Indeed, You are the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim (a.s) ya kukiombea kizazi utiifu, toba na uongofu katika ibada zote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:128.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Mema Duniani na Akhera
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Mema Duniani na Akhera
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَس...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tupe duniani mema, na Akhera mema, na utukinge na adhabu ya Moto.
duas.english: Our Lord, give us in this world that which is good and in the Hereafter that which is good and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua iliyosomwa mara nyingi zaidi na Mtume (s.a.w); inakusanya kheri zote za dunia na Pepo Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:201.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Subira na Ushindi Dhidi ya Maadui
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Subira na Ushindi Dhidi ya Maadui
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا و...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa afrigh 'alaynaa sabran wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tummulie subira, na uimarishe nyayo zetu, na utusaidie tushinde watu makafiri.
duas.english: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya waumini walioongozwa na Talut; humimina utulivu na msimamo wakati wa mitihani mikubwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:250.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Msamaha wa Makosa na Kusahau
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Msamaha wa Makosa na Kusahau
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usituchukulie hatia tukisahau au tukikosea.
duas.english: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya ya mwisho ya Surat Al-Baqarah; inamsafisha muumini na dhiki ya makosa yasiyokusudiwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:286.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuondolewa Mizigo na Mazito ya Ziada
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuondolewa Mizigo na Mazito ya Ziada
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ ع...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahu 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitutwike mzigo mzito kama ulivyowatwika wale waliokuwa kabla yetu.
duas.english: Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us.
duas.virtue_sw: Humuomba Allah kuifanya sheria Yake na maisha ya mja kuwa mepesi bila vizuizi vizito.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:286.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Msamaha, Rehema na Nusra ya Mwisho
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Msamaha, Rehema na Nusra ya Mwisho
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا أَنتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa, Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitutwike tusiyoyaweza; na utusamehe, na utughufirie, na uturehemu; Wewe ndiye Mlinzi wetu, basi tusaidie tushinde watu makafiri.
duas.english: Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya yenye fadhila kuu; anayeisoma usiku anatoshelezwa na kulindwa na malaika dhidi ya mabalaa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:286.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Moyo Usipotoke Baada ya Haki
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Moyo Usipotoke Baada ya Haki
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَب...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wa hab lanaa mil-ladunka rahmah, innaka Antal-Wahhaab.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usizipotoe nyoyo zetu baada ya kwisha tuongoa, na utupe rehema kutoka Kwako; hakika Wewe ndiye Mpaji mkuu.
duas.english: Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya wenye hekima na elimu ya kweli ili kulinda nuru ya imani isipotee daima.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:8.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutambua Siku ya Malipo Isiyo na Shaka
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutambua Siku ya Malipo Isiyo na Shaka
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka jaami'un-naasi li-yawmil-laa rayba feeh, innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Wewe hakika ndiwe Mkusanyaji wa watu kwa Siku isiyo na shaka; hakika Mwenyezi Mungu havunji miadi.
duas.english: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not break His promise.
duas.virtue_sw: Humjaza muumini hofu yenye staha na kujiandaa vyema kwa matendo ya haki kabla ya mauti.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:9.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukiri Imani na Kuomba Kinga ya Moto
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukiri Imani na Kuomba Kinga ya Moto
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa qinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika sisi tumeamini, basi tufutie madhambi yetu, na utukinge na adhabu ya Moto.
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutajwa na waja wema wanaoswali usiku na kuomba msamaha wakati wa alfajiri.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:16.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukiri Ushuhuda Pamoja na Mashahidi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukiri Ushuhuda Pamoja na Mashahidi
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا بِمَا أَنزَلْتَ وَاتَّبَعْنَا الرَّسُولَ فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aamannaa bimaa anzalta wattaba'nar-rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumeyaamini uliyoyateremsha, na tumemfuata Mtume huyu, basi tuandike miongoni mwa wanaoshuhudia.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger, so register us among the witnesses [to truth].
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Hawariyyun (wafuasi wema wa Nabii Isa) ya kuthibitisha imani na utiifu kwa Mtume.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:53.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Msamaha wa Kupindukia Mipaka na Ushindi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Msamaha wa Kupindukia Mipaka na Ushindi
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِن...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِي أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa israafanaa fee amrinaa wa thabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tughufirie madhambi yetu, na kupita kwetu kiasi katika mambo yetu, na uimarishe nyayo zetu, na utusaidie tushinde watu makafiri.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya wacha-Mungu waliosimama imara pamoja na Mitume wao bila kulegea vitani au majaribuni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:147.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutafakari Uumbaji na Kujikinga na Moto
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutafakari Uumbaji na Kujikinga na Moto
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا مَا خَلَقْتَ هَٰذَا بَاطِلًا سُبْحَانَكَ فَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadhaa baatilan subhaanaka faqinaa 'adhaaban-naar.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hukuviumba hivi bure; Utukufu ni Wako, basi utukinge na adhabu ya Moto.
duas.english: Our Lord, You did not create this aimlessly; exalted are You [above such a thing]; then protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Ulul-Albab (wenye akili timamu) wanapotafakari uumbaji wa mbingu na ardhi usiku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:191.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kutofedheheshwa Siku ya Kiyama
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kutofedheheshwa Siku ya Kiyama
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ و...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ مَن تُدْخِلِ النَّارَ فَقَدْ أَخْزَيْتَهُ وَمَا لِلظَّالِمِينَ مِنْ أَنصَارٍ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-naara faqad akhzaytah, wa maa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika unayemtia Motoni, bila shaka umemhizi; na madhalimu hawatakuwa na wa kuwanusuru.
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaonesha kina cha hofu ya adhabu na kumuomba Allah atuepushe na aibu ya Jahannamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:192.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuitikia Mwito wa Imani na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuitikia Mwito wa Imani na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_ar: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَان...
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ آمِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَآمَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyay-yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo bi-Rabbikum fa-aamannaa, Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa sayyi'aatinaa wa tawaffanaa ma'al-abraar.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika sisi tumemsikia mwitaji anayeita kwenye Imani: Muaminini Mola wenu Mlezi; nasi tukaamini. Mola wetu Mlezi! Tughufirie madhambi yetu, na utufutie maovu yetu, na utufishe pamoja na watu wema.
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua mashuhuri ya kuomba mwisho mwema (Husnul Khatima) pamoja na watenda mema.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:193.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutaka Ahadi za Mitume na Kutofedheheshwa
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutaka Ahadi za Mitume na Kutofedheheshwa
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدتَّنَا عَلَىٰ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'attanaa 'alaa rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamah, innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Na utupe uliyotuahidi kwa vinywa vya Mitume wako, wala usitufedheheshe Siku ya Kiyama; hakika Wewe huvunji miadi.
duas.english: Our Lord, and grant us what You promised us through Your messengers and do not disgrace us on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, You do not fail in [Your] promise.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya ya mwisho ya dua za Ulul-Albab; Allah anajibu katika aya inayofuata: 'Mimi sipotezi amali ya mfanyao amali'.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:194.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukiri Imani ya Kweli Mbele ya Kitabu Kitukufu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukiri Imani ya Kweli Mbele ya Kitabu Kitukufu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاكْتُبْنَا مَعَ الشَّاهِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumeamini, basi tuandike pamoja na wanaoshuhudia (haki).
duas.english: Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya wale wanaosikia maneno ya Qur'ani kisha macho yao yakatiririka machozi kwa sababu ya kuitambua haki.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Ma'idah 5:83.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Meza ya Baraka na Riziki Kutoka Mbinguni
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Meza ya Baraka na Riziki Kutoka Mbinguni
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُون...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَنزِلْ عَلَيْنَا مَائِدَةً مِّنَ السَّمَاءِ تَكُونُ لَنَا عِيدًا لِّأَوَّلِنَا وَآخِرِنَا وَآيَةً مِّنكَ وَارْزُقْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّازِقِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa anzil 'alaynaa maa'idatam-minas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eedal-li-awwalinaa wa aakhirinaa wa aayatam-minka warzuqnaa wa Anta khayrur-raaziqeen.
duas.swahili: Ee Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuteremshie meza kutoka mbinguni, ili iwe sikukuu kwa ajili yetu, kwa wa mwanzo wetu na wa mwisho wetu, na iwe ni ishara itokayo Kwako; na uturuzuku, kwani Wewe ndiye Mbora wa watoao riziki.
duas.english: O Allah, our Lord, send down to us a table [spread with food] from the heaven to be for us a festival for the first of us and the last of us and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Isa (a.s) ya kuomba baraka, kutoshelezwa na riziki safi ya mbinguni.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Ma'idah 5:114.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukiri Madhambi na Kuomba Rehema ya Kuokoka
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukiri Madhambi na Kuomba Rehema ya Kuokoka
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَت...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَا أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa dhalamnaa anfusanaa wa illam taghfir lanaa wa tarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumedhulumu nafsi zetu, na usipotusamehe na kuturehemu, hakika tutakuwa miongoni mwa waliokhasirika.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya kwanza ya toba iliyoomba na Nabii Adam na mkewe Hawa; inavunja kiburi na kufuta madhambi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:23.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kutojumuishwa Pamoja na Madhalimu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kutojumuishwa Pamoja na Madhalimu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا مَعَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usituweke pamoja na watu madhalimu.
duas.english: Our Lord, do not place us with the wrongdoing people.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya watu wa Al-A'raf wanapotazama upande wa watu wa Motoni; inalinda dhidi ya uonevu na adhabu zao.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:47.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Hukumu ya Haki Kati Yetu na Watesi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Hukumu ya Haki Kati Yetu na Watesi
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا افْتَحْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمِنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْفَاتِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaftah baynanaa wa bayna qawminaa bil-haqqi wa Anta khayrul-faatiheen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hukumu baina yetu na kaumu yetu kwa haki, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanaohukumu.
duas.english: Our Lord, judge between us and our people in truth, and You are the best of judges.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Shu'ayb (a.s) alipokabiliwa na upinzani mkali wa makafiri; inaleta nusra na ufumbuzi wa haki.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:89.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Subira na Kufariki Katika Uislamu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Subira na Kufariki Katika Uislamu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَتَوَفَّنَا مُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa afrigh 'alaynaa sabran wa tawaffanaa muslimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tummulie subira na utufishe tukiwa Waislamu.
duas.english: Our Lord, pour upon us patience and let us die as Muslims [in submission to You].
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya wachawi wa Firauni walipoamini na kutishiwa kuuawa; inatoa ujasiri wa kutoyumba mbele ya vitisho.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:126.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuepushwa na Fitna za Madhalimu na Kuokolewa
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuepushwa na Fitna za Madhalimu na Kuokolewa
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ وَنَجِّنَا بِرَحْمَتِكَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal-lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen, wa najjinaa bi-rahmatika minal-qawmil-kaafireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitufanye mtihani kwa watu madhalimu, na utuokoe kwa rehema Yako na watu makafiri.
duas.english: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] trial for the wrongdoing people, and save us by Your mercy from the disbelieving people.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya wafuasi vijana wa Nabii Musa walipomtegemea Mwenyezi Mungu pekee mbele ya ukandamizaji.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yunus 10:85-86.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutambua Kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu Anajua Siri Zote
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutambua Kuwa Mwenyezi Mungu Anajua Siri Zote
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا ي...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِن شَيْءٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'lin, wa maa yakhfaa 'alallaahi min shay'in fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika Wewe unajua tunayoyaficha na tunayoyatangaza; na hakuna kitu chochote kinachofichika kwa Mwenyezi Mungu katika ardhi wala katika mbingu.
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from Allah on the earth or in the heaven.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim; inajenga unyofu wa nia na unyenyekevu mbele ya Ujuzi wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ibrahim 14:38.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kusimamisha Swala na Kizazi Chenye Kuswali
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kusimamisha Swala na Kizazi Chenye Kuswali
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّن...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee, Rabbanaa wa taqabbal du'aa'.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nijaalie niwe mwenye kusimamisha Swala, na katika kizazi changu pia; Mola wetu Mlezi, na ipokee dua yangu.
duas.english: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua tukufu ya kuhifadhi ibada ya Swala maishani mwako na kwa watoto na wajukuu zako wote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ibrahim 14:40.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuombea Msamaha Wazazi na Waumini Siku ya Hesabu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuombea Msamaha Wazazi na Waumini Siku ya Hesabu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lee wa li-waalidayya wa lil-mu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Nighufirie mimi na wazazi wangu wote wawili, na Waumini wote, Siku itaposimama Hesabu.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established.
duas.virtue_sw: Moja ya dua bora zaidi za kuwatendea wema wazazi na kuwaombea Waislamu wote maghfirah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ibrahim 14:41.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Rehema na Mwongozo Sahihi Katika Mambo Yetu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Rehema na Mwongozo Sahihi Katika Mambo Yetu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aatinaa mil-ladunka rahmah wa hayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tupe rehema kutoka Kwako, na tutengenezee uongofu katika jambo letu.
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Ashabul Kahf (vijana wa Pangoni); inasaidia kupata ufumbuzi sahihi na ulinzi katika nyakati ngumu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Kahf 18:10.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kinga Dhidi ya Jeuri na Uhasama
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kinga Dhidi ya Jeuri na Uhasama
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَا أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa nakhaafu ay-yafruta 'alaynaa aw ay-yatghaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika sisi tunaogopa asije akatupindukia mipaka au akafanya jeuri.
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa na Harun walipotumwa kwa Firauni; Mwenyezi Mungu aliwajibu: 'Msiogope, Hakika Mimi niko pamoja nanyi'.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Taha 20:45.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuepushwa na Adhabu Kali ya Jahannamu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuepushwa na Adhabu Kali ya Jahannamu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا ك...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanashrif 'annaa 'adhaaba jahannama inna 'adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa, innahaa saa'at mustaqarran wa muqaamaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuondolee adhabu ya Jahannamu; hakika adhabu yake ni yenye kuangamiza daima. Hakika hiyo ni kituo kibaya na makazi mabaya.
duas.english: Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering; indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya 'Ibadur-Rahman (waja wateule wa Mwingi wa Rehema); inalinda nafsi na moto wa milele.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Furqan 25:65-66.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Wenza Wema na Watoto Watulizao Macho
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Wenza Wema na Watoto Watulizao Macho
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wa dhurriyyatinaa qurrata a'yunin waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tupe katika wake zetu na wanetu watulizo la macho, na utujaalie tuwe viongozi kwa wacha-Mungu.
duas.english: Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua adhimu ya kutafuta utulivu wa ndoa, watoto wenye maadili mema na hadhi ya uongozi wa kiuchaji Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Furqan 25:74.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Malaika ya Kuombea Maghfirah Wanaotubu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Malaika ya Kuombea Maghfirah Wanaotubu
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَاغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ الْجَحِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shay'ir-rahmatan wa 'ilman faghfir lil-ladheena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim 'adhaabal-jaheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Umekienea kila kitu kwa rehema na ujuzi; basi waghafirie wale waliotubu na wakaifuata Njia Yako, na uwakinge na adhabu ya Jahannamu.
duas.english: Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua inayoomba Malaika wanaobeba Kiti cha Enzi (Arshi) kwa ajili ya waumini wanaotubu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:7.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Malaika ya Kuingiza Familia Peponi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Malaika ya Kuingiza Familia Peponi
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ الَّتِي وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّاتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'attahum wa man salaha min aabaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa dhurriyyaatihim, innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Na uwaingize katika Bustani za Milele (Pepo) ulizowaahidi, na wale waliokuwa wema miongoni mwa wazazi wao na wenza wao na vizazi vyao; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hekima.
duas.english: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forebears, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
duas.virtue_sw: Malaika wanawaombea waumini wakutane pamoja na familia zao zote zilizotenda mema ndani ya Pepo ya Firdausi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:8.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuomba Kulindwa na Maovu na Kupata Rehema Kuu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuomba Kulindwa na Maovu na Kupata Rehema Kuu
duas.title_ar: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ف...
duas.arabic: وَقِهِمُ السَّيِّئَاتِ وَمَن تَقِ السَّيِّئَاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Wa qihimus-sayyi'aat, wa man taqis-sayyi'aati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtah, wa dhaalika huwal-fawzul-'adheem.
duas.swahili: Na uwakinge na maovu; na yule unayemkinga na maovu Siku hiyo, basi hakika umemrehemu; na huko ndiko kufuzu kukubwa.
duas.english: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment.
duas.virtue_sw: Kukingwa na maovu siku ya Hukumu ndiyo ufunguo mkuu wa kuingia katika rehema za Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:9.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kuombea Maghfirah Walioamini Kabla Yetu na Kuzuia Chuki
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kuombea Maghfirah Walioamini Kabla Yetu na Kuzuia Chuki
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونَا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلًّا لِّلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaghfir lanaa wa li-ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani wa laa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal-lil-ladheena aamanoo, Rabbanaa innaka Ra'oofur-Raheem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tughufirie sisi na ndugu zetu waliotangulia mbele yetu kwa Imani; wala usijaalie ndani ya nyoyo zetu fundo la chuki dhidi ya wale walioamini; Mola wetu Mlezi, hakika Wewe ni Mpole sana, Mwenye kurehemu.
duas.english: Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Full of Pity, Merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Husafisha nyoyo dhidi ya husuda na chuki, na kujenga mshikamano wa kidugu wa waumini wote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Hashr 59:10.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutawakali kwa Allah na Kurejea Kwake Pekee
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutawakali kwa Allah na Kurejea Kwake Pekee
duas.title_ar: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَي...
duas.arabic: رَّبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa 'alayka tawakkalnaa wa ilayka anabnaa wa ilaykal-maseer.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Kwako tumetawakali, na Kwako tunarejea, na Kwako ndiko marejeo yetu ya mwisho.
duas.english: Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim; inathibitisha kuwa msaada, matumaini na kimbilio la mwisho viko kwa Allah pekee.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mumtahanah 60:4.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutofanywa Jaribio kwa Makafiri na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutofanywa Jaribio kwa Makafiri na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal-lil-ladheena kafaroo waghfir lanaa Rabbanaa, innaka Antal-'Azeezul-Hakeem.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Usitufanye mtihani kwa wale waliokufuru; na utughufirie, Mola wetu Mlezi; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye nguvu, Mwenye hekima.
duas.english: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
duas.virtue_sw: Huzuia madhalimu kuwashinda wema kisha wakadhani batili yao ndiyo ukweli.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mumtahanah 60:5.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukamilishiwa Nuru ya Imani na Maghfirah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukamilishiwa Nuru ya Imani na Maghfirah
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَل...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَتْمِمْ لَنَا نُورَنَا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa, innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tukamilishie nuru yetu, na utughufirie; hakika Wewe juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza.
duas.english: Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya waumini watakapokuwa wakivuka Sirat (daraja la Akhera) huku nuru yao ikiwaongoza mbele yao.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat At-Tahrim 66:8.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kukiri Uadilifu wa Allah na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kukiri Uadilifu wa Allah na Kuomba Msamaha
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ...
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta khayrur-raahimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tumeamini; basi tughufirie na uturehemu, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanaorehemu.
duas.english: Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya kundi la waja wema ambao walifanyiwa dhihaka duniani lakini wakapata ushindi mkuu Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mu'minun 23:109.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutambua Uumbaji Mzuri na Kumuomba Mola Mlezi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutambua Uumbaji Mzuri na Kumuomba Mola Mlezi
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shay'ir-rahmatan wa 'ilmaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Rehema Yako na ilimu Yako vimeenea kila kitu.
duas.english: Our Lord, You encompass all things in mercy and knowledge.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga matumaini makubwa kuwa rehema ya Mwenyezi Mungu ni pana zaidi kuliko udhaifu wowote wa mwanadamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:7.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Kutaka Kinga Dhidi ya Hasira ya Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Kutaka Kinga Dhidi ya Hasira ya Allah
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا اكْشِفْ عَنَّا الْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanak-shif 'annal-'adhaaba innaa mu'minoon.
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi! Tuondolee adhabu hii, hakika sisi tutaamini.
duas.english: Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers.
duas.virtue_sw: Hufundisha kuomba kuondolewa adhabu na misukosuko kwa kuweka ahadi ya unyofu na utiifu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ad-Dukhan 44:12.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Kufunguliwa Kifua na Ufasaha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Kufunguliwa Kifua na Ufasaha
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي وَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِي يَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbish-rah lee sadree wa yassir lee amree, wahlul 'uqdatam-mil-lisaanee yafqahoo qawlee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nikunjulie kifua changu, na unifanyie sahala jambo langu, na ufungue fundo katika ulimi wangu, wapate kufahamu maneno yangu.
duas.english: My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance] and ease for me my task and untie the knot from my tongue that they may understand my speech.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa kabla ya kulingania haki; inafaa sana kabla ya mitihani, mazungumzo au kazi nzito.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Taha 20:25-28.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kukiri Umaskini Mbele ya Kheri ya Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kukiri Umaskini Mbele ya Kheri ya Allah
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي لِمَا أَنزَلْتَ إِلَيَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi ni mhitaji wa kheri yoyote utakayoniteremshia.
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyoomba Musa (a.s) akiwa hana makazi wala kazi mjini Madyan; Allah akamfungulia kazi, ndoa na amani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qasas 28:24.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Msamaha Baada ya Kosa
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Msamaha Baada ya Kosa
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee dhalamtu nafsee faghfir lee.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi nimeidhulumu nafsi yangu, basi nighufirie.
duas.english: My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me.
duas.virtue_sw: Inafunza toba ya papo hapo mtu anapofanya kosa; Allah alimsamehe mara moja.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qasas 28:16.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Kuokolewa na Madhalimu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Musa: Kuomba Kuokolewa na Madhalimu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niokoe na watu madhalimu.
duas.english: My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.
duas.virtue_sw: Huvunja mitego ya madhalimu na kuleta uokozi wa Mwenyezi Mungu wakati wa kukimbia dhuluma.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qasas 28:21.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Yunus: Dua ya Dhul-Nun Katika Giza la Tumbo la Samaki
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Yunus: Dua ya Dhul-Nun Katika Giza la Tumbo la Samaki
duas.title_ar: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَ...
duas.arabic: لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Laa ilaaha illaa Anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Hapana mungu ila Wewe; Utukufu ni Wako, hakika mimi nilikuwa miongoni mwa wenye kudhulumu.
duas.english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Muislamu yeyote akiomba kwa dua hii katika shida yoyote ile, Allah humjibu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Anbiya 21:87.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Ayyub: Kuomba Kuondolewa Maradhi na Mateso
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Ayyub: Kuomba Kuondolewa Maradhi na Mateso
duas.title_ar: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Annee massaniyad-durru wa Anta Arhamur-raahimeen.
duas.swahili: Hakika mimi madhara yamenipata, na Wewe ndiye Mwingi wa rehema kuliko wote wanaorehemu.
duas.english: Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Ayyub (a.s) baada ya maradhi ya miaka mingi; Mwenyezi Mungu alimponya na kumrejeshea mara dufu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Anbiya 21:83.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Zakariya: Kuomba Mtoto Mwema
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Zakariya: Kuomba Mtoto Mwema
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi laa tadharnee fardan wa Anta khayrul-waaritheen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Usiniache peke yangu (bila mrithi), na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa warithio wote.
duas.english: My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya kupata kizazi chema; Allah alimpa mtoto Yahya licha ya uzee na mkewe kuwa mgumba.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Anbiya 21:89.
