duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Zakariya: Kuomba Kizazi Kitakatifu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Zakariya: Kuomba Kizazi Kitakatifu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَم...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ الدُّعَاءِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee mil-ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka Samee'ud-du'aa'.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe kutoka Kwako kizazi kizuri; hakika Wewe ndiye Mwenye kusikia maombi.
duas.english: My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication.
duas.virtue_sw: Huvuta baraka ya watoto wema wenye maadili ya kupigiwa mfano.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:38.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Mji wa Amani na Riziki ya Matunda
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Mji wa Amani na Riziki ya Matunda
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا بَلَدًا آمِنًا وَارْزُقْ أَهْلَهُ مِنَ الثَّمَرَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'al haadhaa baladan aaminan warzuq ahlahoo minath-thamaraat.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ufanye mji huu uwe wa amani, na uwaruzuku watu wake matunda mbalimbali.
duas.english: My Lord, make this a secure city and provide its people with fruits.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya amani na ustawi wa kiuchumi kwa nchi na jamii.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:126.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Hekima na Kuunganishwa na Watu Wema
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Hekima na Kuunganishwa na Watu Wema
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen, waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil-aakhireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe hekima, na uniunge na watu wema, na unijaalie kutajwa vizuri kwa wema na vizazi vya baadaye.
duas.english: My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous, and grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutafuta ilimu ya dhati na sifa njema ya kudumu inayowaletea wengine mwongozo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ash-Shu'ara 26:83-84.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Kuingizwa Pepo ya Neema
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kuomba Kuingizwa Pepo ya Neema
duas.title_ar: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Waj'alnee min warathati jannatin-na'eem.
duas.swahili: Na unijaalie niwe miongoni mwa warithi wa Bustani ya Neema (Pepo).
duas.english: And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
duas.virtue_sw: Lengo kuu la maisha ya mwanadamu; kuirithi Pepo ya daima.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ash-Shu'ara 26:85.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kutofedheheka Siku ya Ufufuo
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Ibrahim: Kutofedheheka Siku ya Ufufuo
duas.title_ar: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ ...
duas.arabic: وَلَا تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
duas.transliteration: Wa laa tukhzinee yawma yub'athoon, yawma laa yanfa'u maalun wa laa banoon, illaa man atallaaha bi-qalbin saleem.
duas.swahili: Wala usinifedheheshe Siku watapofufuliwa viumbe; Siku ambayo mali haitafaa kitu wala watoto, isipokuwa yule atakayemfikia Mwenyezi Mungu na moyo safi usio na dosari.
duas.english: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected - The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children, but only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga usafi wa roho (Qalbun Salim) ambao ndio salama pekee Siku ya Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ash-Shu'ara 26:87-89.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Sulaiman: Kuomba Kushukuru Neema Zote
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Sulaiman: Kuomba Kushukuru Neema Zote
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْت...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee bi-rahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe taufiki nishukuru neema Zako ulizonineemesha mimi na wazazi wangu, na nipate kutenda mema unayoyaridhia, na uniingize kwa rehema Yako miongoni mwa waja Wako wema.
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya shukrani kubwa aliyoomba Nabii Sulaiman; inazidisha neema na kuimarisha wema kwa wazazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat An-Naml 27:19.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Sulaiman: Kuomba Ufalme na Msamaha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Sulaiman: Kuomba Ufalme na Msamaha
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَّا يَنبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِّن بَعْدِي إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الْوَهَّابُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa hab lee mulkal-laa yambaghee li-ahadim-mim ba'dee, innaka Antal-Wahhaab.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nighufirie, na unipe ufalme ambao hautampasa yeyote baada yangu; hakika Wewe ndiye Mpaji mkuu.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.
duas.virtue_sw: Inaonesha namna ya kuanza toba kabla ya kuomba utajiri na nafasi kubwa ya uongozi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Sad 38:35.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Yusuf: Kusalimika na Mitego ya Fitna
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Yusuf: Kusalimika na Mitego ya Fitna
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ السِّجْنُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِمَّا يَدْعُونَنِي إِلَيْهِ وَإِلَّا تَصْرِفْ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُنَّ أَصْبُ إِلَيْهِنَّ وَأَكُن مِّنَ الْجَاهِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimmaa yad'oonanee ilayhi, wa illaa tasrif 'annee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa akum-minal-jaahileen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Gereza linanipendeza zaidi kuliko haya wanayoniitia; na usiponiondoshea hila zao, nitaelekea kwao na nitakuwa miongoni mwa wajinga.
duas.english: My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me. And if You do not avert from me their plan, I might incline toward them and be of the ignorant.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya kulinda usafi wa kimwili na kiroho mbele ya vishawishi vya uzinzi na maovu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yusuf 12:33.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Yusuf: Kuomba Mwisho Mwema na Utiifu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Yusuf: Kuomba Mwisho Mwema na Utiifu
duas.title_ar: أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِ...
duas.arabic: أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Anta Waliyyee fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, tawaffanee muslimaw-wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Wewe ndiwe Mlinzi wangu duniani na Akhera; nifishe nikiwa Muislamu, na uniunge na watu wema.
duas.english: You are my protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
duas.virtue_sw: Alisoma Nabii Yusuf baada ya kufikia kilele cha utajiri na heshima nchini Misri; inakumbusha akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yusuf 12:101.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Maghfirah kwa Wazazi na Waumini Wote
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Maghfirah kwa Wazazi na Waumini Wote
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُ...
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa li-waalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minaw-wa lil-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nighufirie mimi, na wazazi wangu wawili, na kila aingiaye nyumbani mwangu akiwa Muumini, na Waumini wote wanaume na Waumini wanawake.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua pana sana inayomletea muumini ujira mkubwa kwa kila muumini duniani anayemuombea.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Nuh 71:28.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Ulinzi Dhidi ya Kuomba Yasiyojulikana
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Ulinzi Dhidi ya Kuomba Yasiyojulikana
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِه...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِي بِهِ عِلْمٌ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِي وَتَرْحَمْنِي أَكُن مِّنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihee 'ilm, wa illaa taghfir lee wa tarhamnee akum-minal-khaasireen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hakika mimi najikinga Kwako nisije nikakuomba yale nisiyo na ilimu nayo; na usiponisamehe na kuturehemu, nitakuwa miongoni mwa waliokhasirika.
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga staha ya kutomuuliza Mwenyezi Mungu mambo kinyume na hekima Yake ya kiungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Hud 11:47.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Nusra Wakati wa Kuzidiwa
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Nusra Wakati wa Kuzidiwa
duas.title_ar: أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
duas.arabic: أَنِّي مَغْلُوبٌ فَانتَصِرْ
duas.transliteration: Annee maghloobun fantasir.
duas.swahili: Hakika mimi nimeshindwa; basi ninusuru!
duas.english: Indeed, I am overcome, so help [me].
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno mafupi lakini yenye uzito mkubwa sana wakati mtu anapozidiwa kabisa na dhiki.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qamar 54:10.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Kutua Mahali Penye Baraka
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Nuh: Kuomba Kutua Mahali Penye Baraka
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُن...
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْمُنزِلِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi anzilnee munzalam-mubaarakaw-wa Anta khayrul-munzileen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nitue mahali penye baraka, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wateremshao.
duas.english: My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].
duas.virtue_sw: Dua maridhawa unapoingia nyumba mpya, ofisi mpya, unaposafiri au kuanza makazi mapya.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mu'minun 23:29.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Kuingia na Kutoka kwa Ukweli
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Kuingia na Kutoka kwa Ukweli
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِ...
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِي مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ وَأَخْرِجْنِي مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ وَاجْعَل لِّي مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَانًا نَّصِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqiw-wa akhrijnee mukhraja sidqiw-waj'al lee mil-ladunka sultaanan naseeraa.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niingize mwingio wa kweli, na unitoshe mtoko wa kweli, na unipe kutoka Kwako mamlaka yenye kusaidia.
duas.english: My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Hijrah ya Mtume; husomwa unapoanza mradi mpya, kazi mpya au safari yoyote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Isra 17:80.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Kuzidishiwa Ilimu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Kuzidishiwa Ilimu
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nizidishie ilimu.
duas.english: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
duas.virtue_sw: Kitu pekee ambacho Allah alimwamuru Mtume Wake kukiomba kwa ziada ni Ilimu yenye manufaa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Taha 20:114.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kujikinga na Vishawishi vya Mashetani
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kujikinga na Vishawishi vya Mashetani
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ ب...
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِينِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen, wa a'oodhu bika Rabbi ay-yahduroon.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Najikinga Kwako na wasiwasi wa mashetani; na najikinga Kwako, Mola wangu Mlezi, wasije wakanikaribia.
duas.english: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.
duas.virtue_sw: Kinga madhubuti dhidi ya wasiwasi, hofu, maovu na ndoto mbaya.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mu'minun 23:97-98.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Maghfirah na Rehema ya Juu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Mtume Muhammad: Kuomba Maghfirah na Rehema ya Juu
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَارْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir warham wa Anta khayrur-raahimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ghufiria na urehemu, na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanaorehemu.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya ya mwisho ya Surat Al-Mu'minun; inafunga sura hiyo kwa unyenyekevu na kutafuta rehema kuu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mu'minun 23:118.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kutambua Utoshelevu wa Allah Peke Yake
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kutambua Utoshelevu wa Allah Peke Yake
duas.title_ar: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْت...
duas.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwa, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu ananitosha; hapana mungu ila Yeye; Kwake nimetawakali, Naye ndiye Mola Mlezi wa Kiti Kikuu cha Enzi.
duas.english: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
duas.virtue_sw: Anayeisoma mara saba asubuhi na jioni Allah humtosheleza katika mambo yake yote ya dunia na akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat At-Tawbah 9:129.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Umri wa Miaka 40: Kushukuru na Kuombea Vizazi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Umri wa Miaka 40: Kushukuru na Kuombea Vizazi
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْت...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa 'alaa waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee, innee tubtu ilayka wa innee minal-muslimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nipe taufiki nishukuru neema Zako ulizonineemesha mimi na wazazi wangu, na nitende mema unayoyaridhia, na unitengenezee wema katika vizazi vyangu; hakika mimi nimetubu Kwako, na hakika mimi ni miongoni mwa Waislamu.
duas.english: My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua maalum ya mtu anapofikia upeo wa utu uzima (miaka 40); inakusanya shukrani, toba na malezi ya kizazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Ahqaf 46:15.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Bibi Asiya (Mke wa Firauni): Kuomba Jumba Peponi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Bibi Asiya (Mke wa Firauni): Kuomba Jumba Peponi
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ ابْنِ لِي عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِي مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِ وَنَجِّنِي مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظَّالِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbib-ni lee 'indaka baytan fil-jannati wa najjinee min fir'awna wa 'amalihee wa najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nijengee Kwako nyumba Peponi, na uniokoe na Firauni na vitendo vyake, na uniokoe na watu madhalimu.
duas.english: My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people.
duas.virtue_sw: Mfano wa imani ya dhati ya mwanamke aliyekataa anasa za kifalme na kuchagua ujirani wa Allah Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat At-Tahrim 66:11.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Lut: Kuomba Kuokolewa na Matendo Machafu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Lut: Kuomba Kuokolewa na Matendo Machafu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِي وَأَهْلِي مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi najjinee wa ahlee mimmaa ya'maloon.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Niokoe mimi na familia yangu na haya wanayoyatenda.
duas.english: My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.
duas.virtue_sw: Humuomba Allah kuisitiri familia dhidi ya tabia chafu na mporomoko wa maadili katika mazingira.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ash-Shu'ara 26:169.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Lut: Kuomba Nusra Dhidi ya Waharibifu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Lut: Kuomba Nusra Dhidi ya Waharibifu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbinsurnee 'alal-qawmil-mufsideen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ninusuru dhidi ya watu waharibifu.
duas.english: My Lord, support me against the corrupting people.
duas.virtue_sw: Husaidia kuomba nusra dhidi ya wale wanaoharibu jamii na kupoteza maadili mema.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Ankabut 29:30.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Nabii Shuaib: Kutegemea Taufiki ya Allah Pekee
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Nabii Shuaib: Kutegemea Taufiki ya Allah Pekee
duas.title_ar: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِل...
duas.arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
duas.transliteration: Wa maa tawfeeqee illaa billaah, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa ilayhi uneeb.
duas.swahili: Na mafanikio yangu hayatoki ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; Kwake nimetawakali na Kwake ninarejea.
duas.english: And my success is not but through Allah. Upon Him I have relied, and to Him I return.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujaza mja unyenyekevu kuwa kila jambo jema linalofanikiwa linawezeshwa na Allah peke Yake.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Hud 11:88.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Waja Wema: Kumtakasa Mola Mlezi na Kumuomba Nuru
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Waja Wema: Kumtakasa Mola Mlezi na Kumuomba Nuru
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًا
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbinaa in kaana wa'du Rabbinaa lamaf'oolaa.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wetu Mlezi! Hakika ahadi ya Mola wetu Mlezi ni yenye kutimizwa.
duas.english: Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa na wenye hekima wanapouangukia uso wao kwa kusujudu na kulia kwa ajili ya maneno ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Isra 17:108.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu Hukumu ya Haki
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kumuomba Mwenyezi Mungu Hukumu ya Haki
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَا...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ احْكُم بِالْحَقِّ وَرَبُّنَا الرَّحْمَٰنُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbih-kum bil-haqq, wa Rabbunar-Rahmaanul-Musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Hukumu kwa haki; na Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwingi wa Rehema, Mwenye kuombwa msaada dhidi ya haya mnayoyazusha.
duas.english: My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya ya mwisho ya Surat Al-Anbiya; inamalizia changamoto zote kwa kumwachia Mwingi wa Rehema.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Anbiya 21:112.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Wacha-Mungu: Kuomba Pepo ya Salama
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Wacha-Mungu: Kuomba Pepo ya Salama
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَ...
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَذْهَبَ عَنَّا الْحَزَنَ إِنَّ رَبَّنَا لَغَفُورٌ شَكُورٌ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee adh-haba 'annal-hazana inna Rabbanaa la-Ghafoorun Shaakoor.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametuondolea huzuni; hakika Mola wetu Mlezi ni Mwingi wa maghfirah, Mwenye kupokea shukrani.
duas.english: Praise to Allah, who has removed from us [all] sorrow. Indeed, our Lord is Forgiving and Appreciative.
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno watakayoyasema watu wa Peponi baada ya kuvuka huzuni na taabu zote za duniani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Fatir 35:34.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kutambua Utukufu wa Ufalme wa Mbingu na Ardhi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kutambua Utukufu wa Ufalme wa Mbingu na Ardhi
duas.title_ar: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَ...
duas.arabic: قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ مَالِكَ الْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِي الْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَاءُ وَتَنزِعُ الْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَاءُ
duas.transliteration: Qulillaahumma Maalikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tashaa'u wa tanzi'ul-mulka mimman tashaa'u wa tu'izzu man tashaa'u wa tudhillu man tashaa'u biyadikal-khayr innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
duas.swahili: Sema: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mfalme wa falme zote! Unampa ufalme umtakaye, na unamnyang'anya ufalme umtakaye, na unamtukuza umtakaye, na unamdhalilisha umtakaye; kheri yote imo mikononi Mwako; hakika Wewe juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza.
duas.english: Say, 'O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.'
duas.virtue_sw: Inatibu hofu ya vyeo na hadhi za kibinadamu, ikithibitisha kuwa riziki na heshima vinatoka kwa Allah pekee.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ali 'Imran 3:26.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Rehema na Msamaha kwa Ndugu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Rehema na Msamaha kwa Ndugu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأ...
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِأَخِي وَأَدْخِلْنَا فِي رَحْمَتِكَ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa li-akhee wa adkhilnaa fee rahmatika wa Anta Arhamur-raahimeen.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Nighufirie mimi na ndugu yangu, na utuingize katika rehema Yako, na Wewe ndiye Mwingi wa rehema kuliko wote wanaorehemu.
duas.english: My Lord, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy; and You are the most merciful of the merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa alipomkumbatia nduguye Harun; inajenga mapenzi na msamaha kati ya ndugu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:151.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kutaka Mwisho Mwema wa Maisha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kutaka Mwisho Mwema wa Maisha
duas.title_ar: تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.arabic: تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Tawaffanee muslimaw-wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Nifishe nikiwa Muislamu, na uniunge na watu wema.
duas.english: Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua fupi lakini nzito ya kuomba kufariki ukiwa kwenye imani safi ya Kiislamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yusuf 12:101.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Msaada Dhidi ya Watu Madhalimu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Msaada Dhidi ya Watu Madhalimu
duas.title_ar: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
duas.arabic: رَبِّ انصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbinsurnee bimaa kadhdhaboon.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Ninusuru kwa sababu wamenikanusha.
duas.english: My Lord, support me because they have denied me.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutumiwa na waja wema pale wanapokabiliwa na uongo na tuhuma zisizo na msingi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Mu'minun 23:26.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Shukurani kwa Kuondolewa Watu Madhalimu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Shukurani kwa Kuondolewa Watu Madhalimu
duas.title_ar: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالْحَمْدُ لِ...
duas.arabic: فَقُطِعَ دَابِرُ الْقَوْمِ الَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Faquti'a daabirul-qawmil-ladheena dhalamoo, walhamdulillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen.
duas.swahili: Kukakatwa mzizi wa kaumu ya wale waliodhulumu; na sifa zote njema ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
duas.english: So the people that committed wrong were eliminated. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
duas.virtue_sw: Shukurani kwa Mola pale haki inaposimama na dhuluma inapoangamia.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-An'am 6:45.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kujisalimisha Kikamilifu kwa Mola wa Ulimwengu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kujisalimisha Kikamilifu kwa Mola wa Ulimwengu
duas.title_ar: إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِ...
duas.arabic: إِنَّ صَلَاتِي وَنُسُكِي وَمَحْيَايَ وَمَمَاتِي لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Inna salaatee wa nusukee wa mahyaaya wa mamaatee lillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen.
duas.swahili: Hakika Swala yangu, na ibada zangu, na uhai wangu, na mauti yangu, ni kwa ajili ya Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
duas.english: Indeed, my prayer, my rites of sacrifice, my living and my dying are for Allah, Lord of the worlds.
duas.virtue_sw: Kauli mbiu ya maisha ya Muislamu ya kujitolea kila pumzi na tendo kwa ajili ya radhi za Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-An'am 6:162.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Mwelekeo Sahihi wa Safari
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Mwelekeo Sahihi wa Safari
duas.title_ar: عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
duas.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبِّي أَن يَهْدِيَنِي سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ
duas.transliteration: 'Asaa Rabbee ay-yahdiyanee sawaa'as-sabeel.
duas.swahili: Huenda Mola wangu Mlezi akaniongoza kwenye njia iliyo sawa.
duas.english: Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way.
duas.virtue_sw: Alisoma Nabii Musa akielekea Madyan; inafaa kusomwa unapotafuta uamuzi sahihi maishani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qasas 28:22.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kutambua Utukufu wa Allah Dhidi ya Ushirikina
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kutambua Utukufu wa Allah Dhidi ya Ushirikina
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَام...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbika Rabbil-'Izzati 'ammaa yasifoon, wa salaamun 'alal-mursaleen, walhamdulillaahi Rabbil-'aalameen.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mola wako Mlezi, Mola Mwenye enzi na utukufu, na yale wanayomsingizia; na amani iwe juu ya Mitume; na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa walimwengu wote.
duas.english: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe. And peace upon the messengers. And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya hizi husomwa kama hitimisho la mabaraza ya kidini, zikileta baraka na utakaso.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat As-Saffat 37:180-182.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Wazazi: Kuomba Huruma ya Malezi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Wazazi: Kuomba Huruma ya Malezi
duas.title_ar: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.arabic: رَّبِّ ارْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِي صَغِيرًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbir-hamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa.
duas.swahili: Mola wangu Mlezi! Warehemu (wazazi wangu) kama walivyonilea nikiwa mdogo.
duas.english: My Lord, have mercy upon them [my parents] as they brought me up [when I was] small.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua bora zaidi ya mtoto mwema kuwaombea wazazi wake huruma na upole wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Isra 17:24.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kutuliza Huzuni kwa Kumlalamikia Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kutuliza Huzuni kwa Kumlalamikia Allah
duas.title_ar: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
duas.arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Innamaa ashkoo baththee wa huznee ilallaah.
duas.swahili: Hakika mimi nakitolea malalamiko yangu na huzuni yangu kwa Mwenyezi Mungu pekee.
duas.english: I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Kauli ya Nabii Ya'qub wakati wa mtihani wa kumpoteza mwanawe; inamfundisha mja kumueleza Allah huzuni zake zote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yusuf 12:86.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuthibitisha Kuwa Allah Ndiye Mlinzi Mbora
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuthibitisha Kuwa Allah Ndiye Mlinzi Mbora
duas.title_ar: فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.arabic: فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Fallaahu khayrun haafidhan wa Huwa Arhamur-raahimeen.
duas.swahili: Basi Mwenyezi Mungu ndiye Mbora wa kuhifadhi, Naye ndiye Mwingi wa rehema kuliko wote wanaorehemu.
duas.english: So Allah is the best guardian, and He is the most merciful of the merciful.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa kwa ajili ya ulinzi wa watoto, mali na safari zote.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Yusuf 12:64.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Ayat Al-Kursi: Ufalme na Uhai wa Kudumu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Ayat Al-Kursi: Ufalme na Uhai wa Kudumu
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ
duas.transliteration: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhuu sinatuw-wa laa nawm.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu, hapana mungu ila Yeye, Aliye Hai daima, Msimamia kila kitu; kusinzia hakumshiki wala kulala.
duas.english: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya kuu zaidi katika Qur'ani nzima; anayeisoma baada ya kila swala ya faradhi hakuna kinachomzuia kuingia Peponi isipokuwa kifo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:255.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Amanar-Rasul: Ushuhuda wa Imani Kamili
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Amanar-Rasul: Ushuhuda wa Imani Kamili
duas.title_ar: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُ...
duas.arabic: آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ
duas.transliteration: Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir-Rabbihee wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billaahi wa malaa'ikatihee wa kutubihee wa rusulih.
duas.swahili: Mtume ameamini yale yaliyoteremshwa kwake kutoka kwa Mola wake Mlezi, na Waumini vilevile; wote wamemwamini Mwenyezi Mungu, na Malaika Wake, na Vitabu Vyake, na Mitume Yake.
duas.english: The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya mbili za mwisho za Al-Baqarah; anayezisoma usiku zinamkinga na kila shari.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Baqarah 2:285.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Surat Al-Fatihah: Kuomba Njia Iliyonyooka
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Surat Al-Fatihah: Kuomba Njia Iliyonyooka
duas.title_ar: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَم...
duas.arabic: اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
duas.transliteration: Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem, Siraatal-ladheena an'amta 'alayhim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alayhim wa lad-daalleen.
duas.swahili: Tuongoze kwenye njia iliyonyooka; njia ya wale uliowaneemesha, siyo ya wale walioghadhibikiwa wala ya waliopotea.
duas.english: Guide us to the straight path - The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray.
duas.virtue_sw: Ummul-Kitab; dua kuu inayorudiwa katika kila rakaa ya swala ya Muislamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Fatihah 1:6-7.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Surat Al-Ikhlas: Kuthibitisha Umoja na Utakaso wa Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Surat Al-Ikhlas: Kuthibitisha Umoja na Utakaso wa Allah
duas.title_ar: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَم...
duas.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration: Qul Huwallaahu Ahad, Allaahus-Samad, lam yalid wa lam yoolad, wa lam yakul-lahoo kufuwan ahad.
duas.swahili: Sema: Yeye Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mmoja tu; Mwenyezi Mungu Mwenye kutegemewa na viumbe vyote; Hakuzaa wala hakuzaliwa; Wala hana anayefanana Naye hata mmoja.
duas.english: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
duas.virtue_sw: Inalingana na theluthi moja ya Qur'ani kwa uzito na ubora wa tauhidi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Surat Al-Falaq: Kujikinga na Shari ya Viumbe na Hasadi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Surat Al-Falaq: Kujikinga na Shari ya Viumbe na Hasadi
duas.title_ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَ...
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ وَمِن شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbil-falaq, min sharri maa khalaq, wa min sharri ghaasiqin idhaa waqab, wa min sharrin-naffaathaati fil-'uqad, wa min sharri haasidin idhaa hasad.
duas.swahili: Sema: Najikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa mapambazuko; na shari ya vile Alivyoviumba; na shari ya giza linapoingia; na shari ya wanaopulizia mafundoni; na shari ya hasidi anapohusudu.
duas.english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak From the evil of that which He created And from the evil of darkness when it settles And from the evil of the blowers in knots And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
duas.virtue_sw: Kinga kuu dhidi ya uchawi, jicho baya na hasadi za wanadamu na majini.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Falaq 113:1-5.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Surat An-Nas: Kujikinga na Wasiwasi wa Mashetani
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Surat An-Nas: Kujikinga na Wasiwasi wa Mashetani
duas.title_ar: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّا...
duas.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ مِن شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.transliteration: Qul a'oodhu bi-Rabbin-naas, Malikin-naas, Ilaahin-naas, min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas, alladhee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas, minal-jinnati wan-naas.
duas.swahili: Sema: Najikinga kwa Mola Mlezi wa watu; Mfalme wa watu; Mungu wa watu; na shari ya mwenye kutia wasiwasi anayerudi nyuma; anayetia wasiwasi katika vifua vya watu; miongoni mwa majini na watu.
duas.english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind. The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'
duas.virtue_sw: Ulinzi wa mwisho dhidi ya wasiwasi wa kiibilisi katika fikra na nyoyo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat An-Nas 114:1-6.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kumtegemea Allah Wakati wa Mitihani
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kumtegemea Allah Wakati wa Mitihani
duas.title_ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ ش...
duas.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَالِغُ أَمْرِهِ قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدْرًا
duas.transliteration: Innallaaha baalighu amrihee, qad ja'alallaahu li-kulli shay'in qadraa.
duas.swahili: Hakika Mwenyezi Mungu anatimiza amri Yake; Mwenyezi Mungu amekwisha wekea kila kitu kipimo chake.
duas.english: Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
duas.virtue_sw: Humfariji mwenye dhiki kuwa kila ugumu una mwisho wake uliopangwa kwa hekima ya Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat At-Talaq 65:3.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Faraja Baada ya Dhiki
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Faraja Baada ya Dhiki
duas.title_ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
duas.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
duas.transliteration: Fa-inna ma'al-'usri yusraa, inna ma'al-'usri yusraa.
duas.swahili: Basi hakika pamoja na dhiki kuna faraja; hakika pamoja na dhiki kuna faraja.
duas.english: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease. Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
duas.virtue_sw: Ahadi ya Mwenyezi Mungu kuwa hakuna dhiki inayodumu; kila jaribu linafuatiwa na wepesi wawili.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ash-Sharh 94:5-6.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kushukuru kwa Uongofu wa Uislamu
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kushukuru kwa Uongofu wa Uislamu
duas.title_ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِهَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِن...
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي هَدَانَا لِهَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِنَهْتَدِيَ لَوْلَا أَنْ هَدَانَا اللَّهُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillaahil-ladhee hadaanaa li-haadhaa wa maa kunnaa linahtadiya lawlaa an hadaanallaah.
duas.swahili: Sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu ambaye ametuongoza kwenye haya; na tusingelikuwa wenye kuongoka kama Mwenyezi Mungu asingelituongoza.
duas.english: Praise to Allah, who has guided us to this; and we would never have been guided if Allah had not guided us.
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno ya unyenyekevu ya waja wa Peponi wakitambua neema kuu ya Uislamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-A'raf 7:43.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Rehema ya Kuwa Pamoja na Mitume na Wema
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Rehema ya Kuwa Pamoja na Mitume na Wema
duas.title_ar: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مَعَ الَّذِين...
duas.arabic: وَمَن يُطِعِ اللَّهَ وَالرَّسُولَ فَأُولَٰئِكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Wa may-yuti'illaaha war-Rasoola fa-oolaa'ika ma'al-ladheena an'amallaahu 'alayhim minan-nabiyyeena was-siddeeqeena wash-shuhadaa'i was-saaliheen.
duas.swahili: Na wenye kumtii Mwenyezi Mungu na Mtume, hao watakuwa pamoja na wale ambao Mwenyezi Mungu amewaneemesha miongoni mwa Mitume, na Masiddiqi, na Mashahidi, na Watu wema.
duas.english: And whoever obeys Allah and the Messenger - those will be with the ones upon whom Allah has bestowed favor of the prophets, the steadfast affirmers of truth, the martyrs and the righteous.
duas.virtue_sw: Inawapa matumaini wanaomfuata Mtume (s.a.w) kupata urafiki wa Peponi na viongozi wa umma.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat An-Nisa 4:69.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Mwisho Mwema wa Maisha
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Mwisho Mwema wa Maisha
duas.title_ar: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَ...
duas.arabic: يَا أَيَّتُهَا النَّفْسُ الْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ارْجِعِي إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً فَادْخُلِي فِي عِبَادِي وَادْخُلِي جَنَّتِي
duas.transliteration: Yaa ayyatuhan-nafsul-mutma'innah, irji'ee ilaa Rabbiki raadiyatam-mardiyyah, fadkhulee fee 'ibaadee, wadkhulee jannatee.
duas.swahili: Ewe nafsi iliyotua! Rejea kwa Mola wako Mlezi ukiwa umeridhika na umeridhiwa; basi ingia miongoni mwa waja Wangu, na ingia katika Pepo Yangu.
duas.english: [To the righteous it will be said], 'O reassured soul, Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him], And enter among My [righteous] servants And enter My Paradise.'
duas.virtue_sw: Ujumbe mtukufu wa utulivu wa roho wakati wa kutoka duniani na kupokelewa Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Fajr 89:27-30.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kuomba Ulinzi Dhidi ya Jeuri na Kiburi
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kuomba Ulinzi Dhidi ya Jeuri na Kiburi
duas.title_ar: إِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّ...
duas.arabic: إِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
duas.transliteration: Innee 'udhtu bi-Rabbee wa Rabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril-laa yu'minu bi-yawmil-hisaab.
duas.swahili: Hakika mimi najikinga kwa Mola wangu Mlezi na Mola wenu Mlezi dhidi ya kila mwenye kiburi asiyeamini Siku ya Hesabu.
duas.english: Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Nabii Musa alipotishiwa na Firauni; inalinda dhidi ya dharau na jeuri ya wenye mamlaka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:27.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kukabidhi Mambo kwa Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kukabidhi Mambo kwa Allah
duas.title_ar: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِال...
duas.arabic: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
duas.transliteration: Wa ufawwidu amree ilallaah, innallaaha Baseerum-bil-'ibaad.
duas.swahili: Nami ninamkabidhi Mwenyezi Mungu mambo yangu; hakika Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mwenye kuwaona waja Wake vizuri.
duas.english: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Muumini wa nyumba ya Firauni; Allah alimkinga mara moja na njama zote mbaya zilizopangwa dhidi yake.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ghafir 40:44.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Wacha-Mungu: Kuomba Faraja ya Nyuso Zao Siku ya Kiyama
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Wacha-Mungu: Kuomba Faraja ya Nyuso Zao Siku ya Kiyama
duas.title_ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
duas.arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
duas.transliteration: Wujoohuy-yawma'idhin naadirah, ilaa Rabbihaa naadhirah.
duas.swahili: Nyuso Siku hiyo zitang'ara kwa furaha, zikimtazama Mola wao Mlezi.
duas.english: [Some] faces, that Day, will beam looking at their Lord.
duas.virtue_sw: Lengo kuu na neema ya juu kabisa Peponi; kutazama Uso Mtukufu wa Allah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Al-Qiyamah 75:22-23.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kupata Riziki Isiyotarajiwa kwa Kumcha Allah
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kupata Riziki Isiyotarajiwa kwa Kumcha Allah
duas.title_ar: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ م...
duas.arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ
duas.transliteration: Wa may-yattaqillaaha yaj'al lahoo makhrajaa, wa yarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasib.
duas.swahili: Na yule anayemcha Mwenyezi Mungu humtengenezea njia ya kutokea, na humruzuku kutoka pale asipopatazamia.
duas.english: And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out and will provide for him from where he does not expect.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua na ukumbusho mkuu kuwa ucha-Mungu ndio ufunguo wa kutatua matatizo yote na kupata riziki isiyo na kikomo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat At-Talaq 65:2-3.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Qur'ani: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah Asubuhi na Jioni
duas.title_en: Quranic Supplication: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah Asubuhi na Jioni
duas.title_ar: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ وَلَ...
duas.arabic: فَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
duas.transliteration: Fa-subhaanallaahi heena tumsoona wa heena tusbihoon, wa lahul-hamdu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa 'ashiyyaw-wa heena tudh-hiroon.
duas.swahili: Basi Mtakaseni Mwenyezi Mungu mnapoingia jioni na mnapoamka asubuhi; na sifa zote njema ni Zake mbinguni na ardhini, na alasiri na wakati wa adhuhuri.
duas.english: So exalted is Allah when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning. And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth and at night and when you are at noon.
duas.virtue_sw: Aya zenye fadhila ya kulipa dhikr zilizopotea wakati wa mchana na usiku.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Quranic prayer from Surat Ar-Rum 30:17-18.

duas.title_sw: Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-Imran: Kufuata Haki na Kutotetereka (Sehemu ya 101)
duas.title_en: Quranic Duas & Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-Imran: Kufuata Haki na Kutotetereka (Part 101)
duas.title_ar: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ
duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ مَا نُخْفِي وَمَا نُعْلِنُ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wa maa nu'lin. (Na. 101)
duas.swahili: Mola wetu Mlezi hakika Wewe unajua yote tunayoyaficha na tunayoyatangaza. [Dua ya Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana Na. 101]
duas.english: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare. [Quranic Duas & Rabbana supplication #101]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Surat Ibrahim 14:38 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-Baqarah: Ahadi ya Waumini (Sehemu ya 102)
duas.title_en: Quranic Duas & Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-Baqarah: Ahadi ya Waumini (Part 102)
duas.title_ar: سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَص...
duas.arabic: سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaykal-maseer. (Na. 102)
duas.swahili: Tumesikia na tumetii; tunakuomba msamaha Wako Mola wetu Mlezi na Kwako ndiko marejeo yetu ya mwisho. [Dua ya Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana Na. 102]
duas.english: We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord... [Quranic Duas & Rabbana supplication #102]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Surat Al-Baqarah 2:285 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-A'raf: Kumuomba Allah Uongofu (Sehemu ya 103)
duas.title_en: Quranic Duas & Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-A'raf: Kumuomba Allah Uongofu (Part 103)
duas.title_ar: أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ...
duas.arabic: أَنتَ وَلِيُّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْغَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration: Anta Waliyyunaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa Anta Khayrul-ghaafireen. (Na. 103)
duas.swahili: Wewe ndiye Mlinzi wetu basi tughufirie na uturehemu na Wewe ndiye Mbora wa wanaoghufiria. [Dua ya Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana Na. 103]
duas.english: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of forgivers. [Quranic Duas & Rabbana supplication #103]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Dua za Qur'ani na Rabbana.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Surat Al-A'raf 7:155 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_ar: سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَص...

duas.title_en: Quranic Duas & Rabbana: Dua ya Surat Al-A'raf: Kumuomba Allah Uongofu (Part 196)

duas.english: You are our Protector, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of forgivers. [Quranic Duas & Rabbana supplication #196]

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya Mtume Wakati wa Kumtembelea Mgonjwa (Adh-hibil-ba's)
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya Mtume Wakati wa Kumtembelea Mgonjwa (Adh-hibil-ba's)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، وَاشْفِ أَنْت...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، أَذْهِبِ الْبَأْسَ، وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي، لَا شِفَاءَ إِلَّا شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لَا يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabban-naas, adh-hibil-ba's, washfi Antash-Shaafee, laa shifaa'a illaa shifaa'uk, shifaa'al-laa yughaadiru saqamaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola Mlezi wa watu wote! Ondoa maradhi haya na uponye; Wewe ndiye Mponyaji, hakuna uponyaji ila uponyaji Wako, uponyaji usioacha ugonjwa wowote.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of mankind, remove the disease and bring healing. You are the Healer; there is no healing except Your healing, a healing that leaves behind no illness.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alikuwa akimpapasa mgonjwa kwa mkono wake wa kulia na kumsomea maneno haya; inaleta uponyaji wa haraka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim #148, Sahih al-Bukhari 5675, Muslim 2191.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya As'alullahal-Adheem Mara Saba kwa Mgonjwa
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya As'alullahal-Adheem Mara Saba kwa Mgonjwa
duas.title_ar: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ ...
duas.arabic: أَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ أَنْ يَشْفِيَكَ.
duas.transliteration: As'alullaahal-'Adheema Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheemi ay-yashfiyak.
duas.swahili: Ninamwomba Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mtukufu, Mola Mlezi wa Kiti Kikuu cha Enzi, akuponye.
duas.english: I ask Allah the Almighty, Lord of the Magnificent Throne, to heal you.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Muislamu anapomtembelea mgonjwa kabla ya kufika ajali yake akamsomea mara 7, Allah humponya ugonjwa huo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim #147, Abu Dawud 3106, Tirmidhi 2083.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya Ruqyah ya Jibril kwa Mtume Muhammad
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya Ruqyah ya Jibril kwa Mtume Muhammad
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ، مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ، اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi arqeek, min kulli shay'iy-yu'dheek, min sharri kulli nafsin aw 'ayni haasid, Allaahu yashfeek, bismillaahi arqeek.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu ninakufanyia ruqyah, dhidi ya kila kitu kinachokuumiza, na dhidi ya shari ya kila nafsi au jicho la hasidi; Mwenyezi Mungu akuponye; kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu ninakufanyia ruqyah.
duas.english: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.
duas.virtue_sw: Malaika Jibril alimfanyia Mtume (s.a.w) ruqyah hii alipokuwa mgonjwa; inatibu maradhi ya kiroho na kimwili.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim #149, Sahih Muslim 2186.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya Mwenye Kuumwa Maumivu Mwilini
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya Mwenye Kuumwa Maumivu Mwilini
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِ...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ (ثَلَاثًا)، أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ (سَبْعًا).
duas.transliteration: Bismillaah (mara 3), kisha: A'oodhu billaahi wa qudratihee min sharri maa ajidu wa uhaadhir (mara 7).
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 3). Kisha: Najikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu na Uweza Wake kutokana na shari ya ninachokihisi na ninachokiogopa (mara 7).
duas.english: In the name of Allah (thrice). Then: I seek refuge in Allah and His power from the evil of what I feel and fear (seven times).
duas.virtue_sw: Weka mkono wako mahali penye maumivu mwilini kisha soma maneno haya; huondoa maumivu ya viungo, meno na tumbo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim #150, Sahih Muslim 2202.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya Kumuombea Mgonjwa Thawabu na Utakaso
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya Kumuombea Mgonjwa Thawabu na Utakaso
duas.title_ar: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.arabic: لَا بَأْسَ طَهُورٌ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Laa ba'sa tahoorun in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Hakuna neno, ni utakaso (wa madhambi) In sha Allah.
duas.english: Do not worry, it is a purification [from sins], if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kumliwaza na kumpa matumaini mgonjwa kuwa maumivu yake yanamfutia madhambi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim #146, Sahih al-Bukhari 5656.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Afya: Dua ya Afya na Kinga ya Maradhi 6
duas.title_en: Health Supplication: Dua ya Afya na Kinga ya Maradhi 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَا...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَاءٍ وَسَقَمٍ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, Allaahumma 'aafinee min kulli balaa'in wa saqam. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba afya na amani duniani na Akhera; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nikinge na kila baa na ugonjwa. [Afya Dua 6]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter... [Health Supplication 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Huimarisha ulinzi wa mwili na kuzuia magonjwa ya mlipuko.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim, Tirmidhi 3514.

duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, Allaahumma 'aafinee min kulli balaa'in wa saqam. (Na. 58)

duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for well-being in this world and the Hereafter... [Health Supplication 58]
duas.virtue_sw: Huimarisha ulinzi wa mwili na kuzuia magonjwa ya mlipuko.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic healing prayer from Hisn al-Muslim, Tirmidhi 3514.

duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu poza joto kali la mwili wangu, na uponye ugonjwa wangu, na unirudishie nguvu zangu. [Dua ya Afya, Maradhi na Ruqyah Na. 119]
duas.english: O Allah, cool the heat of my body, cure my sickness, and restore my strength to me. [Health, Healing & Protection supplication #119]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Afya, Maradhi na Ruqyah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi, Sunan for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Afya, Maradhi na Ruqyah: Dua ya Kujikinga na Magonjwa ya Akili na Huzuni (Sehemu ya 120)
duas.title_en: Health, Healing & Protection: Dua ya Kujikinga na Magonjwa ya Akili na Huzuni (Part 120)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُنُونِ، وَالْجُذَامِ، وَالْبَرَصِ، وَسَيِّئِ الْأَسْقَامِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-junoon, wal-judhaam, wal-baras, wa sayyi'il-asqaam. (Na. 120)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na wazimu, na ukoma, na mbalanga, na maradhi yote mabaya yenye kuangamiza. [Dua ya Afya, Maradhi na Ruqyah Na. 120]
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from madness, leprosy, vitiligo, and evil diseases. [Health, Healing & Protection supplication #120]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Afya, Maradhi na Ruqyah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 1554, An-Nasa'i 5493 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Kumuombea Mahusiano na Ndoa ya Baraka
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Kumuombea Mahusiano na Ndoa ya Baraka
duas.title_ar: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُم...
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka, wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jama'a baynakumaa fee khayr.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki, na amwage baraka Zake juu yako, na awaunganishe ninyi wawili katika kheri.
duas.english: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Sunnah ya kuwaombea wanandoa siku ya harusi ili ndoa yao ijae mapenzi na amani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #190, Abu Dawud 2130, Tirmidhi 1091.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Mume Kumuombea Mkewe Baada ya Kufunga Ndoa
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Mume Kumuombea Mkewe Baada ya Kufunga Ndoa
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka khayrahaa wa khayra maa jabaltahaa 'alayh, wa a'oodhu bika min sharrihaa wa min sharri maa jabaltahaa 'alayh.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba kheri yake na kheri ya tabia uliyomuumbia nayo; na ninajikinga Kwako na shari yake na shari ya tabia uliyomuumbia nayo.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for her goodness and the good of that upon which You created her, and I seek refuge in You from her evil and the evil of that upon which You created her.
duas.reference: Hisn al-Muslim #191, Abu Dawud 2160, Ibn Majah 1918
duas.virtue_sw: Inaleta mapenzi ya dhati na kuzuia migogoro na maudhi ya ndoa tangu siku ya kwanza.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #191, Abu Dawud 2160, Ibn Majah 1918.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Tendo la Ndoa Kuzuia Shetani Asiguse Kizazi
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Tendo la Ndoa Kuzuia Shetani Asiguse Kizazi
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّب...
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ جَنِّبْنَا الشَّيْطَانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّيْطَانَ مَا رَزَقْتَنَا.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi, Allaahumma jannibnash-shaytaana, wa jannibish-shaytaana maa razaqtanaa.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, tuepushe na shetani na umuepushe shetani na kile utakachotupa (kizazi).
duas.english: In the name of Allah; O Allah, keep Satan away from us, and keep Satan away from what You provide us [of children].
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Ikiwa watakadiriwa kupata mtoto kutokana na tendo hilo, shetani hatamdhuru kamwe.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #192, Sahih al-Bukhari 6388, Muslim 1434.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Kuwakinga Watoto Dhidi ya Kijicho na Hasadi
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Kuwakinga Watoto Dhidi ya Kijicho na Hasadi
duas.title_ar: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْ...
duas.arabic: أُعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّةِ مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ.
duas.transliteration: U'eedhukumaa bi-kalimaatillaahit-taammati min kulli shaytaaniw-wa haammah, wa min kulli 'aynil-laammah.
duas.swahili: Ninawakinga ninyi wawili kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyotimia kutokana na kila shetani na kila mdudu mwenye sumu, na kutokana na kila jicho baya lenye kudhuru.
duas.english: I seek protection for you both in the perfect words of Allah from every devil and poisonous creature, and from every envious eye.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyokuwa akiwasomea Nabii Ibrahim wanawe Ismail na Is-haq, na Mtume (s.a.w) aliwasomea wajukuu zake Al-Hasan na Al-Husain.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #145, Sahih al-Bukhari 3371.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Kuwatakia Baraka Watoto Wachanga
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Kuwatakia Baraka Watoto Wachanga
duas.title_ar: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَ...
duas.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي الْمَوْهُوبِ لَكَ، وَشَكَرْتَ الْوَاهِبَ، وَبَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُ، وَرُزِقْتَ بِرَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-Waahib, wa balagha ashuddah, wa ruziqta birrah.
duas.swahili: Mwenyezi Mungu akubariki katika huyu uliyepewa, na umshukuru Mpaji Mkuu, na afikie utu uzima wake, na uruzukiwe wema na utiifu wake.
duas.english: May Allah bless you in what was granted to you, may you give thanks to the Giver, may he reach his maturity, and may you be granted his righteousness.
duas.virtue_sw: Hutumiwa kumpongeza mzazi aliyepata mtoto mchanga; inamvutia mtoto heshima na utiifu kwa wazazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #144, Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Familia: Dua ya Baraka za Familia na Watoto 6
duas.title_en: Family Supplication: Dua ya Baraka za Familia na Watoto 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي، وَبَارِكْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي وَذُرِّيَّتِي، وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا شَرَّ الْفِتَنِ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma aslih lee fee ahlee wa dhurriyyatee, wa baarik lanaa feemaa razaqtanaa wa qinaa sharral-fitan. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nitengenezee wema katika familia yangu na watoto wangu, na utubariki katika yale uliyoturuzuku, na utukinge na shari ya fitna. [Dua ya Familia 6]
duas.english: O Allah, rectify for me my family and children, and bless us in our sustenance... [Family Prayer 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Inajenga amani, heshima na uelewano ndani ya nyumba.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic family and marriage supplication from Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Familia, Ndoa na Malezi: Dua ya Kuweka Upendo na Huruma Kati ya Wanandoa (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Family, Marriage & Children: Dua ya Kuweka Upendo na Huruma Kati ya Wanandoa (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَلِّفْ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ ذَاتَ بَيْنِنَا، وَاهْدِنَا سُبُلَ السَّلَامِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma allif bayna quloobinaa, wa aslih dhaata bayninaa, wahdinaa subulas-salaam. (Na. 61)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu unganisha nyoyo zetu kwa mapenzi, na utengeneze mahusiano yetu, na utuongoze kwenye njia za amani. [Dua ya Familia, Ndoa na Malezi Na. 61]
duas.english: O Allah, unite our hearts in love, reconcile our differences, and guide us to the ways of peace. [Family, Marriage & Children supplication #61]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Familia, Ndoa na Malezi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 969, Al-Hakim 1/265 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Familia, Ndoa na Malezi: Dua ya Kumuombea Mke na Mume Utulivu wa Ndani (Sehemu ya 62)
duas.title_en: Family, Marriage & Children: Dua ya Kumuombea Mke na Mume Utulivu wa Ndani (Part 62)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي، وَبَارِكْ لِأَهْلِي فِيَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لِي فِي أَهْلِي، وَبَارِكْ لِأَهْلِي فِيَّ، وَارْزُقْنِي مِنْهُمْ، وَارْزُقْهُمْ مِنِّي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma baarik lee fee ahlee, wa baarik li-ahlee fiyya, war-zuqnee minhum, war-zuqhum minnee. (Na. 62)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nibariki katika familia yangu, na uibariki familia yangu kwangu, na uniruzuku kutoka kwao na uwaruzuku kutoka kwangu. [Dua ya Familia, Ndoa na Malezi Na. 62]
duas.english: O Allah, bless me in my family, bless my family in me... [Family, Marriage & Children supplication #62]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Familia, Ndoa na Malezi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ibn Abi Shaybah 7/119, Tabarani for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Kulipa Deni Hata Likijaa Kama Mlima Uhud
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Kulipa Deni Hata Likijaa Kama Mlima Uhud
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِي بِحَلَالِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummak-finee bi-halaalika 'an haraamik, wa aghninee bi-fadlika 'amman siwaak.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, nitosheleze na halali Yako ili nijiepushe na haramu Yako, na unitajirishe kwa fadhila Zako nisiwe na haja na mwingine yeyote asiyekuwa Wewe.
duas.english: O Allah, suffice me with Your lawful provisions against Your unlawful ones, and enrich me by Your bounty above all others besides You.
duas.virtue_sw: Ali ibn Abi Talib (r.a) alimwambia mtu aliyekuwa na deni: Hata kama ungedaiwa deni sawa na mlima wa Uhud, Allah angelikulipia kwa dua hii.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #140, Tirmidhi 3563.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Asubuhi ya Kuomba Elimu, Riziki Safi na Amali Inayokubaliwa
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Asubuhi ya Kuomba Elimu, Riziki Safi na Amali Inayokubaliwa
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَي...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka 'ilman naafi'aa, wa rizqan tayyibaa, wa 'amalam-mutaqabbalaa.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi nakuomba ilimu yenye manufaa, na riziki nzuri iliyo halali, na matendo yanayokubaliwa mbele Yako.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge that is beneficial, provision that is pure, and deeds that are accepted.
duas.virtue_sw: Inasomwa kila siku baada ya swala ya Alfajiri kwa ajili ya kuanza siku ya kutafuta riziki.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #71, Ibn Majah 925.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Kuongeza Baraka Katika Mali
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Kuongeza Baraka Katika Mali
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي وَوَلَدِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَكْثِرْ مَالِي وَوَلَدِي، وَبَارِكْ لِي فِيمَا أَعْطَيْتَنِي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma ak-thir maalee wa waladee, wa baarik lee feemaa a'taytanee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, ongeza mali yangu na watoto wangu, na unibariki katika kile ulichonipa.
duas.english: O Allah, increase my wealth and my children, and bless me in what You have granted me.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyomuombea Mtume (s.a.w) Anas ibn Malik; akawa miongoni mwa Maswahaba matajiri na wenye watoto wengi waliobarikiwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Sahih al-Bukhari 6334, Muslim 2480.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Kujikinga na Ufukara, Uadui na Tabia Mbaya Kazi
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Kujikinga na Ufukara, Uadui na Tabia Mbaya Kazi
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْقِلَّةِ،...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْفَقْرِ، وَالْقِلَّةِ، وَالذِّلَّةِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-faqr, wal-qillah, wadh-dhillah, wa a'oodhu bika min an adhlima aw udhlam.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na ufukara, na uhaba wa riziki, na udhalili; na ninajikinga Kwako nisije nikadhulumu au nikadhulumiwa.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from poverty, scarcity, and humiliation, and I seek refuge in You from committing injustice or suffering injustice.
duas.virtue_sw: Inalinda mfanyabiashara na mfanyakazi asidhulumiwe haki yake wala asiwaibie wateja au waajiri.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Abu Dawud 1544, An-Nasa'i 5460.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Aondoe Wasiwasi wa Riziki
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Kumuomba Allah Aondoe Wasiwasi wa Riziki
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الْأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ، فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى... اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma Rabbas-samaawaati wa Rabbal-ardi wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem... iqdi 'annad-dayna wa aghninaa minal-faqr.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, Mola wa mbingu na Mola wa ardhi na Mola wa Kiti Kikuu cha Enzi... tulipe madeni yetu na ututajirishe utuepushe na ufukara.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth... settle our debt for us and enrich us from poverty.
duas.virtue_sw: Inamaliza wasiwasi wa kiuchumi na kuleta utajiri wa halali na utulivu wa moyo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #105, Sahih Muslim 2713.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Riziki: Dua ya Kufunguliwa Milango ya Riziki na Kazi 6
duas.title_en: Sustenance Supplication: Dua ya Kufunguliwa Milango ya Riziki na Kazi 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا مِن...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِي رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا مِنْ غَيْرِ كَدٍّ وَلَا تَعَبٍ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahummar-zuqnee rizqan halaalan tayyiban waasi'am-min ghayri kaddin wa laa ta'ab, innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu niruzuku riziki ya halali, nzuri na pana bila ya mateso wala tabu; hakika Wewe juu ya kila kitu ni Muweza. [Riziki Dua 6]
duas.english: O Allah, grant me lawful, pure, and abundant provision... [Provision Supplication 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Hufungua baraka na mafanikio katika biashara na kazi halali.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic sustenance and work supplication from Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Riziki, Madeni na Kazi: Dua ya Kufunguliwa Milango ya Riziki Asubuhi (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Sustenance, Debt & Work: Dua ya Kufunguliwa Milango ya Riziki Asubuhi (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ وَتَوْفِيقِكَ، وَي...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رِزْقِكَ وَتَوْفِيقِكَ، وَيَسِّرْ لِي كُلَّ عَسِيرٍ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaf-tah lee abwaaba rizqika wa tawfeeqik, wa yassir lee kulla 'aseer. (Na. 61)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nifungulie milango ya riziki Yako na taufiki Yako, na unisahilishie kila lililo gumu. [Dua ya Riziki, Madeni na Kazi Na. 61]
duas.english: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your provision and success... [Sustenance, Debt & Work supplication #61]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Riziki, Madeni na Kazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Riziki, Madeni na Kazi: Dua ya Kulinda Mali Dhidi ya Wizi na Uharibifu (Sehemu ya 62)
duas.title_en: Sustenance, Debt & Work: Dua ya Kulinda Mali Dhidi ya Wizi na Uharibifu (Part 62)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَالِي وَأَهْلِي وَكُلَّ مَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ مَالِي وَأَهْلِي وَكُلَّ مَا أَنْعَمْتَ بِهِ عَلَيَّ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee astaudi'uka maalee wa ahlee wa kulla maa an'amta bihee 'alayy. (Na. 62)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu hakika mimi ninakukabidhi mali yangu na familia yangu na kila ulichonineemesha nacho. [Dua ya Riziki, Madeni na Kazi Na. 62]
duas.english: O Allah, I entrust to You my wealth, my family... [Sustenance, Debt & Work supplication #62]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Riziki, Madeni na Kazi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Ahmad 2/401, Ibn Majah for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.english: O Allah, open for me the doors of Your provision and success... [Sustenance, Debt & Work supplication #113]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Riziki, Madeni na Kazi.
