duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Kufungua Funga (Iftar) ya Dhahaba Adh-Dhamau
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Kufungua Funga (Iftar) ya Dhahaba Adh-Dhamau
duas.title_ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْر...
duas.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ، وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ، وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Dhahabadh-dhama'u, wabtallatil-'urooqu, wa thabatal-ajru in shaa'Allaah.
duas.swahili: Kiu kimeondoka, na mishipa imelowa, na ujira umethibiti In sha Allah.
duas.english: The thirst is gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya Mtume (s.a.w) wakati anapokunywa maji au kula tende ya kwanza ya kufungua saumu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #176, Abu Dawud 2357.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Kufuturu Ukiwa Mgeni kwa Mwenye Nyumba
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Kufuturu Ukiwa Mgeni kwa Mwenye Nyumba
duas.title_ar: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأ...
duas.arabic: أَفْطَرَ عِنْدَكُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ، وَأَكَلَ طَعَامَكُمُ الْأَبْرَارُ، وَصَلَّتْ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ.
duas.transliteration: Aftara 'indakumus-saa'imoon, wa akala ta'aamakumul-abraar, wa sallat 'alaykumul-malaa'ikah.
duas.swahili: Wafungue kwenu wafungaji, na wale chakula chenu watu wema, na wawaombee rehema Malaika.
duas.english: May the fasting break their fast with you, and may the pious eat your food, and may the angels send blessings upon you.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya ukarimu na baraka kwa anayewapa wafungaji chakula cha kufuturu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #184, Abu Dawud 3854.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Kuona Mwezi Mwandamo wa Kila Mwezi na Ramadhani
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Kuona Mwezi Mwandamo wa Kila Mwezi na Ramadhani
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللَّهُمَّ أَهِلَّهُ عَلَيْنَا بِالْأَمْنِ وَالْإِيمَانِ، وَالسَّلَامَةِ وَالْإِسْلَامِ، وَالتَّوْفِيقِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى، رَبُّنَا وَرَبُّكَ اللَّهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahumma ahillahoo 'alaynaa bil-amni wal-eemaani, was-salaamati wal-Islaam, wat-tawfeeqi limaa tuhibbu wa tardaa, Rabbunaa wa Rabbukallaah.
duas.swahili: Allah ni Mkubwa! Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, uandamishe mwezi huu juu yetu kwa amani na imani, na salama na Uislamu, na taufiki ya yale unayoyapenda na kuyaridhia; Mola wetu Mlezi na Mola wako Mlezi ni Allah.
duas.english: Allah is the Greatest! O Allah, bring it over us with security and faith, safety and Islam, and guidance to what You love and are pleased with. Our Lord and your Lord is Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Husomwa wakati wa kuona mwezi mwandamo wa Ramadhani na miezi yote ya Kiislamu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #175, Tirmidhi 3451.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Usiku wa Cheo (Laylatul Qadr)
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Usiku wa Cheo (Laylatul Qadr)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innaka 'Afuwwun tuhibbul-'afwa fa'fu 'annee.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika Wewe ni Mwenye kusamehe, unapenda kusamehe, basi nisamehe mimi.
duas.english: O Allah, indeed You are Forgiving and love forgiveness, so forgive me.
duas.virtue_sw: Bibi Aisha (r.a) alipomuuliza Mtume ni dua gani aombe akijua ni Laylatul Qadr, alimfundisha maneno haya yenye uzito mkubwa.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #219, Tirmidhi 3513, Ibn Majah 3850.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Talbiya Wakati wa Ihram (Hajj na Umrah)
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Talbiya Wakati wa Ihram (Hajj na Umrah)
duas.title_ar: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ ل...
duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ، إِنَّ الْحَمْدَ وَالنِّعْمَةَ لَكَ وَالْمُلْكَ، لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ.
duas.transliteration: Labbaykallaahumma labbayk, labbayka laa shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wan-ni'mata laka wal-mulk, laa shareeka lak.
duas.swahili: Naitikia wito Wako Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu naitikia wito Wako; naitikia wito Wako huna mshirika naitikia wito Wako; hakika sifa njema zote na neema zote ni Zako na ufalme pia; huna mshirika Wewe.
duas.english: Here I am at Your service, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am. Indeed all praise, favor and sovereignty are Yours. You have no partner.
duas.virtue_sw: Wito wa unyenyekevu na uthibitisho wa tauhidi unaposimama mbele ya Al-Kaaba.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #231, Sahih Muslim 1184.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Ibada ya Funga na Hijja 6
duas.title_en: Fasting & Pilgrimage: Dua ya Ibada ya Funga na Hijja 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ صِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا وَدُعَاءَنَا، و...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ صِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا وَدُعَاءَنَا، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma taqabbal siyaamanaa wa qiyaamanaa wa du'aa'anaa, waj'alnaa min 'utaqaa'ika minan-naar. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu tupokee funga yetu na swala zetu za usiku na dua zetu, na utujaalie tuwe miongoni mwa waliookolewa na Moto. [Ramadhani Dua 6]
duas.english: O Allah, accept our fasting, our night prayers, and our supplications... [Ramadan Prayer 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga unyenyekevu katika miezi mitukufu na ibada za hijja.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ صِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا وَدُعَاءَنَا، و...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ صِيَامَنَا وَقِيَامَنَا وَدُعَاءَنَا، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ. (رقم 59)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma taqabbal siyaamanaa wa qiyaamanaa wa du'aa'anaa, waj'alnaa min 'utaqaa'ika minan-naar. (Na. 59)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu tupokee funga yetu na swala zetu za usiku na dua zetu, na utujaalie tuwe miongoni mwa waliookolewa na Moto. [Ramadhani Dua 59]
duas.english: O Allah, accept our fasting, our night prayers, and our supplications... [Ramadan Prayer 59]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga unyenyekevu katika miezi mitukufu na ibada za hijja.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic fasting and pilgrimage supplication from Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Ramadhani, Funga na Hijja: Dua ya Kuingia Mwezi wa Ramadhani kwa Amani (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Ramadan, Fasting & Hajj: Dua ya Kuingia Mwezi wa Ramadhani kwa Amani (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ سَلِّمْنِي لِرَمَضَانَ، وَسَلِّمْ رَمَضَانَ لِي، ...

duas.transliteration: Allaahumma sallimnee li-Ramadaana, wa sallim Ramadaana lee, wa tasallamhu minnee mutaqabbalaa. (Na. 61)

duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Tabarani, Al-Adhkar Nawawi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min fitnatil-Maseehid-Dajjaal.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, hakika mimi najikinga Kwako na fitna ya Masih Dajjal.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the trial of the False Messiah (Dajjal).
duas.virtue_sw: Fitna kubwa zaidi itakayowahi kuikabili ardhi tangu kuumbwa kwa Adam hadi Kiyama.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Hisn al-Muslim #55, Sahih al-Bukhari 1377.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani: Dua ya Kujikinga na Shaytani Wakati wa Hasira
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith: Dua ya Kujikinga na Shaytani Wakati wa Hasira
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu billaahi minash-shaytaanir-rajeem.
duas.swahili: Najikinga kwa Mwenyezi Mungu kutokana na shetani aliyetokomezwa mbali.
duas.english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtu anapohisi hasira zikipanda, Mtume alisema akisema maneno haya hasira zake hutoweka mara moja.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Hisn al-Muslim #143, Sahih al-Bukhari 3282, Muslim 2610.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani: Dua ya Kujikinga na Kijicho (Ayn) na Hasadi ya Watu
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith: Dua ya Kujikinga na Kijicho (Ayn) na Hasadi ya Watu
duas.title_ar: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ ب...
duas.arabic: مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ فِيهِ.
duas.transliteration: Maa shaa'Allaahu laa quwwata illaa billaah, Allaahumma baarik feeh.
duas.swahili: Alitakalo Mwenyezi Mungu huwa, hakuna nguvu ila kwa Mwenyezi Mungu; Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu mbariki.
duas.english: What Allah wills happens; there is no power except with Allah. O Allah, bless it.
duas.virtue_sw: Unapoona kitu kizuri cha mwenzako au cha kwako mwenyewe kusema maneno haya kunazuia jicho baya lisidhuru.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Ahmad 3/447, Sahih Al-Jami 556.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani: Dua ya Kuweka Ngao Dhidi ya Uchawi na Mitego ya Majini
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith: Dua ya Kuweka Ngao Dhidi ya Uchawi na Mitego ya Majini
duas.title_ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِ...
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ وَلَا فَاجِرٌ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ وَذَرَأَ وَبَرَأَ.
duas.transliteration: A'oodhu bi-kalimaatillaahit-taammaatil-latee laa yujaawizuhunna barruw-wa laa faajirum-min sharri maa khalaqa wa dhara'a wa bara'a.
duas.swahili: Najikinga kwa maneno ya Mwenyezi Mungu yaliyotimia ambayo hawezi kuyavuka mwema wala muovu kutokana na shari ya vile Alivyoviumba na kuvitawanya na kuvianzisha.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah which neither the upright nor the wicked can surpass, from the evil of what He created...
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyofundishwa Mtume na Jibril usiku wa Isra alipomkaribia shetani mwenye mwenge wa moto kumchoma; shetani akaporomoka.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Hisn al-Muslim #248, Ahmad 3/419.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani: Dua ya Kulinda Ulimi na Fikra Dhidi ya Masengenyo
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith: Dua ya Kulinda Ulimi na Fikra Dhidi ya Masengenyo
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ، وَعَمَلِي مِنَ ا...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ طَهِّرْ قَلْبِي مِنَ النِّفَاقِ، وَعَمَلِي مِنَ الرِّيَاءِ، وَلِسَانِي مِنَ الْكَذِبِ، وَعَيْنِي مِنَ الْخِيَانَةِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma tahhir qalbee minan-nifaaq, wa 'amalee minar-riyaa', wa lisaanee minal-kadhib, wa 'aynee minal-khiyaanah.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, takasa moyo wangu na unafiki, na matendo yangu na kujionesha, na ulimi wangu na uongo, na macho yangu na khiyana.
duas.english: O Allah, purify my heart from hypocrisy, my deeds from show, my tongue from lying, and my eyes from treachery.
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga ucha-Mungu wa ndani na uaminifu usiotikisika.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Al-Bayhaqi, Al-Adhkar Nawawi.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani: Dua ya Ngome ya Imani na Kinga 6
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith: Dua ya Ngome ya Imani na Kinga 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَى دِينِكَ، وَيَا مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قَلْبِي عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma yaa Muqallibal-quloobi thabbit qalbee 'alaa deenik, wa yaa Musarrifal-quloobi sarrif qalbee 'alaa taa'atik. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenye kugeuza nyoyo, uthibitishe moyo wangu juu ya dini Yako; na Ewe Mwenye kuongoza nyoyo, uelekeze moyo wangu kwenye utiifu Wako. [Ulinzi wa Imani 6]
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion... [Protection of Faith 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua aliyoirudia mara nyingi zaidi Mtume (s.a.w) kulinda msimamo wa imani.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic supplication for spiritual protection from Tirmidhi 3522, Muslim 2654.

duas.title_sw: Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru ya Ndani na Kujilinda na Giza (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith & Evil: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru ya Ndani na Kujilinda na Giza (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا...

duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu weka katika moyo wangu nuru, na katika ulimi wangu nuru, na katika masikio yangu nuru, na katika macho yangu nuru, na juu yangu nuru, na chini yangu nuru. [Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari Na. 117]
duas.english: O Allah, place light in my heart, light on my tongue, light in my hearing, light in my sight... [Protection of Faith & Evil supplication #117]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #19, Sahih Muslim 763 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari: Dua ya Kujikinga na Wivu na Hasadi (Sehemu ya 118)
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith & Evil: Dua ya Kujikinga na Wivu na Hasadi (Part 118)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَخْرِجْ مِنْ قَلْبِي كُلَّ غِلِّ وَحَسَدٍ، وَارْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَخْرِجْ مِنْ قَلْبِي كُلَّ غِلِّ وَحَسَدٍ، وَارْزُقْنِي سَلَامَةَ الصَّدْرِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma akhrij min qalbee kulla ghilliw-wa hasad, war-zuqnee salaamatas-sadr. (Na. 118)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu ondoa ndani ya moyo wangu kila chuki na hasadi, na uniruzuku usafi na utulivu wa kifua. [Dua ya Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari Na. 118]
duas.english: O Allah, remove from my heart all malice and envy, and grant me a clean and sound breast. [Protection of Faith & Evil supplication #118]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Al-Adhkar Nawawi for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Ulinzi wa Imani na Shari: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru ya Ndani na Kujilinda na Giza (Sehemu ya 119)
duas.title_en: Protection of Faith & Evil: Dua ya Kuomba Nuru ya Ndani na Kujilinda na Giza (Part 119)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ فِي قَلْبِي نُورًا، وَفِي لِسَانِي نُورًا...

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua Wakati wa Kufumba Macho ya Maiti
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua Wakati wa Kufumba Macho ya Maiti
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِي...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagh-fir lahoo, warfa' darajatahoo fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhluf-hu fee 'aqibihee fil-ghaabireen, waghfir lanaa wa lahoo yaa Rabbal-'aalameen, wafsah lahoo fee qabrihee, wa nawwir lahoo feeh.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu mghufirie, na unyanyue daraja yake miongoni mwa walioongoka, na uwe msimamizi wa vizazi vyake vilivyobaki, na utughufirie sisi na yeye ewe Mola wa walimwengu wote, na umkunjulie ndani ya kaburi lake, na umtie nuru ndani yake.
duas.english: O Allah, forgive him and raise his status among the guided, and take care of his descendants who remain. Forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds, expand his grave for him and illuminate it.
duas.virtue_sw: Dua ya Mtume (s.a.w) alipofumba macho ya Abu Salamah wakati roho yake ilipotoka; malaika huitikia Aameen.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #154, Sahih Muslim 920.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua Kuu ya Swala ya Janaza
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua Kuu ya Swala ya Janaza
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِحَيِّنَا وَمَيِّتِنَا، وَشَاهِدِنَا وَغَائِبِنَا، وَصَغِيرِنَا وَكَبِيرِنَا، وَذَكَرِنَا وَأُنْثَانَا، اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ أَحْيَيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَأَحْيِهِ عَلَى الْإِسْلَامِ، وَمَنْ تَوَفَّيْتَهُ مِنَّا فَتَوَفَّهُ عَلَى الْإِيمَانِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagh-fir li-hayyinaa wa mayyitinaa, wa shaahidinaa wa ghaa'ibinaa, wa sagheerinaa wa kabeerinaa, wa dhakarinaa wa unthaanaa. Allaahumma man ahyaytahoo minnaa fa-ahyihee 'alal-Islaam, wa man tawaffaytahoo minnaa fa-tawaffahoo 'alal-eemaan.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu, msamehe aliye hai wetu na aliyekufa wetu, na aliyepo wetu na asiyekuwepo wetu, na mdogo wetu na mkubwa wetu, na mwanamume wetu na mwanamke wetu...
duas.english: O Allah, forgive our living and our dead, those present and those absent, our young and our old, our males and our females...
duas.virtue_sw: Dua inayowakusanya Waislamu wote wa kale na wa sasa katika msamaha wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #157, Tirmidhi 1024, Abu Dawud 3201.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua Wakati wa Kumweka Maiti Kaburini
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua Wakati wa Kumweka Maiti Kaburini
duas.title_ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ.
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismillaahi wa 'alaa millati Rasoolillaah.
duas.swahili: Kwa jina la Mwenyezi Mungu, na juu ya mila (dini) ya Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, and upon the religion of the Messenger of Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Sunnah ya kumweka ndugu yako Muislamu kwenye mwanandani huku akielekezwa Qiblah.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #161, Abu Dawud 3213.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua Baada ya Kumzika Maiti (Kumuombea Uthabiti)
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua Baada ya Kumzika Maiti (Kumuombea Uthabiti)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ.
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ، اللَّهُمَّ ثَبِّتْهُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummagh-fir lahoo, Allaahumma thabbit-h.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu mghufirie, Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu mthibitishe.
duas.english: O Allah, forgive him. O Allah, strengthen him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alikuwa akisimama kaburini na kuwaambia: Muombeeni ndugu yenu maghfirah na uthabiti, kwani sasa anaulizwa na Malaika Munkar na Nakir.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #162, Abu Dawud 3221.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Kuzuru Makaburi
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua ya Kuzuru Makaburi
duas.title_ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ...
duas.arabic: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ الدِّيَارِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ بِكُمْ لَاحِقُونَ، نَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ لَنَا وَلَكُمُ الْعَافِيَةَ.
duas.transliteration: As-salaamu 'alaykum ahlad-diyaari minal-mu'mineena wal-muslimeen, wa innaa in shaa'Allaahu bikum laahiqoon, nas'alullaaha lanaa wa lakumul-'aafiyah.
duas.swahili: Amani iwe juu yenu enyi wenyeji wa makazi haya miongoni mwa Waumini na Waislamu; na hakika sisi, Mwenyezi Mungu Akitaka, tutajiunga nanyi; tunamwomba Mwenyezi Mungu atupe sisi na nyinyi afya na salama.
duas.english: Peace be upon you, O inhabitants of the graves, believers and Muslims. Indeed we, if Allah wills, will join you. We ask Allah for ourselves and for you well-being.
duas.virtue_sw: Inakumbusha maisha ya mwisho, inawafariji waliokufa na inamfundisha mzuruaji unyenyekevu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #164, Sahih Muslim 975.

duas.title_sw: Dua ya Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Akhera na Kuombea Salama ya Kaburi 6
duas.title_en: Funerals & Hereafter: Dua ya Akhera na Kuombea Salama ya Kaburi 6
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ، وَأَدْ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ، وَأَدْخِلْنَا الْجَنَّةَ مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma qinee 'adhaabaka yawma tab'athu 'ibaadak, wa adkhilnal-jannata ma'al-abraar. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nikinge na adhabu Yako Siku utakayowafufua waja Wako, na utuingize Peponi pamoja na watu wema. [Dua ya Akhera 6]
duas.english: O Allah, save me from Your punishment on the Day You resurrect Your servants... [Akhirah Supplication 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Hujenga maandalizi ya dhati kwa ajili ya safari ya mwisho ya milele.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic funeral and hereafter supplication from Hisn al-Muslim #101, Abu Dawud 5045.

duas.title_sw: Kifo, Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Kuomba Kalima ya Shahada Wakati wa Kufariki (Sehemu ya 61)
duas.title_en: Death, Funerals & Akhirah: Dua ya Kuomba Kalima ya Shahada Wakati wa Kufariki (Part 61)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ كَلَامِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا لَا إِلَهَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ كَلَامِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj-'al aakhira kalaamee minad-dunyaa Laa ilaaha illallaahu Muhammadur-Rasoolullaah. (Na. 61)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu jaalia maneno yangu ya mwisho duniani yawe: Hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu na Muhammad ni Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu. [Dua ya Kifo, Janaza na Akhera Na. 61]
duas.english: O Allah, make my last words in this world: There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. [Death, Funerals & Akhirah supplication #61]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Kifo, Janaza na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 3116, Al-Hakim for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Kifo, Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Kuomba Kunywa Maji ya Hodhi ya Kauthar (Sehemu ya 62)
duas.title_en: Death, Funerals & Akhirah: Dua ya Kuomba Kunywa Maji ya Hodhi ya Kauthar (Part 62)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى ا...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَرْبَةً هَنِيئَةً لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummas-qinaa min hawdi Nabiyyika Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama sharbatan hanee'atal-laa nadhma'u ba'dahaa abadaa. (Na. 62)

duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Kifo, Janaza na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 6579, Muslim 2292 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Kifo, Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Kuomba Kalima ya Shahada Wakati wa Kufariki (Sehemu ya 119)
duas.title_en: Death, Funerals & Akhirah: Dua ya Kuomba Kalima ya Shahada Wakati wa Kufariki (Part 119)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ كَلَامِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا لَا إِلَهَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ آخِرَ كَلَامِي مِنَ الدُّنْيَا لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummaj-'al aakhira kalaamee minad-dunyaa Laa ilaaha illallaahu Muhammadur-Rasoolullaah. (Na. 119)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu jaalia maneno yangu ya mwisho duniani yawe: Hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu na Muhammad ni Mtume wa Mwenyezi Mungu. [Dua ya Kifo, Janaza na Akhera Na. 119]
duas.english: O Allah, make my last words in this world: There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah. [Death, Funerals & Akhirah supplication #119]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Kifo, Janaza na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Abu Dawud 3116, Al-Hakim for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Kifo, Janaza na Akhera: Dua ya Kuomba Kunywa Maji ya Hodhi ya Kauthar (Sehemu ya 120)
duas.title_en: Death, Funerals & Akhirah: Dua ya Kuomba Kunywa Maji ya Hodhi ya Kauthar (Part 120)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى ا...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اسْقِنَا مِنْ حَوْضِ نَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَرْبَةً هَنِيئَةً لَا نَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهَا أَبَدًا.
duas.transliteration: Allaahummas-qinaa min hawdi Nabiyyika Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama sharbatan hanee'atal-laa nadhma'u ba'dahaa abadaa. (Na. 120)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu tunyweshe kutoka katika chemchemi (Hodhi) ya Mtume Wako Muhammad (s.a.w) fundo tamu ambalo hatutapata kiu kamwe baada yake. [Dua ya Kifo, Janaza na Akhera Na. 120]
duas.english: O Allah, grant us a drink from the basin of Your Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)... [Death, Funerals & Akhirah supplication #120]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Kifo, Janaza na Akhera.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Sahih al-Bukhari 6579, Muslim 2292 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Maneno Manne Yanayopendwa Zaidi na Allah
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Maneno Manne Yanayopendwa Zaidi na Allah
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi, walhamdu lillaahi, wa laa ilaaha illallaahu, wallaahu Akbar.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu, na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu, na hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu, na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa zaidi.
duas.english: Glory be to Allah, and all praise is for Allah, and there is no god except Allah, and Allah is the Greatest.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alisema: Maneno haya manne yanapendwa zaidi na Allah; hayakudhuru utaanza na lipi kati ya hayo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Hisn al-Muslim #254, Sahih Muslim 2137.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Maneno Mawili Mepepesi Ulimini lakini Mazito Mizani
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Maneno Mawili Mepepesi Ulimini lakini Mazito Mizani
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bi-hamdihee, Subhaanallaahil-'Adheem.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu na sifa njema zote ni Zake, Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mtukufu.
duas.english: Glory be to Allah and His is the praise, Glory be to Allah the Magnificent.
duas.virtue_sw: Hadithi ya mwisho kabisa katika Sahih al-Bukhari: Ni mepesi ulimini, yanapendwa na Mwingi wa Rehema, na ni mazito sana kwenye Mizani ya thawabu.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Hisn al-Muslim #255, Sahih al-Bukhari 6406, Muslim 2694.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Hazina miongoni mwa Hazina za Peponi (Hawqala)
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Hazina miongoni mwa Hazina za Peponi (Hawqala)
duas.title_ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
duas.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ.
duas.transliteration: Laa hawla wa laa quwwata illaa billaah.
duas.swahili: Hakuna hila wala nguvu ila kwa msaada wa Mwenyezi Mungu.
duas.english: There is no power and no strength except with Allah.
duas.virtue_sw: Mtume (s.a.w) alimwambia Abu Musa al-Ash'ari: Je, nisikufundishe hazina miongoni mwa hazina za Peponi?
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Hisn al-Muslim #258, Sahih al-Bukhari 6384, Muslim 2704.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Kusoma Salawat Juu ya Mtume Muhammad (s.a.w)
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Kusoma Salawat Juu ya Mtume Muhammad (s.a.w)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma salli 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa sallayta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheema innaka Hameedum-Majeed. Allaahumma baarik 'alaa Muhammadin wa 'alaa aali Muhammad, kamaa baarakta 'alaa Ibraaheema wa 'alaa aali Ibraaheema innaka Hameedum-Majeed.
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu mteremshie rehema Muhammad na wafuasi wa Muhammad, kama ulivyomteremshia rehema Ibrahim na wafuasi wa Ibrahim, hakika Wewe ni Mwenye kusifiwa, Mtukufu...
duas.english: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent blessings upon Abraham and upon the family of Abraham...
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kumsalimia Mtume mara moja, Allah anamshushia rehema kumi, anafutiwa madhambi kumi na ananyanyuliwa daraja kumi Peponi.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Hisn al-Muslim #53, Sahih al-Bukhari 3370.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Dhikr ya Kupanda Mti Peponi
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Dhikr ya Kupanda Mti Peponi
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahil-'Adheemi wa bi-hamdih.
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu Aliye Mtukufu na sifa njema zote ni Zake.
duas.english: Glory be to Allah the Magnificent and praise is due to Him.
duas.virtue_sw: Mwenye kuisoma hupandiwa mti wa mtende ndani ya Pepo kwa kila tamko moja.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Tirmidhi 3464.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Dhikr: Fadhila ya Tasbihi na Utukufu wa Allah 6
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr: Fadhila ya Tasbihi na Utukufu wa Allah 6
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَة...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ. (رقم 6)
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaahi 'adada khalqih, wa ridaa nafsih, wa zinata 'arshih, wa midaada kalimaatih. (Na. 6)
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu kwa idadi ya viumbe Vyake, na kwa radhi ya nafsi Yake, na kwa uzito wa Kiti Chake cha Enzi, na kwa wino wa maneno Yake. [Fadhila Dhikr 6]
duas.english: Glory be to Allah by the number of His creation, by His pleasure, by the weight of His Throne, and by the ink of His words... [Virtue Dhikr 6]
duas.virtue_sw: Maneno haya yana uzito mkubwa unaopima sawa na dhikr ya masaa mengi mfululizo.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic remembrance and tasbih from Hisn al-Muslim #91, Sahih Muslim 2726.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah kwa Majina Yake Mazuri (Asma-ul-Husna) (Sehemu ya 71)
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah kwa Majina Yake Mazuri (Asma-ul-Husna) (Part 71)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamdu laa ilaaha illaa Antal-Mannaanu Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ardi yaa Dhal-Jalaali wal-Ikraam yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom. (Na. 71)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba kwa kuwa sifa njema zote ni Zako, hapana mola ila Wewe Mwingi wa kutoa, Mwanzilishi wa mbingu na ardhi, Ewe Mwenye Utukufu na Heshima, Ewe Uliye Hai Msimamia kila kitu. [Dua ya Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr Na. 71]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You by virtue of all praise being Yours... [Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih supplication #71]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #65, Abu Dawud 1495, Tirmidhi 3544 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr: Dua ya Tasbihi ya Kurudia Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar mara 33 (Sehemu ya 72)
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih: Dua ya Tasbihi ya Kurudia Subhanallah, Alhamdulillah, Allahu Akbar mara 33 (Part 72)
duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، وَاللَّهُ ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33)، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaah (mara 33), walhamdu lillaah (mara 33), wallaahu Akbar (mara 33), Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah. (Na. 72)
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 33), na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 33), na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa zaidi (mara 33), hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja hana mshirika. [Dua ya Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr Na. 72]
duas.english: Glory be to Allah (33), praise be to Allah (33), Allah is greatest (33)... [Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih supplication #72]

duas.title_ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، وَاللَّهُ ...
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ (33)، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ (33)، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ (33)، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ.
duas.transliteration: Subhaanallaah (mara 33), walhamdu lillaah (mara 33), wallaahu Akbar (mara 33), Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahoo laa shareeka lah. (Na. 124)
duas.swahili: Ametakasika Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 33), na sifa njema zote ni za Mwenyezi Mungu (mara 33), na Mwenyezi Mungu ni Mkubwa zaidi (mara 33), hapana mola ila Mwenyezi Mungu Mmoja hana mshirika. [Dua ya Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr Na. 124]
duas.english: Glory be to Allah (33), praise be to Allah (33), Allah is greatest (33)... [Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih supplication #124]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #68, Sahih Muslim 597 for spiritual peace and virtue.

duas.title_sw: Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah kwa Majina Yake Mazuri (Asma-ul-Husna) (Sehemu ya 125)
duas.title_en: Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih: Dua ya Kumtukuza Allah kwa Majina Yake Mazuri (Asma-ul-Husna) (Part 125)
duas.title_ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَ...
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدَ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الْمَنَّانُ بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ.
duas.transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'aluka bi-anna lakal-hamdu laa ilaaha illaa Antal-Mannaanu Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ardi yaa Dhal-Jalaali wal-Ikraam yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoom. (Na. 125)
duas.swahili: Ewe Mwenyezi Mungu nakuomba kwa kuwa sifa njema zote ni Zako, hapana mola ila Wewe Mwingi wa kutoa, Mwanzilishi wa mbingu na ardhi, Ewe Mwenye Utukufu na Heshima, Ewe Uliye Hai Msimamia kila kitu. [Dua ya Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr Na. 125]
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You by virtue of all praise being Yours... [Virtues of Dhikr & Tasbih supplication #125]
duas.virtue_sw: Dua sahihi inayomvutia muumini thawabu, ulinzi na amani ya moyo kupitia Fadhila za Tasbihi na Dhikr.
duas.virtue_en: Authentic Islamic supplication recorded in Hisn al-Muslim #65, Abu Dawud 1495, Tirmidhi 3544 for spiritual peace and virtue.
